+import openpyxl
+from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
+from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
+from datetime import datetime
+from io import BytesIO
+
+def generate_excel(data: list, columns: list, title: str = "Export"):
+    """
+    Generates an Excel file in memory.
+    
+    :param data: List of dictionaries or objects (if objects, ensure to dict beforehand or handle it)
+                 OR List of Lists used directly as rows.
+    :param columns: List of column headers.
+    :param title: Title for the worksheet.
+    :return: BytesIO object containing the .xlsx file.
+    """
+    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
+    ws = wb.active
+    ws.title = title[:30] # Excel limits sheet names
+
+    # Styles
+    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
+    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="334155", end_color="334155", fill_type="solid") # Slate-700
+    centered = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
+    border_style = Side(style="thin", color="CBD5E1")
+    border = Border(left=border_style, right=border_style, top=border_style, bottom=border_style)
+
+    # 1. Headers
+    for col_idx, col_name in enumerate(columns, 1):
+        cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=str(col_name).upper())
+        cell.font = header_font
+        cell.fill = header_fill
+        cell.alignment = centered
+        cell.border = border
+
+    # 2. Data
+    for row_idx, row_data in enumerate(data, 2):
+        row_values = []
+        if isinstance(row_data, dict):
+            # If dict, assume columns map to keys (fragile if keys don't match or order differs)
+            # Better to pass row_data as list of values already ordered.
+            row_values = list(row_data.values())
+        elif isinstance(row_data, (list, tuple)):
+            row_values = row_data
+        else:
+            # Try object attributes
+            row_values = [getattr(row_data, col.lower(), "") for col in columns]
+
+        for col_idx, value in enumerate(row_values, 1):
+            cell = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx, value=value)
+            cell.border = border
+            
+            # Simple Formatting
+            if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+                cell.number_format = '#,##0.00'
+            elif isinstance(value, datetime):
+                cell.number_format = 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm'
+
+    # 3. Auto-Width
+    for column_cells in ws.columns:
+        length = max(len(str(cell.value) or "") for cell in column_cells)
+        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(column_cells[0].column)].width = min(length + 2, 50)
+
+    output = BytesIO()
+    wb.save(output)
+    output.seek(0)
+    return output

+        subject = "❌ Error: Inicialización de Revisión de Discrepancias"
+        body = f"Ocurrió un error al ejecutar el agente de revisión.\n\n"
+        body += f"Error:\n{result.get('error', '')}\n{result.get('stderr', '')}"
+        
+    send_email_notification(emails, subject, body)
+
+def get_mismatch_db_cron_schedule():
+    db = SessionLocal()
+    config = db.query(MismatchAutomationConfig).first()
+    db.close()
+    if config and config.cron_schedule:
+        return config.cron_schedule
+    return "30 7,12 * * *" 
+
+def setup_mismatch_scheduler(scheduler):
+    try:
+        cron_expr = get_mismatch_db_cron_schedule()
+        parts = cron_expr.strip().split()
+        if len(parts) == 5:
+            min, hr, dom, mth, dow = parts
+            scheduler.add_job(
+                scheduled_mismatch_job,
+                CronTrigger(minute=min, hour=hr, day=dom, month=mth, day_of_week=dow),
+                id='mismatch_automation',
+                replace_existing=True
+            )
+            print(f"Mismatch Automation Scheduler started with CRON {cron_expr}")
+        else:
+            print("Invalid CRON format in database for mismatch. Expected 5 parts.")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Could not setup mismatch scheduler: {e}")
+
+def update_mismatch_scheduler_cron(scheduler, new_cron: str):
+    parts = new_cron.strip().split()
+    if len(parts) == 5:
+        min, hr, dom, mth, dow = parts
+        scheduler.reschedule_job(
+            'mismatch_automation',
+            trigger=CronTrigger(minute=min, hour=hr, day=dom, month=mth, day_of_week=dow)
+        )
+        print(f"Mismatch Scheduler job updated to {new_cron}")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid cron format")

+"""
+mp_alert_service.py
+Servicio de análisis de Materia Prima vs Compras.
+Calcula el balance entre lo requerido (ventas/pedidos/cotizaciones) y lo comprado.
+Envía alertas diarias por Telegram a los suscriptores registrados en la BD local.
+"""
+
+import os
+import logging
+import requests
+from datetime import date, timedelta
+from typing import Optional
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+log = logging.getLogger("mp_alert_service")
+
+TELEGRAM_TOKEN = os.getenv("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN", "")
+
+# ── Telegram ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def send_telegram_to(chat_id: str, message: str, parse_mode: str = "Markdown") -> bool:
+    """Envía un mensaje de Telegram a un chat_id específico."""
+    if not TELEGRAM_TOKEN:
+        log.warning(f"[TELEGRAM NO CONFIGURADO] Mensaje para {chat_id}:\n{message}")
+        return False
+    try:
+        # Si es un número de teléfono (ej: 04126036358), usarlo directamente como string
+        url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TELEGRAM_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
+        r = requests.post(url, json={
+            "chat_id": chat_id,
+            "text": message,
+            "parse_mode": parse_mode
+        }, timeout=15)
+        if r.ok:
+            log.info(f"Telegram ✅ enviado a {chat_id}")
+            return True
+        else:
+            log.error(f"Telegram error para {chat_id}: {r.text}")
+            return False
+    except Exception as e:
+        log.error(f"Error enviando Telegram a {chat_id}: {e}")
+        return False
+
+
+def send_mp_alert_to_all(local_db: Session, balance_data: list, fecha: str) -> dict:
+    """Lee todos los suscriptores activos de tipo MP y envía el reporte."""
+    from ..models import TelegramSubscriber
+    
+    subscribers = local_db.query(TelegramSubscriber).filter(
+        TelegramSubscriber.is_active == True,
+        TelegramSubscriber.report_type.in_(["MP", "General"])
+    ).all()
+    
+    if not subscribers:
+        return {"sent": 0, "errors": 0, "message": "No hay suscriptores activos"}
+    
+    message = format_mp_telegram_message(balance_data, fecha)
+    sent = 0
+    errors = 0
+    
+    for sub in subscribers:
+        ok = send_telegram_to(sub.chat_id, message)
+        if ok:
+            sent += 1
+        else:
+            errors += 1
+    
+    return {"sent": sent, "errors": errors, "total": len(subscribers)}
+

+# ── Cálculo de balance MP ─────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def get_mp_demand(ext_conn, fecha_ini: str, fecha_fin: str,
+                  include_ventas: bool = True,
+                  include_pedidos: bool = True,
+                  include_cotizaciones: bool = True) -> list:
+    """
+    Consulta la demanda de artículos MP derivada de PT en documentos comerciales.
+    Usa saFormulaArticulo/saFormulaArticuloReng si existe, sino saArticuloComp.
+    Retorna [{co_art_mp, des_art_mp, cantidad_requerida, unidad, fuente}]
+    """
+    results = []
+    
+    # Detectar tabla de fórmulas disponible
+    formula_table = _detect_formula_table(ext_conn)
+    if not formula_table:
+        log.warning("No se encontró tabla de fórmulas de PT en SQL Server")
+        return []
+    
+    fhead, freng = formula_table
+    
+    docs_union_parts = []
+    params = {"fi": fecha_ini, "ff": fecha_fin}
+    
+    if include_ventas:
+        docs_union_parts.append("""
+            SELECT r.co_art, SUM(r.total_art) as cant
+            FROM saFacturaVenta f
+            JOIN saFacturaVentaReng r ON f.doc_num = r.doc_num
+            WHERE f.fec_emis BETWEEN :fi AND :ff
+              AND f.anulado = 0
+            GROUP BY r.co_art
+        """)
+    
+    if include_pedidos:
+        docs_union_parts.append("""
+            SELECT r.co_art, SUM(r.total_art) as cant
+            FROM saPedidoVenta p
+            JOIN saPedidoVentaReng r ON p.doc_num = r.doc_num
+            WHERE p.fec_emis BETWEEN :fi AND :ff
+              AND p.anulado = 0
+              AND p.status NOT IN ('C', 'A')
+            GROUP BY r.co_art
+        """)
+    
+    if include_cotizaciones:
+        docs_union_parts.append("""
+            SELECT r.co_art, SUM(r.total_art) as cant
+            FROM saPresupuestoVenta pv
+            JOIN saPresupuestoVentaReng r ON pv.doc_num = r.doc_num
+            WHERE pv.fec_emis BETWEEN :fi AND :ff
+              AND ISNULL(pv.anulado, 0) = 0
+            GROUP BY r.co_art
+        """)
+    
+    if not docs_union_parts:
+        return []
+    
+    union_sql = " UNION ALL ".join(docs_union_parts)
+    
+    sql = f"""
+        SELECT
+            comp.co_art_comp        AS co_art_mp,
+            ISNULL(a.art_des, comp.co_art_comp) AS des_art_mp,
+            SUM(docs.cant * comp.cant_comp) AS cantidad_requerida,
+            ISNULL(comp.co_uni_comp, 'UN') AS unidad
+        FROM (
+            SELECT co_art, SUM(cant) as cant
+            FROM ({union_sql}) AS docs_total
+            GROUP BY co_art
+        ) AS docs
+        JOIN {fhead} fh ON fh.co_art = docs.co_art
+        JOIN {freng} comp ON comp.co_art = fh.co_art
+        LEFT JOIN saArticulo a ON a.co_art = comp.co_art_comp
+        GROUP BY comp.co_art_comp, a.art_des, comp.co_uni_comp
+        ORDER BY cantidad_requerida DESC
+    """
+    
+    try:
+        rows = ext_conn.execute(sa.text(sql), params).fetchall()
+        results = [
+            {
+                "co_art_mp": str(r.co_art_mp).strip(),
+                "des_art_mp": str(r.des_art_mp).strip(),
+                "cantidad_requerida": float(r.cantidad_requerida),
+                "unidad": str(r.unidad).strip()
+            }
+            for r in rows
+        ]
+    except Exception as e:
+        log.error(f"Error consultando demanda MP: {e}")
+    
+    return results
+
+
+def get_mp_purchases(ext_conn, fecha_ini: str, fecha_fin: str) -> list:
+    """
+    Consulta las compras de MP en el período: saOrdenCompra + saOrdenCompraReng.
+    También incluye recepciones si existe saRecepcionCompra.
+    Retorna [{co_art, cant_comprada}]
+    """
+    results = []
+    sql = """
+        SELECT
+            r.co_art,
+            SUM(r.cant_total_rec) AS cant_comprada
+        FROM saOrdenCompra oc
+        JOIN saOrdenCompraReng r ON oc.doc_num = r.doc_num
+        WHERE oc.fec_emis BETWEEN :fi AND :ff
+          AND ISNULL(oc.anulado, 0) = 0
+        GROUP BY r.co_art
+    """
+    try:
+        rows = ext_conn.execute(sa.text(sql), {"fi": fecha_ini, "ff": fecha_fin}).fetchall()
+        results = [{"co_art": str(r.co_art).strip(), "cant_comprada": float(r.cant_comprada)} for r in rows]
+    except Exception as e:
+        log.warning(f"Error con cant_total_rec, intentando cant_pend: {e}")
+        # Fallback: usar cant_pend o total_art
+        try:
+            sql2 = """
+                SELECT r.co_art, SUM(ISNULL(r.total_art, r.cant_pend)) AS cant_comprada
+                FROM saOrdenCompra oc
+                JOIN saOrdenCompraReng r ON oc.doc_num = r.doc_num
+                WHERE oc.fec_emis BETWEEN :fi AND :ff
+                  AND ISNULL(oc.anulado, 0) = 0
+                GROUP BY r.co_art
+            """
+            rows2 = ext_conn.execute(sa.text(sql2), {"fi": fecha_ini, "ff": fecha_fin}).fetchall()
+            results = [{"co_art": str(r.co_art).strip(), "cant_comprada": float(r.cant_comprada)} for r in rows2]
+        except Exception as e2:
+            log.error(f"Error fallback compras MP: {e2}")
+    
+    return results
+
+
+def calculate_mp_balance(demand: list, purchases: list) -> list:
+    """
+    Cruza demanda vs compras y calcula balance.
+    Retorna lista ordenada por déficit (más críticos primero).
+    """
+    purchases_map = {p["co_art"]: p["cant_comprada"] for p in purchases}
+    
+    balance = []
+    for d in demand:
+        code = d["co_art_mp"]
+        requerido = d["cantidad_requerida"]
+        comprado = purchases_map.get(code, 0.0)
+        deficit = max(0.0, requerido - comprado)
+        cobertura_pct = min(100.0, (comprado / requerido * 100) if requerido > 0 else 100.0)
+        
+        # Semáforo
+        if cobertura_pct >= 80:
+            semaforo = "verde"
+        elif cobertura_pct >= 50:
+            semaforo = "amarillo"
+        else:
+            semaforo = "rojo"
+        
+        balance.append({
+            "co_art_mp": code,
+            "des_art_mp": d["des_art_mp"],
+            "unidad": d["unidad"],
+            "requerido": round(requerido, 2),
+            "comprado": round(comprado, 2),
+            "deficit": round(deficit, 2),
+            "cobertura_pct": round(cobertura_pct, 1),
+            "semaforo": semaforo
+        })
+    
+    # Ordenar: primero rojos, luego amarillos, luego verdes; dentro de cada grupo, mayor déficit primero
+    priority = {"rojo": 0, "amarillo": 1, "verde": 2}
+    balance.sort(key=lambda x: (priority[x["semaforo"]], -x["deficit"]))
+    return balance
+
+
+def format_mp_telegram_message(balance: list, fecha: str) -> str:
+    """Formatea el mensaje de alerta MP para Telegram en Markdown."""
+    criticos = [b for b in balance if b["semaforo"] == "rojo"]
+    alertas = [b for b in balance if b["semaforo"] == "amarillo"]
+    ok = [b for b in balance if b["semaforo"] == "verde"]
+    
+    lineas_criticos = ""
+    for b in criticos[:8]:
+        lineas_criticos += (
+            f"🔴 *{b['des_art_mp'][:35]}*\n"
+            f"   Req: {b['requerido']:,.0f} | Comp: {b['comprado']:,.0f} | "
+            f"Déficit: *{b['deficit']:,.0f}* ({b['cobertura_pct']}%)\n"
+        )
+    
+    lineas_alertas = ""
+    for b in alertas[:5]:
+        lineas_alertas += (
+            f"🟡 *{b['des_art_mp'][:35]}* — {b['cobertura_pct']}% cubierto\n"
+        )
+    
+    msg = (
+        f"🧮 *ANÁLISIS MP vs COMPRAS* — {fecha}\n\n"
+        f"📊 Resumen: {len(criticos)} críticos | {len(alertas)} en alerta | {len(ok)} OK\n\n"
+    )
+    
+    if criticos:
+        msg += f"*⚠️ CRÍTICOS ({len(criticos)}):*\n{lineas_criticos}\n"
+    
+    if alertas:
+        msg += f"*🟡 EN ALERTA ({len(alertas)}):*\n{lineas_alertas}\n"
+    
+    if not criticos and not alertas:
+        msg += "✅ *Todos los materiales tienen cobertura suficiente*\n"
+    
+    msg += "_Sistema de Producción — Delicias de Belén_"
+    return msg
+
+
+# ── Utilidad interna ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _detect_formula_table(conn) -> Optional[tuple]:
+    """Detecta qué tabla de fórmulas de producción está disponible."""
+    candidates = [
+        ("saFormulaArticulo", "saFormulaArticuloReng"),
+        ("saArticuloComp", "saArticuloCompReng"),
+    ]
+    for head, reng in candidates:
+        try:
+            conn.execute(sa.text(f"SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM {head}"))
+            return (head, reng)
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+    return None

+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+from sqlalchemy import func
+from ..models import ProductionReport, AuditLog, ProductionPlanning, AIFunctionality, AIParameter
+import datetime
+
+class RecommendationEngine:
+    def __init__(self, db: Session):
+        self.db = db
+
+    def analyze_and_recommend(self):
+        recommendations = []
+        
+        # 1. WASTE ANALYSIS (Optimization)
+        # Check average waste percentage
+        # Formula: sum(mp_waste_kg) / sum(kg_produced)
+        
+        waste_stats = self.db.query(
+            func.sum(ProductionReport.mp_waste_kg),
+            func.sum(ProductionReport.kg_produced)
+        ).filter(ProductionReport.kg_produced > 0).first()
+        
+        if waste_stats and waste_stats[1] and waste_stats[1] > 0:
+            total_waste = waste_stats[0] or 0
+            total_prod = waste_stats[1]
+            waste_ratio = total_waste / total_prod
+            
+            if waste_ratio > 0.05: # > 5% Waste
+                recommendations.append(
+                    f"⚠️ **Optimización**: El desperdicio promedio es del {waste_ratio:.1%}. "
+                    f"Se recomienda ajustar el parámetro 'tolerance_threshold' en el módulo Audit o revisar fórmulas en carmal_m."
+                )
+        
+        # 2. AUDIT FREQUENCY (Audit)
+        # Check if there are many open audit logs
+        open_issues = self.db.query(func.count(AuditLog.id)).filter(AuditLog.status == "Open").scalar()
+        if open_issues > 10:
+             recommendations.append(
+                f"🛡️ **Auditoría**: Hay {open_issues} incidencias abiertas. "
+                f"Se recomienda activar el módulo 'Predictive' para detectar anomalías antes de que ocurran."
+             )
+
+        # 3. PLANNING DELAYS (Predictive)
+        # Check expired planning orders that are still pending
+        today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+        delayed_orders = self.db.query(func.count(ProductionPlanning.id)).filter(
+            ProductionPlanning.status == "Pending",
+            ProductionPlanning.date < today
+        ).scalar()
+        
+        if delayed_orders > 0:
+             recommendations.append(
+                f"🛑 **Planificación**: Hay {delayed_orders} órdenes atrasadas. "
+                "La IA sugiere priorizar las órdenes con menor 'units_pending'."
+             )
+
+        # 4. CONFIGURATION CHECK
+        # Check if basic modules are active
+        opt_mod = self.db.query(AIFunctionality).filter(AIFunctionality.name == "Optimization").first()
+        if opt_mod and not opt_mod.is_active:
+             recommendations.append(
+                 "💡 **Configuración**: El módulo 'Optimization' está desactivado. Actívelo para permitir el análisis automático de mermas."
+             )
+
+        if not recommendations:
+            recommendations.append("✅ **Estado Óptimo**: No se detectaron anomalías graves en los datos recientes.")
+            
+        return recommendations
+
+def get_ai_recommendations(db: Session):
+    engine = RecommendationEngine(db)
+    return engine.analyze_and_recommend()

+from sqlalchemy import text
+from app.external_db import engine_a
+
+class StockSolver:
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_diagnostics():
+        issues = []
+        try:
+            with engine_a.connect() as conn:
+                # 1. Check for Negative Stock / Overdraws
+                # Logic: Where exits > entry quantity (approximate check via negative stock_actual, 
+                # but better to check inconsistent balance if stock_actual is trusted or calc it)
+                # For this solver, we focus on what we fixed: Negative Stock Actual
+                
+                q_neg = text("""
+                    SELECT rowguid, co_art, numero_lote, stock_actual, cantidad
+                    FROM saLoteEntrada
+                    WHERE stock_actual < 0
+                """)
+                neg_rows = conn.execute(q_neg).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in neg_rows:
+                    issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "NEGATIVE_STOCK",
+                        "severity": "high",
+                        "title": f"Stock Negativo: {row.numero_lote}",
+                        "description": f"El lote {row.numero_lote} ({row.co_art}) tiene stock negativo de {row.stock_actual:.2f}.",
+                        "meta": {"current_stock": float(row.stock_actual), "initial_qty": float(row.cantidad)}
+                    })
+
+                # 2. Check for Warehouse Mismatch (Line vs Entry)
+                # Logic: saLoteSalida.rowguid_reng -> saTrasladoReng (no alma) -> saTraslado.alm_orig
+                # Actually, simpler check: saLoteSalida.co_alma != saLoteEntrada.co_alma
+                # Limiting to recent issues or active ones?
+                
+                q_mismatch = text("""
+                    SELECT TOP 20 LS.rowguid, LS.numero_lote, LS.co_alma as salida_alma, LE.co_alma as entrada_alma, LS.co_art
+                    FROM saLoteSalida LS
+                    JOIN saLoteEntrada LE ON LS.Rowguid_Lote = LE.rowguid
+                    WHERE LS.co_alma != LE.co_alma
+                """)
+                mis_rows = conn.execute(q_mismatch).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in mis_rows:
+                    issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "WAREHOUSE_MISMATCH",
+                        "severity": "medium",
+                        "title": f"Conflicto Almacén: {row.numero_lote}",
+                        "description": f"Salida desde '{row.salida_alma}' pero el lote pertenece a '{row.entrada_alma}'.",
+                        "meta": {"correct_alma": row.entrada_alma}
+                    })
+
+                # 3. Check for Stuck in Warehouse 99 (P1-99 )
+                # ... (Existing logic) ...
+                
+                # 4. Check for Customer Return Inconsistencies (Supervisor Belén)
+                # Rule A: Validate Header Math (Total = Bruto + Imp)
+                # The user specifically reported cases where Total = Subtotal (ignoring Tax)
+                # Filtered by Current Month to reduce noise
+                q_ret_header = text("""
+                    SELECT doc_num, rowguid, total_neto, total_bruto, monto_imp, co_cli, co_mone
+                    FROM saDevolucionCliente
+                    WHERE anulado = 0
+                    AND MONTH(fec_emis) = MONTH(GETDATE()) 
+                    AND YEAR(fec_emis) = YEAR(GETDATE())
+                    AND ABS(total_neto - (total_bruto + monto_imp)) > 0.1
+                """)
+                rows_bad_header = conn.execute(q_ret_header).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in rows_bad_header:
+                    diff = float(row.total_neto - (row.total_bruto + row.monto_imp))
+                    mone = row.co_mone.strip() if row.co_mone else ""
+                    issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "RETURN_MATH_ERROR",
+                        "severity": "critical",
+                        "title": f"Error Matemático en Devolución: {row.doc_num}",
+                        "description": f"El Total Neto ({row.total_neto:,.2f} {mone}) no coincide con Subtotal + Impuestos. Diferencia: {diff:,.2f} {mone}.",
+                        "meta": {"diff": diff, "mone": mone}
+                    })
+
+                # Rule B: Line Totals vs Header Totals
+                # Compare Header Total Neto vs Sum(Line Net + Line Tax)
+                q_ret_lines = text("""
+                    SELECT H.doc_num, H.co_cli, H.total_neto, H.total_bruto, H.monto_imp,
+                           SUM(L.reng_neto) as sum_neto, SUM(L.monto_imp) as sum_imp,
+                           H.rowguid, MAX(H.co_mone) as co_mone
+                    FROM saDevolucionCliente H
+                    JOIN saDevolucionClienteReng L ON H.doc_num = L.doc_num
+                    WHERE H.anulado = 0
+                    AND MONTH(H.fec_emis) = MONTH(GETDATE()) 
+                    AND YEAR(H.fec_emis) = YEAR(GETDATE())
+                    GROUP BY H.doc_num, H.co_cli, H.total_neto, H.total_bruto, H.monto_imp, H.rowguid
+                    HAVING ABS(H.total_neto - (SUM(L.reng_neto) + SUM(L.monto_imp))) > 0.1
+                """)
+                bad_lines = conn.execute(q_ret_lines).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in bad_lines:
+                     # Avoid dupes
+                     # if row.doc_num in [x['title'] for x in issues]: continue
+                     
+                     real_total = row.sum_neto + row.sum_imp
+                     diff = float(row.total_neto - real_total)
+                     mone = row.co_mone.strip() if row.co_mone else ""
+                     
+                     issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "RETURN_LINE_MISMATCH",
+                        "severity": "critical",
+                        "title": f"Diferencia Renglones Devolución: {row.doc_num}",
+                        "description": f"Cabecera ({row.total_neto:,.2f} {mone}) difiere de la Suma de Renglones ({real_total:,.2f} {mone}). Diferencia: {diff:,.2f} {mone}",
+                        "meta": {"diff": diff, "real_total": float(real_total), "mone": mone}
+                    })
+
+
+                # Rule C: Return vs Credit Note (Monto Validation)
+                # Strategy: Find recent returns and try to find matching N/C
+                q_ret_nc = text("""
+                    SELECT top 50 H.doc_num, H.co_cli, H.total_neto, H.fec_emis, H.rowguid, H.co_mone
+                    FROM saDevolucionCliente H
+                    WHERE H.anulado = 0 AND H.status = '0' 
+                    AND MONTH(H.fec_emis) = MONTH(GETDATE()) 
+                    AND YEAR(H.fec_emis) = YEAR(GETDATE())
+                    ORDER BY H.fec_emis DESC
+                """)
+                recent_returns = conn.execute(q_ret_nc).fetchall()
+                
+                for ret in recent_returns:
+                    # Look for N/C for this Client on the same day (or close?)
+                    # Let's search by Date and Client first
+                    q_nc_candidates = text("""
+                        SELECT rowguid, nro_doc, total_neto, doc_orig, nro_orig
+                        FROM saDocumentoVenta 
+                        WHERE co_tipo_doc = 'N/CR' 
+                        AND co_cli = :cli 
+                        AND CAST(fec_emis AS DATE) = CAST(:date AS DATE)
+                    """)
+                    candidates = conn.execute(q_nc_candidates, {
+                        "cli": ret.co_cli, 
+                        "date": ret.fec_emis
+                    }).fetchall()
+                    
+                    match_found = False
+                    best_match = None
+                    
+                    for nc in candidates:
+                        # Check logic:
+                        # 1. Exact Amount Match
+                        if abs(nc.total_neto - ret.total_neto) < 0.1:
+                            match_found = True
+                            break
+                        # 2. Origin Match (if exists)
+                        if nc.nro_orig and nc.nro_orig.strip() == ret.doc_num.strip():
+                            match_found = True
+                            best_match = nc

+                                "meta": {}

+                # Check saLoteSalida

+                # Rule E: Confirmed Transfers Without Movement (Supervisor Belén)

+                    SELECT TOP 50 T.tras_num, T.fecha, TR.co_art, TR.total_art, TR.rowguid

+                    JOIN saTrasladoReng TR ON T.tras_num = TR.tras_num

+                    AND NOT EXISTS (

+                for row in res_tras:
+                    issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "TRANSFER_WITHOUT_MOVEMENT",
+                        "severity": "critical",

+                        "meta": {"art": row.co_art.strip(), "qty": float(row.total_art)}
+                    })

+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"Solver Error: {e}")

+    @staticmethod
+    def fix_issue(issue_id, issue_type):
+        try:
+            with engine_a.connect() as conn:
+                trans = conn.begin()
+                
+                if issue_type == "NEGATIVE_STOCK":
+                    # ... (Existing logic) ...

+                    q_check = text("SELECT co_art, numero_lote FROM saLoteEntrada WHERE rowguid = :guid")

+                    
+                    if not row:
+                        return {"success": False, "message": "Registro no encontrado"}
+                        
+                    # Calculate exits
+                    q_calc = text("""
+                        SELECT ISNULL(SUM(cantidad), 0) 
+                        FROM saLoteSalida 
+                        WHERE Rowguid_Lote = :guid
+                    """)
+                    total_exits = conn.execute(q_calc, {"guid": issue_id}).scalar()
+                    
+                    # Update
+                    q_upd = text("""
+                        UPDATE saLoteEntrada 
+                        SET cantidad = :new_qty, stock_actual = 0 
+                        WHERE rowguid = :guid
+                    """)
+                    conn.execute(q_upd, {"new_qty": total_exits, "guid": issue_id})
+                    
+                    trans.commit()
+                    return {"success": True, "message": f"Stock corregido. Nueva cantidad base: {total_exits}"}
+
+                elif issue_type == "WAREHOUSE_MISMATCH":
+                    # ... (Existing logic) ...

+                        SELECT LE.co_alma 
+                        FROM saLoteEntrada LE
+                        JOIN saLoteSalida LS ON LE.rowguid = LS.Rowguid_Lote
+                        WHERE LS.rowguid = :guid
+                    """)
+                    correct_alma = conn.execute(q_correct, {"guid": issue_id}).scalar()
+                    
+                    if not correct_alma:
+                        return {"success": False, "message": "No se pudo determinar el almacén correcto"}
+                        
+                    q_fix = text("UPDATE saLoteSalida SET co_alma = :alma WHERE rowguid = :guid")
+                    conn.execute(q_fix, {"alma": correct_alma, "guid": issue_id})
+                    
+                    trans.commit()
+                    return {"success": True, "message": f"Almacén de salida actualizado a '{correct_alma}'"}
+
+                elif issue_type == "STUCK_IN_99_OUT":

+                    # Or saAjusteReng -> saAjuste

+                    elif tipo == 'AJU':

+                        return {"success": False, "message": "No se pudo determinar el almacén correcto del documento padre"}

+    async function loadAlerts() {
+        addMessage("🔍 Buscando alertas de análisis de inteligencia...", 'user');
+        showTypingInfo();
+
+        try {

+                let badgeClass = 'badge-ok';
+                let icon = '✅';

+                    badgeClass = 'badge-critical';
+                    icon = '⚠️';
+                } else if (alert.status === 'WARNING' || alert.severity === 'medium') {
+                    badgeClass = 'badge-warning';
+                    icon = '🔸';

+                    <div class="alert-client">${alert.client || 'Cliente Desconocido'}</div>

+                    <div class="alert-refs">

+    async function fixIssue(id, type, btn) {
+        const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Procesando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.style.opacity = 0.7;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/fix', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify({ id, type })
+            });
+
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                btn.innerHTML = '✅ Corregido';
+                btn.style.background = '#22c55e';
+                setTimeout(() => { refreshAIDiagnostics(); }, 1500);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + result.detail);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+                btn.style.opacity = 1;
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de red");
+            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }

+    function switchTab(tabId) {
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl1').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl2').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent1').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('tabContent2').style.display = 'none';
+
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl' + tabId).classList.add('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent' + tabId).style.display = 'block';
+    }
+
+    function toggleRibbon() {
+        const isActive = document.getElementById('inputActive').checked;
+        const ribbon = document.getElementById('activeRibbon');
+        if (isActive) {
+            ribbon.classList.add('active');
+            ribbon.style.background = '#28a745';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Activo';
+        } else {
+            ribbon.classList.add('active');
+            ribbon.style.background = '#6c757d';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Archivado / Inactivo';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadConfig() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/automation-admin/api/config');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            document.getElementById('inputEmails').value = data.emails;
+            document.getElementById('inputCron').value = data.cron_schedule;
+            document.getElementById('inputActive').checked = data.is_active;
+            toggleRibbon();
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error cargando la configuración. Servidor inaccesible.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function saveConfig() {
+        showToast('Guardando...');
+        const payload = {
+            emails: document.getElementById('inputEmails').value.trim(),
+            cron_schedule: document.getElementById('inputCron').value.trim(),
+            is_active: document.getElementById('inputActive').checked
+        };
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/automation-admin/api/config', {
+                method: 'PUT',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (res.ok) {
+                if (data.warning) {
+                    showToast('Guardado. Alerta: ' + data.warning);
+                } else {
+                    showToast('Configuración guardada exitosamente.');
+                }
+            } else {
+                showToast('Error al guardar en base de datos.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error de red al intentar guardar.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function runNow() {
+        switchTab(1); // switch to console tab
+        if (!confirm('¿Desea despachar el agente bot manualmente ahora mismo? Toma algunos minutos.')) return;
+        showToast('Iniciando secuencias del agente bot. No recargue.');
+
+        const logger = document.getElementById('consoleLog');
+        logger.textContent = "> Inicializando conexión SSH y localizando entorno OpenClaw...\n> Despachando Prompt...\n> Esperando respuesta remota y ejecución visual...\n\n";
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/automation-admin/api/run-now', { method: 'POST' });
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                showToast('Secuencia finalizada con éxito.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- TERMINADO CORRECTAMENTE ---\n\n" + data.output;
+            } else {
+                const err = await res.json();
+                showToast('Ocurrió un error en la automatización.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- ERROR ---\n\n" + (err.detail || 'Fallo en la ejecución remota.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Time-out o error de enlace.');
+            logger.textContent += "--- ENLACE CORTADO ---\nNetwork Timeout o error de conexión.";
+        }
+    }
+
+    function showToast(msg, dur = 3000) {
+        const t = document.getElementById('toast');
+        t.innerText = msg;
+        t.style.display = 'block';
+        clearTimeout(window._toastTimer);
+        window._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', dur);
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+    async function loadMRP() {
+        const m = document.getElementById('selMonth').value;
+        const y = document.getElementById('inpYear').value;
+
+        document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'block';
+        document.getElementById('mrpTable').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/purchasing/api/mrp/alerts?month=${m}&year=${y}`);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Error interno al calcular MRP");
+
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (data.data.length === 0) {
+                alert(data.message || "No existen proyecciones de venta almacenadas para explotar en este mes.");
+                document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'none';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            renderTable(data.data);
+
+            document.getElementById('mrpTable').style.display = 'table';
+            document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'grid';
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Fallo la conexión con MRP / Profit Plus.");
+        } finally {
+            document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderTable(rows) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('mrpBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        let cRed = 0, cYellow = 0, cGreen = 0;
+
+        rows.forEach((row) => {
+            let badgeHtml = '';
+            let bgStyle = '';
+
+            if (row.status === 'red') {
+                cRed++;
+                badgeHtml = '<span style="display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#ef4444; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6);"></span>';
+                bgStyle = 'background: #fef2f2;';
+            } else if (row.status === 'yellow') {
+                cYellow++;
+                badgeHtml = '<span style="display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#f59e0b;"></span>';
+            } else {
+                cGreen++;
+                badgeHtml = '<span style="display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#10b981;"></span>';
+            }
+
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.style.cssText = `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); transition: background 0.2s; ${bgStyle}`;
+            tr.onmouseover = () => { if (!bgStyle) tr.style.background = '#f8fafc'; };
+            tr.onmouseout = () => { if (!bgStyle) tr.style.background = 'transparent'; };
+
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center;">${badgeHtml}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight:600; color:#475569;">${row.co_art}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500;">${row.art_des}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a;">${row.demand.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #3b82f6;">${row.stock.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; color: ${row.shortage > 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#cbd5e1'}; font-size:1.05rem;">
+                    ${row.shortage > 0 ? row.shortage.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : '-'}
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem; color:#94a3b8; font-weight:600;">${row.uom}</td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+
+        // Animated counter effect (optional polish)
+        document.getElementById('statRed').innerText = cRed;
+        document.getElementById('statYellow').innerText = cYellow;
+        document.getElementById('statGreen').innerText = cGreen;
+    }
+
+    async function syncProfit() {
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnSync');
+        const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
+
+        if (!confirm("¿Estás seguro de querer forzar una sincronización masiva desde Profit Plus? Esto actualizará Fórmulas, Artículos y Stock.")) return;
+
+        try {
+            btn.innerHTML = '<svg class="animate-spin" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="animation: spin 1s linear infinite;"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56"></path></svg> Sincronizando... (1m)';
+            btn.disabled = true;
+
+            const res = await fetch("/api/mrp/sync", {
+                method: "POST"
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || "Error interno");
+
+            alert(data.message);
+            // Reload the table since stock probably changed
+            loadMRP();
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("No se pudo sincronizar: " + e.message);
+        } finally {
+            btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+    let allData = [];

+    // ── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        const hoy = new Date();
+        const primerDia = new Date(hoy.getFullYear(), hoy.getMonth(), 1);
+        document.getElementById('fechaIni').value = primerDia.toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        document.getElementById('fechaFin').value = hoy.toISOString().split('T')[0];

+    async function loadDashboard() {
+        const fi = document.getElementById('fechaIni').value;
+        const ff = document.getElementById('fechaFin').value;
+        const ventas = document.getElementById('chkVentas').checked;
+        const pedidos = document.getElementById('chkPedidos').checked;
+        const cotizaciones = document.getElementById('chkCotizaciones').checked;
+
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnRefresh');
+        btn.textContent = '⏳ Cargando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+
+        setLoadingState(true);
+
+        try {
+            const params = new URLSearchParams({
+                fecha_ini: fi,
+                fecha_fin: ff,
+                include_ventas: ventas,
+                include_pedidos: pedidos,
+                include_cotizaciones: cotizaciones
+            });
+            const res = await fetch(`/compras-mp/api/dashboard?${params}`);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (data.errors && Object.keys(data.errors).length > 0) {
+                console.warn('Errores del backend:', data.errors);
+            }
+
+            allData = data.balance || [];
+            renderKpis(data.kpis || {});
+            renderTable(allData);
+            renderChart(allData.slice(0, 10));
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            showToast('❌ Error al cargar datos: ' + e.message, 5000);
+        } finally {
+            btn.textContent = '🔄 Actualizar';
+            btn.disabled = false;
+            setLoadingState(false);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderKpis(k) {
+        document.getElementById('kpiTotal').textContent = k.total_articulos ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiCriticos').textContent = k.criticos ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiAlertas').textContent = k.alertas ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiOk').textContent = k.ok ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiCobertura').textContent = (k.cobertura_global_pct ?? '—') + '%';
+        document.getElementById('kpiDeficit').textContent = formatNum(k.total_deficit ?? 0);
+    }
+
+    function renderTable(data) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('tbodyMP');
+        if (!data.length) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:#94a3b8;">
+                <div style="font-size:2rem;">📦</div>Sin datos para el período seleccionado.<br>
+                <small>Verifique que existen tablas de fórmulas en Profit Plus</small></td></tr>`;
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const filtroText = document.getElementById('filtroTabla').value.toLowerCase();
+        const filtroSem = document.getElementById('filtroSemaforo').value;
+
+        const filtered = data.filter(r => {
+            const matchText = !filtroText || r.des_art_mp.toLowerCase().includes(filtroText) || r.co_art_mp.toLowerCase().includes(filtroText);
+            const matchSem = !filtroSem || r.semaforo === filtroSem;
+            return matchText && matchSem;
+        });

+        tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(r => {
+            const emoji = r.semaforo === 'rojo' ? '🔴' : r.semaforo === 'amarillo' ? '🟡' : '🟢';
+            const pctColor = r.semaforo === 'rojo' ? '#ef4444' : r.semaforo === 'amarillo' ? '#f59e0b' : '#10b981';
+            const rowBg = r.semaforo === 'rojo' ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.04)' : r.semaforo === 'amarillo' ? 'rgba(245,158,11,0.04)' : '';
+            return `
+                <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9; background: ${rowBg};" onmouseover="this.style.background='#f8fafc'" onmouseout="this.style.background='${rowBg}'">
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; color:#1e293b;">
+                        <div style="font-weight:600; font-size:0.82rem;">${escHtml(r.des_art_mp)}</div>
+                        <div style="font-size:0.72rem; color:#94a3b8;">${escHtml(r.co_art_mp)}</div>
+                    </td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:center; color:#64748b;">${escHtml(r.unidad)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:right; color:#374151;">${formatNum(r.requerido)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:right; color:#374151;">${formatNum(r.comprado)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:right; color:${r.deficit > 0 ? '#ef4444' : '#10b981'}; font-weight:${r.deficit > 0 ? '700' : '400'};">${formatNum(r.deficit)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:center;">
+                        <div style="background:#f1f5f9; border-radius:20px; height:7px; overflow:hidden; width:80px; margin: 0 auto 3px;">
+                            <div style="height:100%; width:${Math.min(r.cobertura_pct, 100)}%; background:${pctColor}; border-radius:20px;"></div>
+                        </div>
+                        <span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:${pctColor}; font-weight:700;">${r.cobertura_pct}%</span>
+                    </td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:center; font-size:1.1rem;">${emoji}</td>
+                </tr>
+            `;
+        }).join('');
+
+        if (!filtered.length) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:20px; color:#94a3b8;">Sin resultados para el filtro aplicado</td></tr>`;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function filterTable() {
+        renderTable(allData);

+
+    function renderChart(data) {
+        const ctx = document.getElementById('chartBar').getContext('2d');
+        if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy();
+
+        const labels = data.map(d => d.des_art_mp.length > 30 ? d.des_art_mp.substring(0, 30) + '…' : d.des_art_mp);
+        const requerido = data.map(d => d.requerido);
+        const comprado = data.map(d => d.comprado);
+
+        chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
+            type: 'bar',
+            data: {
+                labels,
+                datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Requerido', data: requerido, backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.75)', borderRadius: 3 },
+                    { label: 'Comprado', data: comprado, backgroundColor: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.75)', borderRadius: 3 }
+                ]
+            },
+            options: {
+                responsive: true,
+                maintainAspectRatio: false,
+                plugins: {
+                    legend: { position: 'top', labels: { font: { size: 11 } } },
+                    tooltip: {
+                        callbacks: {
+                            label: ctx => ` ${ctx.dataset.label}: ${Number(ctx.parsed.y).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 0 })}`
+                        }
+                    }
+                },
+                scales: {
+                    x: { ticks: { font: { size: 10 }, maxRotation: 35 } },
+                    y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { font: { size: 10 } } }
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    async function triggerAlert() {
+        if (!confirm('¿Enviar alerta MP a todos los suscriptores Telegram activos?')) return;
+        showToast('📡 Enviando alertas...', 3000);
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/compras-mp/api/send-alert-now', { method: 'POST' });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (data.success) {
+                showToast(`✅ ${data.result.sent} alerta(s) enviada(s) — ${data.result.errors} error(es)`, 5000);
+            } else {
+                showToast('❌ Error: ' + (data.error || 'Desconocido'), 7000);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('❌ Error de conexión', 5000);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

+        }
+    }
+
+    function formatNum(n) {
+        return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
+    }
+
+    function escHtml(str) {
+        return String(str || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
+    }
+
+    function showToast(msg, dur = 3000) {
+        const t = document.getElementById('toast');
+        t.textContent = msg;
+        t.style.display = 'block';
+        setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', dur);
+    }

+    async function refreshAIDiagnostics() {
+        const container = document.getElementById('ai-supervisor-section');
+        const list = document.getElementById('ai-issues-container');
+        const cleanMsg = document.getElementById('ai-clean-state');
+
+        // Show section
+        container.style.display = 'block';
+        list.innerHTML = '<div style="opacity: 0.7;">Analizando base de datos...</div>';
+        cleanMsg.style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/diagnose');
+            const issues = await res.json();
+
+            list.innerHTML = '';
+
+            if (issues.length === 0) {
+                cleanMsg.style.display = 'flex';
+            } else {
+                issues.forEach(issue => {
+                    const div = document.createElement('div');
+                    div.style.cssText = `
+                        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
+                        color: #1e293b;
+                        padding: 1rem;
+                        border-radius: 8px;
+                        display: flex;
+                        justify-content: space-between;
+                        align-items: center;
+                        gap: 1rem;
+                        border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;
+                    `;
+
+                    div.innerHTML = `
+                        <div>
+                            <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.95rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
+                                ⚠️ ${issue.title}
+                                <span style="background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;">${issue.severity}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">${issue.description}</div>
+                        </div>
+                        <button onclick="fixIssue('${issue.id}', '${issue.type}', this)" 
+                            style="background: #dc2626; color: white; border: none; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.2s;">
+                            ✨ Corregir con AI
+                        </button>
+                    `;
+                    list.appendChild(div);
+                });
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color: #fca5a5;">Error de conexión con el servicio AI.</div>';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function fixIssue(id, type, btn) {
+        const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Procesando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.style.opacity = 0.7;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/fix', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify({ id, type })
+            });
+
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                btn.innerHTML = '✅ Corregido';
+                btn.style.background = '#22c55e';
+                setTimeout(() => {
+                    // Refresh checks
+                    refreshAIDiagnostics();
+                }, 1500);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + result.detail);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+                btn.style.opacity = 1;
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de red");
+            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+

+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        refreshAIDiagnostics();
+    });

+    // --- Annulment Logic ---
+    async function annulDispatch(id, ref) {
+        if (!confirm(`⚠️ ALERTA ⚠️\n\n¿Estás seguro de que deseas ANULAR la guía ${ref}?\n\n- Esta acción no se puede deshacer.\n- Todas las facturas o notas contenidas volverán a estar disponibles de inmediato.\n\nEscribe "ANULAR" para confirmar:`)) return;

+            const res = await fetch(`/logistics/api/dispatch/${id}/annul`, {
+                method: 'POST'
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                alert(data.message);
+                location.reload(); // Reload to refresh list and annulled states
+            } else {
+                alert(data.detail || "Error anulando la guía.");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión al anular.");
+        }

+<script>
+    let currentDocType = 'invoice';
+    let searchDebounce;
+    let selectedIndex = -1;
+
+    // Set default date to today
+    document.getElementById('receptionDate').valueAsDate = new Date();
+
+    function toggleDocType() {
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnDocToggle');
+        const lbl = document.getElementById('lblTitle');
+        const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
+
+        if (currentDocType === 'invoice') {
+            currentDocType = 'delivery_note';
+            btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Factura';
+            lbl.innerText = 'Buscar Nota de Entrega';
+            input.placeholder = 'Buscar Nota...';
+        } else {
+            currentDocType = 'invoice';
+            btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Nota de Entrega';
+            lbl.innerText = 'Buscar Factura';
+            input.placeholder = 'Buscar Factura...';
+        }
+
+        // Reset
+        input.value = '';
+        input.focus();
+        document.getElementById('detailsSection').style.display = 'none';
+        hideDropdown();
+    }
+
+    function hideDropdown() {
+        const dropdown = document.getElementById('resultsDropdown');
+        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
+        selectedIndex = -1;
+    }
+
+    function handleKeyDown(e) {
+        const dropdown = document.getElementById('resultsDropdown');
+        const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item');
+
+        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (dropdown.style.display === 'none' && document.getElementById('searchInput').value.length >= 2) {
+                handleInput(document.getElementById('searchInput').value);
+            }
+            selectedIndex = Math.min(selectedIndex + 1, items.length - 1);
+            // Skip disabled items
+            while (selectedIndex < items.length - 1 && items[selectedIndex].style.cursor === 'not-allowed') {
+                selectedIndex++;
+            }
+            updateSelection(items);
+        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            selectedIndex = Math.max(selectedIndex - 1, 0);
+            // Skip disabled items
+            while (selectedIndex > 0 && items[selectedIndex].style.cursor === 'not-allowed') {
+                selectedIndex--;
+            }
+            updateSelection(items);
+        } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            if (dropdown.style.display !== 'none' && selectedIndex > -1 && items[selectedIndex]) {
+                e.preventDefault();
+                if (items[selectedIndex].style.cursor !== 'not-allowed') {
+                    items[selectedIndex].click();
+                }
+            } else {
+                searchDocument();
+            }
+        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
+            hideDropdown();
+        }
+    }
+
+    function updateSelection(items) {
+        items.forEach((item, index) => {
+            if (index === selectedIndex) {
+                item.classList.add('selected');
+                item.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
+            } else {
+                item.classList.remove('selected');
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function handleInput(val) {
+        const dropdown = document.getElementById('resultsDropdown');
+
+        if (val.length < 2) {
+            hideDropdown();
+            return;
+        }
+
+        clearTimeout(searchDebounce);
+        searchDebounce = setTimeout(async () => {
+            try {
+                // Unified search endpoint with current type filter
+                const res = await fetch(`/logistics/api/external/documents/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(val)}&doc_type=${currentDocType}`);
+                if (res.ok) {
+                    const data = await res.json();
+                    dropdown.innerHTML = '';
+
+                    if (data.length === 0) {
+                        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
+                        return;
+                    }
+
+                    data.forEach((item, index) => {
+                        // Populate custom dropdown for rich details
+                        const div = document.createElement('div');
+                        div.className = 'dropdown-item';
+                        div.style.padding = '0.75rem 1rem';
+                        div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #f1f5f9';
+                        div.style.display = 'flex';
+                        div.style.flexDirection = 'column';
+                        div.style.gap = '0.25rem';
+                        div.style.transition = 'background 0.2s';
+
+                        const typeLabel = item.doc_type === 'invoice' ? 'FACT' : 'NOTA';
+                        const typeColor = item.doc_type === 'invoice' ? '#3b82f6' : '#8b5cf6';
+
+                        let warningHtml = '';
+                        if (item.has_campo5) {
+                            warningHtml = `<div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #ef4444; background: #fef2f2; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block; margin-top: 4px;">
+                                ⚠️ El documento ya posee una fecha registrada (${item.campo5_val}), por favor valide.
+                            </div>`;
+                            div.style.opacity = '0.6';
+                            div.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
+                        } else {
+                            div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                        }
+
+                        div.innerHTML = `
+                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%;">
+                                <div>
+                                    <span style="font-weight: 600; color: ${typeColor}; margin-right: 0.5rem;">${typeLabel} ${item.doc_num}</span>
+                                    <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-main);">${item.client}</span>
+                                </div>
+                                ${!item.has_campo5 ? `<span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 0.5;">ENTER</span>` : ''}
+                            </div>
+                            ${warningHtml}
+                        `;
+
+                        if (!item.has_campo5) {
+                            div.onclick = () => {
+                                document.getElementById('searchInput').value = item.display;
+                                hideDropdown();
+                                selectAndSearch(item.doc_num, item.doc_type);
+                            };
+
+                            div.onmouseover = () => {
+                                selectedIndex = index;
+                                updateSelection(dropdown.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item:not([style*="not-allowed"])'));
+                            };
+                        }
+
+                        dropdown.appendChild(div);
+                    });
+
+                    dropdown.style.display = 'block';
+                }
+            } catch (err) {
+                console.error("Autocomplete error", err);
+            }
+        }, 150); // Reduced debounce for snappier feel
+    }
+
+    // Trigger search after selecting from dropdown
+    async function selectAndSearch(docNum, docType) {
+        // We reuse the search logic but passing params directly
+        await performSearch(docNum, docType);
+    }
+
+    // Unified search logic
+    async function searchDocument() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
+        let displayVal = input.value.trim();
+        if (!displayVal) return;
+
+        // Attempt to parse number if it's in "TYPE NUM - CLIENT" format
+        let docNum = displayVal;
+        let docType = currentDocType;
+
+        if (displayVal.includes(' - ')) {
+            const parts = displayVal.split(' - ');
+            const left = parts[0].trim();
+            docNum = left.replace(/^(FACT:|NOTA:)\s*/, '');
+            docType = left.startsWith('NOTA:') ? 'delivery_note' : 'invoice';
+        }
+
+        await performSearch(docNum, docType);
+    }
+
+    async function performSearch(docNum, docType) {
+        const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
+        input.disabled = true;
+
+        try {
+            // Set visuals
+            currentDocType = docType;
+            const btn = document.getElementById('btnDocToggle');
+            const lbl = document.getElementById('lblTitle');
+
+            if (docType === 'delivery_note') {
+                btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Factura';
+                lbl.innerText = 'Nota de Entrega Detectada';
+            } else {
+                btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Nota de Entrega';
+                lbl.innerText = 'Factura Detectada';
+            }
+
+            const endpoint = docType === 'invoice'
+                ? `/logistics/api/external/invoice/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items/no-check`
+                : `/logistics/api/external/delivery_note/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items`;
+
+            const res = await fetch(endpoint);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
+                alert("Documento no encontrado o no tiene renglones pendientes.");
+                input.disabled = false;
+                return;
+            }
+
+            // Populate Details
+            const first = data[0];
+            document.getElementById('detClient').innerText = first.client_name || first.client || 'Desconocido';
+            document.getElementById('detDoc').innerText = `${docType === 'invoice' ? 'FACT' : 'NOTA'} ${docNum}`;
+
+            const amt = first.invoice_total || 0;
+            document.getElementById('detAmount').innerText = amt.toLocaleString('es-VE', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
+
+            // Prepare Form
+            document.getElementById('formDocType').value = docType;
+            document.getElementById('formDocNum').value = docNum;
+
+            // Show Section
+            document.getElementById('detailsSection').style.display = 'block';
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error consultando documento");
+        } finally {
+            input.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function submitUpdate(e) {
+        e.preventDefault();
+
+        if (!confirm("¿Está seguro de actualizar la fecha de recepción para este documento?")) return;
+
+        const form = document.getElementById('updateForm');
+        const formData = new FormData(form);
+        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.innerText = "Guardando...";
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/api/external/update-reception-date', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (result.status === 'success') {
+                alert("✅ Actualización Exitosa");
+                // Reset UI
+                document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
+                document.getElementById('detailsSection').style.display = 'none';
+                document.getElementById('searchInput').focus();
+            } else {
+                alert("❌ Error: " + (result.message || "Desconocido"));
+            }
+
+        } catch (err) {
+            console.error(err);
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        } finally {
+            btn.disabled = false;
+            btn.innerText = "💾 Guardar Fecha";
+        }
+    }
+</script>

+    // ── Chip helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+    function toggleRoleChip(chip) {
+        // If this role is the primary role, block extra selection
+        const primaryId = document.getElementById('primaryRoleSelect').value;
+        if (chip.dataset.roleId === primaryId) {
+            chip.style.outline = '2px solid #f59e0b';
+            setTimeout(() => chip.style.outline = '', 600);
+            return;
+        }
+        const isActive = chip.classList.contains('active');
+        if (isActive) {
+            chip.classList.remove('active');
+            chip.classList.add('inactive');
+            chip.querySelector('.chip-dot').style.background = '#94a3b8';
+        } else {
+            chip.classList.remove('inactive');
+            chip.classList.add('active');
+            chip.querySelector('.chip-dot').style.background = '#1d4ed8';
+        }
+        updateRolesSummary();
+    }
+
+    function updateChipHighlight() {
+        const primaryId = document.getElementById('primaryRoleSelect').value;
+        document.querySelectorAll('.role-chip').forEach(chip => {
+            if (chip.dataset.roleId === primaryId) {
+                chip.classList.remove('active', 'inactive');
+                chip.classList.add('primary-chip');
+                chip.querySelector('.chip-dot').style.background = '#7c3aed';
+            } else if (chip.classList.contains('primary-chip')) {
+                chip.classList.remove('primary-chip');
+                chip.classList.add('inactive');
+                chip.querySelector('.chip-dot').style.background = '#94a3b8';
+            }
+        });
+        updateRolesSummary();
+    }
+
+    function updateRolesSummary() {
+        const active = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.role-chip.active'));
+        const summary = document.getElementById('rolesSummary');
+        if (active.length === 0) {
+            summary.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#9ca3af;">Sin roles adicionales seleccionados</span>';
+        } else {
+            summary.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#374151; font-weight:500;">Adicionales activos:</span> ' +
+                active.map(c => `<span style="background:#eff6ff; color:#1d4ed8; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:10px; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600;">${c.dataset.roleName}</span>`).join(' ');
+        }
+    }
+
+    // ── Modal open/close ──────────────────────────────────────────
+    function openUserModal(userId, username, primaryRole, isActive, extraRolesStr) {
+        document.getElementById('modalUserId').value = userId;

+        } else {
+            lbl.textContent = 'Inactivo';
+            btn.textContent = 'Activar';
+            btn.style.cssText = 'background:#f0fdf4; color:#16a34a; border:1.5px solid #bbf7d0; padding:0.35rem 0.875rem; border-radius:20px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:0.78rem;';
+        }
+
+        // Primary role
+        document.getElementById('primaryRoleSelect').value = primaryRole;
+

+        document.querySelectorAll('.role-chip').forEach(chip => {
+            chip.classList.remove('active', 'primary-chip');

+    // ── Actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    async function changePassword() {
+        const userId = document.getElementById('modalUserId').value;
+        const pwd = document.getElementById('newPasswordInput').value.trim();
+        if (!pwd || pwd.length < 4) { alert('La contraseña debe tener al menos 4 caracteres.'); return; }
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('user_id', userId);
+        fd.append('new_password', pwd);
+        const res = await fetch('/maintenance/users/change-password', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+        const data = await res.json();
+        const msg = document.getElementById('pwdMsg');
+        msg.style.display = 'block';
+        if (data.status === 'ok') { msg.textContent = '✅ Contraseña actualizada.'; msg.style.color='#16a34a'; }
+        else { msg.textContent = '❌ ' + (data.detail || 'Error desconocido'); msg.style.color='#dc2626'; }
+        document.getElementById('newPasswordInput').value = '';
+    }
+
+    async function toggleActive() {
+        const userId = document.getElementById('modalUserId').value;
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('user_id', userId);
+        const res = await fetch('/maintenance/users/toggle-active', { method: 'POST', body: fd });

+            } else {

+            }
+            setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1000);
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function saveRoles() {
+        const userId   = document.getElementById('modalUserId').value;
+        const primary  = document.getElementById('primaryRoleSelect').value;
+        const extras   = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.role-chip.active'))
+                              .map(c => c.dataset.roleId)
+                              .filter(id => id !== primary)
+                              .join(',');
+
+        const btn = document.getElementById('saveRolesBtn');
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Guardando...';
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('user_id', userId);
+        fd.append('primary_role', primary);
+        fd.append('extra_role_ids', extras);
+
+        try {
+            const res  = await fetch('/maintenance/users/set-roles', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            const msg  = document.getElementById('rolesMsg');
+            msg.style.display = 'block';
+
+            if (data.status === 'ok') {
+                msg.innerHTML = '✅ Roles guardados correctamente.';
+                msg.style.color = '#16a34a';
+                setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1200);
+            } else {
+                msg.innerHTML = '❌ ' + (data.detail || 'Error al guardar');
+                msg.style.color = '#dc2626';
+                btn.disabled = false;
+                btn.innerHTML = '💾 Guardar Configuración de Roles';
+            }
+        } catch(err) {
+            const msg = document.getElementById('rolesMsg');
+            msg.style.display = 'block';
+            msg.innerHTML = '❌ Error de red: ' + err.message;
+            msg.style.color = '#dc2626';
+            btn.disabled = false;
+            btn.innerHTML = '💾 Guardar Configuración de Roles';
+        }
+    }

+    async function toggleAI(id, checkbox) {
+        const enabled = checkbox.checked;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('func_id', id);
+        formData.append('enabled', enabled);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/toggle', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (data.status !== 'success') {
+                alert('Error al cambiar estado');
+                checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert('Error de conexión');
+            checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+        }
+    }
+    async function sendAIChat() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
+        const history = document.getElementById('chatHistory');
+        const txt = input.value.trim();
+        if (!txt) return;
+
+        // User Message
+        history.innerHTML += `
+            <div style="align-self: flex-end; background: #8b5cf6; color: white; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 8px; max-width: 80%;">
+                ${txt}
+            </div>
+        `;
+        input.value = '';
+        history.scrollTop = history.scrollHeight;
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('message', txt);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/chat', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            // AI Response
+            history.innerHTML += `
+                <div style="align-self: flex-start; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 0; max-width: 80%;">
+                    ${data.response}
+                </div>
+            `;
+
+            // Auto-refresh if success
+            if (data.response.includes("exitosamente") || data.response.includes("agregado")) {
+                setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1500);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            history.innerHTML += `
+                <div style="align-self: flex-start; background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 0; max-width: 80%;">
+                    Error de conexión.
+                </div>
+            `;
+        }
+        history.scrollTop = history.scrollHeight;
+    }
