+{% block scripts %}
+<script>
+    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadConfig);
+
+    function switchTab(tabId) {
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl1').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl2').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent1').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('tabContent2').style.display = 'none';
+
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl' + tabId).classList.add('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent' + tabId).style.display = 'block';
+    }
+
+    function toggleRibbon() {
+        const isActive = document.getElementById('inputActive').checked;
+        const ribbon = document.getElementById('activeRibbon');
+        if (isActive) {
+            ribbon.classList.add('active');
+            ribbon.style.background = '#28a745';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Activo';
+        } else {
+            ribbon.style.background = '#6c757d';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Archivado / Inactivo';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadConfig() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/mismatch-admin/api/config');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            document.getElementById('inputEmails').value = data.emails;
+            document.getElementById('inputCron').value = data.cron_schedule;
+            document.getElementById('inputActive').checked = data.is_active;
+            toggleRibbon();
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error cargando la configuración. Servidor inaccesible.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function saveConfig() {
+        showToast('Guardando...');
+        const payload = {
+            emails: document.getElementById('inputEmails').value.trim(),
+            cron_schedule: document.getElementById('inputCron').value.trim(),
+            is_active: document.getElementById('inputActive').checked
+        };
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/mismatch-admin/api/config', {
+                method: 'PUT',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (res.ok) {
+                if (data.warning) {
+                    showToast('Guardado. Alerta: ' + data.warning);
+                } else {
+                    showToast('Configuración guardada exitosamente.');
+                }
+            } else {
+                showToast('Error al guardar en base de datos.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error de red al intentar guardar.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function runNow() {
+        switchTab(1); // switch to console tab
+        if (!confirm('¿Desea despachar el agente bot manualmente para buscar discrepancias ahora mismo? Toma algunos minutos.')) return;
+        showToast('Iniciando secuencias del agente bot. No recargue.');
+
+        const logger = document.getElementById('consoleLog');
+        logger.textContent = "> Inicializando conexión SSH e inyectando prompt de Mismatch...\n> Esperando respuesta remota y ejecución...\n\n";
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/mismatch-admin/api/run-now', { method: 'POST' });
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                showToast('Supervisión finalizada con éxito.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- TERMINADO CORRECTAMENTE ---\n\n" + data.output;
+            } else {
+                const err = await res.json();
+                showToast('Ocurrió un error en la automatización.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- ERROR ---\n\n" + (err.detail || 'Fallo en la ejecución remota.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Time-out o error de enlace.');
+            logger.textContent += "--- ENLACE CORTADO ---\nNetwork Timeout o error de conexión.";
+        }
+    }
+
+    function showToast(msg, dur = 3000) {
+        const t = document.getElementById('toast');
+        t.innerText = msg;
+        t.style.display = 'block';
+        clearTimeout(window._toastTimer);
+        window._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', dur);
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@latest/Sortable.min.js"></script>
+<script>
+    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
+        if (!document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.contains('collapsed')) {
+            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
+        }
+    });
+
+    const boardContainer = document.getElementById('board-container');
+    const boardId = "{{ board.id }}";
+    const projectId = "{{ project_id | default('') }}";
+
+    new Sortable(boardContainer, {
+        animation: 150,
+        ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
+        handle: '.list-header',
+        onEnd: async function (evt) {
+            if (evt.oldIndex === evt.newIndex) return;
+            const itemEl = evt.item;
+            const listId = itemEl.getAttribute('data-id');
+            const newIndex = evt.newIndex;
+            const lists = Array.from(boardContainer.children);
+            let prevOrder = 0.0, nextOrder = 0.0;
+            if (newIndex > 0) prevOrder = parseFloat(lists[newIndex - 1].getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+            if (newIndex < lists.length - 1) { 
+                const nextEl = lists[newIndex + 1];
+                if(nextEl && nextEl.hasAttribute('data-order')) nextOrder = parseFloat(nextEl.getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+            }
+            const formData = new URLSearchParams();
+            formData.append("prev_order", prevOrder);
+            formData.append("next_order", nextOrder);
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/lists/${listId}/move`, {
+                    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+                });
+                if(res.ok) {
+                    const data = await res.json();
+                    itemEl.setAttribute('data-order', data.new_order);
+                }
+            } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
+        }
+    });
+
+    function initCardSortable() {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.card-list').forEach(el => {
+            new Sortable(el, {
+                group: 'shared', 
+                animation: 150,
+                ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
+                onEnd: async function (evt) {
+                    const itemEl = evt.item;
+                    const cardId = itemEl.getAttribute('data-id');
+                    const newListId = evt.to.closest('.kanban-list').getAttribute('data-id');
+                    const newIndex = evt.newIndex;
+                    const cards = Array.from(evt.to.children);
+                    let prevOrder = 0.0, nextOrder = 0.0;
+                    if (newIndex > 0) prevOrder = parseFloat(cards[newIndex - 1].getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+                    if (newIndex < cards.length - 1) nextOrder = parseFloat(cards[newIndex + 1].getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+
+                    const formData = new URLSearchParams();
+                    formData.append("new_list_id", newListId);
+                    formData.append("prev_order", prevOrder);
+                    formData.append("next_order", nextOrder);
+                    try {
+                        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${cardId}/move`, {
+                            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+                        });
+                        if(res.ok) {
+                            const data = await res.json();
+                            itemEl.setAttribute('data-order', data.new_order);
+                        }
+                    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
+                }
+            });
+        });
+    }
+
+    initCardSortable();
+
+    async function addNewList(event) {
+        if(event) event.preventDefault();
+        const input = document.getElementById('newListInput');
+        const title = input.value.trim();
+        if(!title) return;
+        const formData = new URLSearchParams(); formData.append("title", title);
+        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/boards/${boardId}/lists`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+        });
+        if (res.ok) window.location.reload(); 
+    }
+
+    async function addNewCard(listId, formElement) {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        const input = formElement.querySelector('input');
+        const title = input.value.trim();
+        if(!title) return;
+        const formData = new URLSearchParams(); formData.append("title", title);
+        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/lists/${listId}/cards`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+        });
+        if (res.ok) window.location.reload(); 
+    }
+
+    function showAddCardForm(listId) {
+        document.getElementById('add-card-btn-' + listId).style.display = 'none';
+        const form = document.getElementById('add-card-form-' + listId);
+        form.style.display = 'block';
+        form.querySelector('input').focus();
+    }
+
+    // --- EXPERIENCIA DE USUARIO AVANZADA: MODAL DE TARJETA ---
+    let currentModalCardId = null;
+
+    async function openCardModal(cardId) {
+        currentModalCardId = cardId;
+        document.getElementById('cardModal').style.display = 'flex';
+        // Cleanup old UI
+        document.getElementById('modalCardTitle').value = 'Cargando...';
+        document.getElementById('modalCardDesc').value = '';
+        document.getElementById('modalChecklists').innerHTML = '';
+        document.getElementById('modalMembersText').innerHTML = '';
+        document.getElementById('modalCardStatus').value = 'Por Hacer';
+        
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${cardId}`);
+            if(res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                document.getElementById('modalCardTitle').value = data.title;
+                document.getElementById('modalCardDesc').value = data.description;
+                document.getElementById('modalDueDate').value = data.due_date;
+                document.getElementById('modalCardStatus').value = data.status || 'Por Hacer';
+                
+                // Render Checklists
+                document.getElementById('modalChecklists').innerHTML = data.checklists.map(cl => `
+                    <div style="margin-top: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 10px;">
+                        <h4 style="margin: 0 0 10px 0; color: #334155; font-size:1rem;">✅ ${cl.title}</h4>
+                        <div style="padding-left: 25px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
+                            ${cl.items.map(it => `
+                                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:5px;">
+                                    <input type="checkbox" ${it.is_completed ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleChecklistItem('${it.id}', this.checked)">
+                                    <span style="flex:1; ${it.is_completed ? 'text-decoration: line-through; color:#94a3b8;' : ''}">${it.text}</span>
+                                    <button onclick="deleteChecklistItem('${it.id}')" style="background:none; border:none; color:#ef4444; cursor:pointer;" title="Eliminar">×</button>
+                                </div>
+                            `).join('')}
+                        </div>
+                        <div style="padding-left: 25px;">
+                            <input type="text" id="cl-input-${cl.id}" placeholder="Nuevo ítem..." style="padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:3px;" onkeypress="if(event.key === 'Enter') addChecklistItem('${cl.id}')">
+                            <button onclick="addChecklistItem('${cl.id}')" style="padding: 5px 10px; border:none; background:#f1f5f9; cursor:pointer; border-radius:3px;">Añadir</button>
+                        </div>
+                    </div>
+                `).join('');
+
+                // Render Members
+                document.getElementById('modalMembersText').innerHTML = data.members.map(m => `
+                    <div style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:2px 8px; margin:2px; font-size:0.8rem;">
+                        ${m.username}
+                        <button onclick="removeMember('${m.id}')" style="background:none; border:none; margin-left:5px; cursor:pointer;">×</button>
+                    </div>
+                `).join('');
+                
+                // Labels rendering skip for brevity in display, you get the point
+            }
+        } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
+    }
+
+    function closeCardModal() {
+        document.getElementById('cardModal').style.display = 'none';
+        window.location.reload(); // Refresh to catch all changes
+    }
+
+    // Card Updates
+    async function updateCardDetails() {
+        const title  = document.getElementById('modalCardTitle').value;
+        const desc   = document.getElementById('modalCardDesc').value;
+        const dueDate= document.getElementById('modalDueDate').value;
+        const status = document.getElementById('modalCardStatus').value;
+        
+        const formData = new URLSearchParams();
+        formData.append("title", title);
+        formData.append("description", desc);
+        formData.append("due_date", dueDate);
+        formData.append("status", status);
+
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}`, {
+            method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+        });
+        document.getElementById('saveMsg').innerText = 'Guardado!';
+        setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('saveMsg').innerText='', 2000);
+    }
+
+    async function deleteCard() {
+        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+        if (res.ok) closeCardModal();
+        else { document.getElementById('deleteCardBtn').innerText = 'Error ' + res.status; }
+    }
+
+    async function deleteList(listId, btn) {
+        btn.innerHTML = '...';
+        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/lists/${listId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+        if (res.ok) {
+            window.location.reload();
+        } else {
+            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
+            const msg = data.detail || ('Error ' + res.status);
+            // Show inline error on the list header
+            btn.innerHTML = '\u26a0\ufe0f';
+            btn.title = msg;
+            btn.style.color = '#ef4444';
+            // Also show floating toast
+            showToast(msg, 'error');
+            setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = '\ud83d\uddd1\ufe0f'; btn.style.color = '#94a3b8'; btn.title = ''; }, 5000);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function showToast(msg, type) {
+        let t = document.getElementById('kanban-toast');
+        if (!t) {
+            t = document.createElement('div');
+            t.id = 'kanban-toast';
+            t.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500;z-index:9999;max-width:480px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.2);transition:opacity .3s';
+            document.body.appendChild(t);
+        }
+        t.style.background = type === 'error' ? '#fef2f2' : '#f0fdf4';
+        t.style.color = type === 'error' ? '#b91c1c' : '#15803d';
+        t.style.border = type === 'error' ? '1px solid #fecaca' : '1px solid #bbf7d0';
+        t.style.opacity = '1';
+        t.textContent = msg;
+        clearTimeout(t._timer);
+        t._timer = setTimeout(() => { t.style.opacity = '0'; }, 4000);
+    }
+
+    // Members
+    async function loadUsersToAssign() {
+        const res = await fetch('/api/projects/users');
+        const users = await res.json();
+        const sel = document.getElementById('userAssignSelect');
+        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Selecciona un usuario...</option>' + users.map(u => `<option value="${u.id}">${u.username}</option>`).join('');
+        document.getElementById('assignUserDiv').style.display = 'block';
+    }
+
+    async function assignMember() {
+        const userId = document.getElementById('userAssignSelect').value;
+        if(!userId) return;
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("user_id", userId);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}/members`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        document.getElementById('assignUserDiv').style.display = 'none';
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+    
+    async function removeMember(userId) {
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}/members/${userId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    // Checklists
+    async function createNewChecklist() {
+        const title = prompt("Nombre de la lista de tareas:");
+        if(!title) return;
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("title", title);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}/checklists`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    async function addChecklistItem(clId) {
+        const text = document.getElementById(`cl-input-${clId}`).value;
+        if(!text) return;
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("text", text);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/checklists/${clId}/items`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    async function toggleChecklistItem(itemId, isComplete) {
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("is_completed", isComplete);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/checklist_items/${itemId}`, {
+            method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    async function deleteChecklistItem(itemId) {
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/checklist_items/${itemId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+
+</script>

+{% block scripts %}
+<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@latest/Sortable.min.js"></script>
+<script>
+    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
+        if (!document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.contains('collapsed')) {
+            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
+        }
+    });
+
+    const boardContainer = document.getElementById('board-container');
+    const boardId = "{{ board.id }}";
+    const projectId = "{{ project_id | default('') }}";
+
+    new Sortable(boardContainer, {
+        animation: 150,
+        ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
+        handle: '.list-header',
+        onEnd: async function (evt) {
+            if (evt.oldIndex === evt.newIndex) return;
+            const itemEl = evt.item;
+            const listId = itemEl.getAttribute('data-id');
+            const newIndex = evt.newIndex;
+            const lists = Array.from(boardContainer.children);
+            let prevOrder = 0.0, nextOrder = 0.0;
+            if (newIndex > 0) prevOrder = parseFloat(lists[newIndex - 1].getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+            if (newIndex < lists.length - 1) { 
+                const nextEl = lists[newIndex + 1];
+                if(nextEl && nextEl.hasAttribute('data-order')) nextOrder = parseFloat(nextEl.getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+            }
+            const formData = new URLSearchParams();
+            formData.append("prev_order", prevOrder);
+            formData.append("next_order", nextOrder);
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/lists/${listId}/move`, {
+                    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+                });
+                if(res.ok) {
+                    const data = await res.json();
+                    itemEl.setAttribute('data-order', data.new_order);
+                }
+            } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
+        }
+    });
+
+    function initCardSortable() {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.card-list').forEach(el => {
+            new Sortable(el, {
+                group: 'shared', 
+                animation: 150,
+                ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
+                onEnd: async function (evt) {
+                    const itemEl = evt.item;
+                    const cardId = itemEl.getAttribute('data-id');
+                    const newListId = evt.to.closest('.kanban-list').getAttribute('data-id');
+                    const newIndex = evt.newIndex;
+                    const cards = Array.from(evt.to.children);
+                    let prevOrder = 0.0, nextOrder = 0.0;
+                    if (newIndex > 0) prevOrder = parseFloat(cards[newIndex - 1].getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+                    if (newIndex < cards.length - 1) nextOrder = parseFloat(cards[newIndex + 1].getAttribute('data-order') || 0);
+
+                    const formData = new URLSearchParams();
+                    formData.append("new_list_id", newListId);
+                    formData.append("prev_order", prevOrder);
+                    formData.append("next_order", nextOrder);
+                    try {
+                        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${cardId}/move`, {
+                            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+                        });
+                        if(res.ok) {
+                            const data = await res.json();
+                            itemEl.setAttribute('data-order', data.new_order);
+                        }
+                    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
+                }
+            });
+        });
+    }
+
+    initCardSortable();
+
+    async function addNewList(event) {
+        if(event) event.preventDefault();
+        const input = document.getElementById('newListInput');
+        const title = input.value.trim();
+        if(!title) return;
+        const formData = new URLSearchParams(); formData.append("title", title);
+        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/boards/${boardId}/lists`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+        });
+        if (res.ok) window.location.reload(); 
+    }
+
+    async function addNewCard(listId, formElement) {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        const input = formElement.querySelector('input');
+        const title = input.value.trim();
+        if(!title) return;
+        const formData = new URLSearchParams(); formData.append("title", title);
+        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/lists/${listId}/cards`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+        });
+        if (res.ok) window.location.reload(); 
+    }

+    function showAddCardForm(listId) {
+        document.getElementById('add-card-btn-' + listId).style.display = 'none';
+        const form = document.getElementById('add-card-form-' + listId);
+        form.style.display = 'block';
+        form.querySelector('input').focus();

+    // --- EXPERIENCIA DE USUARIO AVANZADA: MODAL DE TARJETA ---
+    let currentModalCardId = null;

+    async function openCardModal(cardId) {
+        currentModalCardId = cardId;
+        document.getElementById('cardModal').style.display = 'flex';
+        // Cleanup old UI
+        document.getElementById('modalCardTitle').value = 'Cargando...';
+        document.getElementById('modalCardDesc').value = '';
+        document.getElementById('modalChecklists').innerHTML = '';
+        document.getElementById('modalMembersText').innerHTML = '';
+        
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${cardId}`);
+            if(res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                document.getElementById('modalCardTitle').value = data.title;
+                document.getElementById('modalCardDesc').value = data.description;
+                document.getElementById('modalDueDate').value = data.due_date;
+                
+                // Render Checklists
+                document.getElementById('modalChecklists').innerHTML = data.checklists.map(cl => `
+                    <div style="margin-top: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 10px;">
+                        <h4 style="margin: 0 0 10px 0; color: #334155; font-size:1rem;">✅ ${cl.title}</h4>
+                        <div style="padding-left: 25px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
+                            ${cl.items.map(it => `
+                                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:5px;">
+                                    <input type="checkbox" ${it.is_completed ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleChecklistItem('${it.id}', this.checked)">
+                                    <span style="flex:1; ${it.is_completed ? 'text-decoration: line-through; color:#94a3b8;' : ''}">${it.text}</span>
+                                    <button onclick="deleteChecklistItem('${it.id}')" style="background:none; border:none; color:#ef4444; cursor:pointer;" title="Eliminar">×</button>
+                                </div>
+                            `).join('')}
+                        </div>
+                        <div style="padding-left: 25px;">
+                            <input type="text" id="cl-input-${cl.id}" placeholder="Nuevo ítem..." style="padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:3px;" onkeypress="if(event.key === 'Enter') addChecklistItem('${cl.id}')">
+                            <button onclick="addChecklistItem('${cl.id}')" style="padding: 5px 10px; border:none; background:#f1f5f9; cursor:pointer; border-radius:3px;">Añadir</button>
+                        </div>
+                    </div>
+                `).join('');
+
+                // Render Members
+                document.getElementById('modalMembersText').innerHTML = data.members.map(m => `
+                    <div style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:2px 8px; margin:2px; font-size:0.8rem;">
+                        ${m.username}
+                        <button onclick="removeMember('${m.id}')" style="background:none; border:none; margin-left:5px; cursor:pointer;">×</button>
+                    </div>
+                `).join('');
+                
+                // Labels rendering skip for brevity in display, you get the point
+            }
+        } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
+    }

+    function closeCardModal() {
+        document.getElementById('cardModal').style.display = 'none';
+        window.location.reload(); // Refresh to catch all changes
+    }

+    // Card Updates
+    async function updateCardDetails() {
+        const title = document.getElementById('modalCardTitle').value;
+        const desc = document.getElementById('modalCardDesc').value;
+        const dueDate = document.getElementById('modalDueDate').value;
+        
+        const formData = new URLSearchParams();
+        formData.append("title", title);
+        formData.append("description", desc);
+        formData.append("due_date", dueDate);
+
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}`, {
+            method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: formData
+        });
+        document.getElementById('saveMsg').innerText = 'Guardado!';
+        setTimeout(()=> document.getElementById('saveMsg').innerText='', 2000);
+    }
+
+    async function deleteCard() {
+        if(confirm("¿Estás seguro de eliminar esta tarjeta de forma permanente?")) {
+            await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+            closeCardModal();
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Members
+    async function loadUsersToAssign() {
+        const res = await fetch('/api/projects/users');
+        const users = await res.json();
+        const sel = document.getElementById('userAssignSelect');
+        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Selecciona un usuario...</option>' + users.map(u => `<option value="${u.id}">${u.username}</option>`).join('');
+        document.getElementById('assignUserDiv').style.display = 'block';
+    }
+
+    async function assignMember() {
+        const userId = document.getElementById('userAssignSelect').value;
+        if(!userId) return;
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("user_id", userId);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}/members`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        document.getElementById('assignUserDiv').style.display = 'none';
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+    
+    async function removeMember(userId) {
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}/members/${userId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    // Checklists
+    async function createNewChecklist() {
+        const title = prompt("Nombre de la lista de tareas:");
+        if(!title) return;
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("title", title);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/cards/${currentModalCardId}/checklists`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    async function addChecklistItem(clId) {
+        const text = document.getElementById(`cl-input-${clId}`).value;
+        if(!text) return;
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("text", text);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/checklists/${clId}/items`, {
+            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    async function toggleChecklistItem(itemId, isComplete) {
+        const form = new URLSearchParams(); form.append("is_completed", isComplete);
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/checklist_items/${itemId}`, {
+            method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: form
+        });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    async function deleteChecklistItem(itemId) {
+        await fetch(`/api/projects/checklist_items/${itemId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+        openCardModal(currentModalCardId);
+    }
+
+    async function deleteList(listId) {
+        if(confirm("¿Estás seguro de eliminar esta lista y TODAS sus tarjetas de forma permanente?")) {
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/lists/${listId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+                if(res.ok) {
+                    window.location.reload();
+                } else {
+                    alert("Error eliminando lista");
+                }
+            } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
+        }
+    }

+<script>
+async function submitNewBoard(e) {
+    e.preventDefault();
+    const title = document.getElementById('boardTitle').value;
+    const color = document.getElementById('boardColor').value;
+    
+    const formData = new URLSearchParams();
+    formData.append("title", title);
+    formData.append("background", color);
+    
+    try {
+        const res = await fetch("/api/projects/boards", {
+            method: "POST",
+            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
+            body: formData.toString()
+        });
+        if(res.ok) {
+            const data = await res.json();
+            window.location.href = "/projects/" + data.id;
+        } else {
+            alert("Error al crear el tablero.");
+        }
+    } catch(err) {
+        alert("Error de red.");
+    }
+}
+
+async function deleteBoard(boardId) {
+    if(confirm("¿Estás seguro de eliminar todo el tablero y sus tarjetas de forma permanente?")) {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/boards/${boardId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+            if(res.ok) {
+                window.location.reload();
+            } else {
+                alert("Error eliminando tablero");
+            }
+        } catch(e) {
+            console.error(e);
+        }
+    }
+}
+</script>

+<script>
+const PROJECT_ID = "{{ project.id }}";
+function openAddPhaseModal() { document.getElementById('addPhaseModal').classList.add('open'); }
+function closeModal() { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('open')); }
+
+document.getElementById('addPhaseForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+    e.preventDefault();
+    const btn = document.getElementById('phaseSubmitBtn');
+    btn.textContent = 'Creando...'; btn.disabled = true;
+    const fd = new FormData();
+    fd.append('title',      document.getElementById('phaseName').value.trim());
+    fd.append('background', document.getElementById('phaseColor').value);
+    try {
+        const res  = await fetch('/api/projects/' + PROJECT_ID + '/boards', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+        const data = await res.json();
+        if (res.ok) { window.location.reload(); }
+        else { alert(data.detail || 'Error'); btn.textContent = 'Crear Fase'; btn.disabled = false; }
+    } catch { alert('Error de red'); btn.textContent = 'Crear Fase'; btn.disabled = false; }
+});
+
+async function deletePhase(projectId, boardId, title) {
+    const res = await fetch('/api/projects/' + projectId + '/boards/' + boardId, { method: 'DELETE' });
+    if (res.ok) {
+        document.querySelector('[data-board-id="' + boardId + '"]')?.remove();
+        window.location.reload();
+    } else {
+        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
+        const msg = data.detail || 'No se pudo eliminar la fase';
+        showDetailToast(msg, 'error');
+    }
+}
+
+async function confirmDeleteProject(projectId, name) {
+    const res = await fetch('/api/projects/' + projectId, { method: 'DELETE' });
+    if (res.ok) {
+        window.location.href = '/projects';
+    } else {
+        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
+        const msg = data.detail || 'No se pudo eliminar el proyecto';
+        showDetailToast(msg, 'error');
+    }
+}
+
+function showDetailToast(msg, type) {
+    let t = document.getElementById('detail-toast');
+    if (!t) {
+        t = document.createElement('div');
+        t.id = 'detail-toast';
+        t.style.cssText = [
+            'position:fixed', 'bottom:28px', 'left:50%', 'transform:translateX(-50%)',
+            'padding:14px 24px', 'border-radius:10px', 'font-size:.88rem', 'font-weight:500',
+            'z-index:9999', 'max-width:540px', 'text-align:center',
+            'box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.18)', 'transition:opacity .35s'
+        ].join(';');
+        document.body.appendChild(t);
+    }
+    t.style.background = type === 'error' ? '#fef2f2' : '#f0fdf4';
+    t.style.color      = type === 'error' ? '#b91c1c' : '#15803d';
+    t.style.border     = type === 'error' ? '1px solid #fecaca' : '1px solid #bbf7d0';
+    t.style.opacity    = '1';
+    t.textContent      = '⚠️ ' + msg;
+    clearTimeout(t._timer);
+    t._timer = setTimeout(() => { t.style.opacity = '0'; }, 6000);
+}

+    m.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === m) closeModal(); });

+<script>
+function openCreateModal() { document.getElementById('createModal').classList.add('open'); }
+function closeModal()      { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('open')); }
+
+function selectColor(el) {
+    document.querySelectorAll('.color-swatch').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));
+    el.classList.add('selected');
+    document.getElementById('projBackground').value = el.dataset.color;
+}
+
+document.getElementById('createProjectForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+    e.preventDefault();
+    const btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
+    btn.textContent = 'Creando...'; btn.disabled = true;
+    const fd = new FormData();
+    fd.append('name',        document.getElementById('projName').value.trim());
+    fd.append('description', document.getElementById('projDesc').value.trim());
+    fd.append('background',  document.getElementById('projBackground').value);
+    try {
+        const res  = await fetch('/api/projects', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+        const data = await res.json();
+        if (res.ok) { window.location.href = '/projects/' + data.id; }
+        else { alert(data.detail || 'Error'); btn.textContent = 'Crear Proyecto'; btn.disabled = false; }
+    } catch { alert('Error de red'); btn.textContent = 'Crear Proyecto'; btn.disabled = false; }
+});
+
+document.getElementById('createModal').addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeModal(); });
+</script>

+                        onclick="setSort('suggested_qty')" title="Clic para ordenar">
+                        Sug. Mensual<br><small>(Promedio Móvil)</small> <span id="sort_suggested_qty"
+                            style="font-size: 0.8rem;"></span>
+                        <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: normal; margin-top: 0.2rem;">UND / CAJ</div>
+                    </th>
+                    <th style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); color: #10b981; cursor: pointer; width: 20%;"
+                        onclick="setSort('estimated_qty')" title="Clic para ordenar">
+                        Proyección Final<br><small>(Ajustable)</small> <span id="sort_estimated_qty"
+                            style="font-size: 0.8rem;"></span>
+                        <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: normal; margin-top: 0.2rem;">UND / CAJ</div>
+                    </th>
+                </tr>
+            </thead>
+            <tbody id="forecastBody">
+                <!-- Rows injected here -->
+            </tbody>
+        </table>
+    </div>
+</div>

+<!-- MRP Section -->
+<div class="card" id="mrpSection" style="display: none; margin-bottom: 2rem;">
+    <div class="flex-between" style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
+        <div>
+            <h2 style="color: var(--primary); margin-bottom: 0.25rem;">Planeación de Insumos (MRP)</h2>
+            <p style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem;">Explosión de requerimientos vs Stock Actual.</p>
+        </div>
+        <div>
+            <input type="text" id="mrpSearch" class="form-control" placeholder="Buscar insumo..." onkeyup="filterMRP()"
+                style="width: 250px;">
+        </div>
+    </div>
+
+    <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
+        <table class="table" style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
+            <thead>
+                <tr style="background: #f8fafc;">
+                    <th style="padding: 1rem; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);">Insumo</th>
+                    <th style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);">Tipo</th>
+                    <th
+                        style="padding: 1rem; text-align: right; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); color: #3b82f6;">
+                        Stock Actual</th>
+                    <th
+                        style="padding: 1rem; text-align: right; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); color: #8b5cf6;">
+                        Requerido (Forecast)</th>
+                    <th
+                        style="padding: 1rem; text-align: right; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); font-weight: bold;">
+                        Déficit / Sobrante</th>
+                </tr>
+            </thead>
+            <tbody id="mrpBody">
+                <!-- MRP rows injected here -->
+            </tbody>
+        </table>
+    </div>

+<script>
+    const canEditStr = "{{ 'true' if user and user.role in [1, 4, 8] else 'false' }}";
+    const canEdit = (canEditStr === "true");
+    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
+        document.getElementById('selMonth').value = "{{ default_month }}";
+    });
+
+    let currentForecastData = [];
+    let displayData = [];
+    let mrpData = [];
+    let sortCol = 'article_name';
+    let sortAsc = true;
+
+    async function loadForecast() {
+        const m = document.getElementById('selMonth').value;
+        const y = document.getElementById('inpYear').value;
+
+        document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'block';
+        document.getElementById('forecastTable').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('btnSave').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('btnMrp').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('mrpSection').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/sales/api/forecast/generate?month=${m}&year=${y}&refresh=true`);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Error interno");
+
+            const data = await res.json();
+            currentForecastData = data.data;
+
+            document.getElementById('lblHistoryDates').innerText = `${data.start_history} - ${data.end_history}`;
+
+            applyFilter();
+
+            document.getElementById('forecastTable').style.display = 'table';
+            document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'grid';
+            document.getElementById('btnSave').style.display = 'block';
+            document.getElementById('btnMrp').style.display = 'block';
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("No se pudo cargar la sugerencia.");
+        } finally {
+            document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    }
+
+    function setSort(col) {
+        if (sortCol === col) {
+            sortAsc = !sortAsc;
+        } else {
+            sortCol = col;
+            sortAsc = true;
+        }
+        applyFilter();
+    }
+
+    function applyFilter() {
+        // Since we removed inputs, displayData is exactly the same array, just sorted
+        displayData = [...currentForecastData];
+
+        displayData.sort((a, b) => {
+            let va = a[sortCol];
+            let vb = b[sortCol];
+            if (typeof va === 'string') return sortAsc ? va.localeCompare(vb) : vb.localeCompare(va);
+            return sortAsc ? va - vb : vb - va;
+        });
+
+        ['co_art', 'article_name', 'total_past_3m', 'suggested_qty', 'estimated_qty'].forEach(c => {
+            const el = document.getElementById('sort_' + c);
+            if (el) el.innerText = (c === sortCol) ? (sortAsc ? '▲' : '▼') : '';
+        });
+
+        renderTable();
+    }
+
+    function renderTable() {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('forecastBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        let sumAvg = 0;
+        let sumFinal = 0;
+        let sumBoxesAvg = 0;
+        let sumBoxesFinal = 0;
+
+        currentForecastData.forEach(row => {
+            sumAvg += row.suggested_qty;
+            sumFinal += row.estimated_qty;
+            sumBoxesAvg += (row.suggested_boxes || 0);
+            sumBoxesFinal += (row.estimated_boxes || 0);
+        });
+
+        displayData.forEach((row) => {
+            const idx = currentForecastData.indexOf(row);
+            const isAdj = Math.abs(row.suggested_qty - row.estimated_qty) > 0.01;
+            const bg = isAdj ? 'background: #f0fdf4;' : '';
+
+            const equivText = (row.equiv > 1) ? ` <span style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.8rem;">/ ${row.suggested_boxes.toLocaleString()} CJ</span>` : '';
+            const finalEquivText = (row.equiv > 1) ? `<div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #10b981; margin-top: 0.3rem;">${row.estimated_boxes.toLocaleString()} CJ</div>` : '';
+
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.style.cssText = `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); ${bg}`;
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.85rem;">${row.co_art}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500;">${row.article_name}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: center; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500;">${row.total_past_3m.toLocaleString()}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; color: #3b82f6;">
+                    ${row.suggested_qty.toLocaleString()} UND<br>${equivText}
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: center;">
+                    <input type="number" step="0.01" value="${row.estimated_qty}" 
+                    style="width: 100px; padding: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid ${isAdj ? '#10b981' : 'var(--border)'}; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; color: ${isAdj ? '#047857' : 'inherit'};"
+                    onchange="updateEstimatedQty(${idx}, this.value)"
+                    ${canEdit ? "" : "disabled"} >
+                    ${finalEquivText}
+                </td >
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+
+        document.getElementById('statSkus').innerText = currentForecastData.length;
+        document.getElementById('statAvg').innerHTML = `${Math.round(sumAvg).toLocaleString()}<div style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #c026d3; margin-top: 0.2rem;">${Math.round(sumBoxesAvg).toLocaleString()} CAJ</div>`;
+        document.getElementById('statFinal').innerHTML = `${Math.round(sumFinal).toLocaleString()}<div style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #059669; margin-top: 0.2rem;">${Math.round(sumBoxesFinal).toLocaleString()} CAJ</div>`;
+    }
+
+    function updateEstimatedQty(idx, val) {
+        let num = parseFloat(val);
+        if (isNaN(num) || num < 0) num = 0;
+
+        let row = currentForecastData[idx];
+        row.estimated_qty = num;
+        if (row.equiv > 1) {
+            row.estimated_boxes = Math.round((num / row.equiv) * 100) / 100;
+        }
+
+        applyFilter();
+    }
+
+    async function saveForecast() {
+        const payload = {
+            month: parseInt(document.getElementById('selMonth').value),
+            year: parseInt(document.getElementById('inpYear').value),
+            rows: currentForecastData
+        };
+
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnSave');
+        const origText = btn.innerText;
+        btn.innerText = "Guardando...";
+        btn.disabled = true;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/sales/api/forecast/save', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                alert("✅ " + data.message);
+            } else {
+                alert("❌ Error: " + data.detail);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión al guardar.");
+        } finally {
+            btn.innerText = origText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadMRP() {
+        const m = document.getElementById('selMonth').value;
+        const y = document.getElementById('inpYear').value;
+
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnMrp');
+        const origText = btn.innerText;
+        btn.innerText = "Calculando...";
+        btn.disabled = true;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/sales/api/mrp/calculate?month=${m}&year=${y}`);
+            const payload = await res.json();
+
+            if (payload.status === "error") {
+                alert("⚠️ Debe guardar/congelar primero la proyección actual antes de calcular el MRP.");
+                return;
+            }
+
+            mrpData = payload.data;
+            document.getElementById('mrpSection').style.display = 'block';
+            filterMRP();
+
+            // Scroll down to MRP section smoothly
+            document.getElementById('mrpSection').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Ocurrió un error consultando el MRP de la base de datos.");
+        } finally {
+            btn.innerText = origText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function filterMRP() {
+        const term = document.getElementById('mrpSearch').value.toLowerCase();
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('mrpBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        if (mrpData.length === 0) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; padding: 2rem;">No hay requerimientos en la explosión de materiales. Asegúrese de que haya artículos compuestos en el Forecast.</td></tr>';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        mrpData.forEach(row => {
+            if (term &&
+                !row.componente.toLowerCase().includes(term) &&
+                !row.descrip.toLowerCase().includes(term) &&
+                !(row.tipo_art && row.tipo_art.toLowerCase().includes(term))) {
+                return; // skip
+            }
+
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.style.borderBottom = '1px solid var(--border)';
+
+            // Styling for deficit
+            let deficitHtml = `<span style="color: #059669; font-weight: bold;">+${row.deficit.toLocaleString()}</span>`;
+            if (row.deficit < 0) {
+                deficitHtml = `<span style="color: #ef4444; font-weight: bold; background: #fef2f2; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px;">${row.deficit.toLocaleString()} COMPRAR</span>`;
+            }
+
+            const tipoLabel = row.tipo_art === 'M' ? 'MP' : (row.tipo_art === 'E' ? 'ME' : row.tipo_art);
+
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem;">
+                    <div style="font-weight: 500;">${row.componente}</div>
+                    <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted);">${row.descrip}</div>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: center;">
+                    <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; background: #e2e8f0; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;">${tipoLabel}</span>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: right; color: #3b82f6; font-weight: 500;">
+                    ${row.stock_actual.toLocaleString()} <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8;">${row.unidad}</span>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: right; color: #8b5cf6; font-weight: 500;">
+                    ${row.required_qty.toLocaleString()} <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8;">${row.unidad}</span>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: right;">
+                    ${deficitHtml}
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+                        <span>150%</span>
+                    </div>
+                </div>
+
+                <!-- 3 métricas -->
+                <div class="row g-3">
+                    <div class="col-4">
+                        <div class="card text-center">
+                            <div class="metric-value text-info" id="val-hoy">—</div>
+                            <div class="metric-label">Ventas Hoy</div>
+                        </div>
+                    </div>
+                    <div class="col-4">
+                        <div class="card text-center">
+                            <div class="metric-value text-warning" id="val-prom">—</div>
+                            <div class="metric-label">Promedio 30d</div>
+                        </div>
+                    </div>
+                    <div class="col-4">
+                        <div class="card text-center">
+                            <div class="metric-value" id="val-diff" style="color:var(--muted)">—</div>

+<script>
+    let chartVentas = null;
+    const fmt = (n) => new Intl.NumberFormat('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(n);
+
+    async function cargarDatos() {
+        document.getElementById('loader').style.display = 'flex';
+        document.getElementById('main-content').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('error-state').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const [estadoRes, histRes] = await Promise.all([
+                fetch('/semaforo/api/estado'),
+                fetch('/semaforo/api/historico?dias=30')
+            ]);
+
+            if (!estadoRes.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${estadoRes.status}`);
+            const data = await estadoRes.json();
+            const hist = histRes.ok ? await histRes.json() : data.historico_7dias || [];
+
+            renderSemaforo(data);
+            renderHistorico(hist, data.promedio_30);
+            renderTopClientes(data.top_clientes || []);
+
+            document.getElementById('ts-label').textContent =
+                `Actualizado: ${data.hora_consulta} · Fuente: ${data.fuente === 'carmal' ? 'Carmal' : 'Local'}`;
+
+            document.getElementById('loader').style.display = 'none';
+            document.getElementById('main-content').style.display = 'block';
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            document.getElementById('loader').style.display = 'none';
+            document.getElementById('error-state').style.display = 'block';
+            document.getElementById('error-msg').textContent = e.message;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderSemaforo(d) {
+        // Luces
+        ['rojo', 'amarillo', 'verde'].forEach(c => {
+            document.getElementById(`light-${c}`).className = 'light';
+        });
+        const est = d.estado; // verde | amarillo | rojo | sin_datos
+        if (['verde', 'amarillo', 'rojo'].includes(est)) {
+            document.getElementById(`light-${est}`).classList.add(`active-${est}`);
+        }
+
+        // Badge
+        const badge = document.getElementById('estado-badge');
+        badge.className = `estado-badge badge-${est}`;
+        const labels = { verde: '✅ En Meta', amarillo: '⚠️ Alerta', rojo: '🚨 Bajo Meta', sin_datos: '⚪ Sin Datos' };
+        badge.textContent = labels[est] || est;
+
+        // Barra progreso
+        const pct = Math.min(d.pct, 150);
+        const bar = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
+        bar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
+        const colors = { verde: 'var(--verde)', amarillo: 'var(--amarillo)', rojo: 'var(--rojo)', sin_datos: 'var(--gris)' };
+        bar.style.background = colors[est];
+        document.getElementById('pct-label').textContent = `${d.pct}%`;
+        document.getElementById('pct-label').style.color = colors[est];
+
+        // Métricas
+        document.getElementById('val-hoy').textContent = fmt(d.hoy);
+        document.getElementById('val-prom').textContent = fmt(d.promedio_30);
+        const diff = d.diferencia;
+        const diffEl = document.getElementById('val-diff');
+        diffEl.textContent = (diff >= 0 ? '+' : '') + fmt(diff);
+        diffEl.style.color = diff >= 0 ? 'var(--verde)' : 'var(--rojo)';
+    }
+
+    function renderHistorico(hist, promedio) {
+        const labels = hist.map(h => {
+            const d = new Date(h.dia + 'T00:00:00');
+            return d.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' });
+        });
+        const totales = hist.map(h => h.total);
+        const promArr = hist.map(() => promedio);
+
+        const ctx = document.getElementById('chart-ventas').getContext('2d');
+        if (chartVentas) chartVentas.destroy();
+
+        chartVentas = new Chart(ctx, {
+            type: 'bar',
+            data: {
+                labels,
+                datasets: [
+                    {
+                        label: 'Ventas diarias',
+                        data: totales,
+                        backgroundColor: totales.map(v =>
+                            v >= promedio * 0.9 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,.7)' :
+                                v >= promedio * 0.7 ? 'rgba(234,179,8,.7)' :
+                                    'rgba(239,68,68,.7)'
+                        ),
+                        borderRadius: 4,
+                        order: 2
+                    },
+                    {
+                        label: 'Promedio 30d',
+                        data: promArr,
+                        type: 'line',
+                        borderColor: 'rgba(148,163,184,.6)',
+                        borderDash: [5, 5],
+                        borderWidth: 2,
+                        pointRadius: 0,
+                        fill: false,
+                        order: 1
+                    }
+                ]
+            },
+            options: {
+                responsive: true,
+                plugins: {
+                    legend: { labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 11 } } },
+                    tooltip: {
+                        callbacks: {
+                            label: ctx => ` ${fmt(ctx.raw)}`
+                        }
+                    }
+                },
+                scales: {
+                    x: { ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 10 } }, grid: { color: '#1e293b' } },
+                    y: { ticks: { color: '#64748b', callback: v => fmt(v) }, grid: { color: '#1e293b' } }
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderTopClientes(clientes) {
+        const el = document.getElementById('top-clientes');
+        if (!clientes.length) {
+            el.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted" style="font-size:.85rem">Sin ventas registradas hoy</p>';
+            return;
+        }
+        const max = Math.max(...clientes.map(c => c.total));
+        el.innerHTML = clientes.map((c, i) => `
+      <div class="cliente-row">
+        <div>
+          <span class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.85rem">${i + 1}. ${c.cliente}</span>
+          <div style="height:4px; margin-top:4px; width:${Math.round(c.total / max * 100)}%;
+               background:rgba(99,102,241,.6); border-radius:2px"></div>
+        </div>
+        <span class="fw-bold" style="color:var(--verde); font-size:.9rem">${fmt(c.total)}</span>
+      </div>
+    `).join('');
+    }
+
+    // Auto-refresh cada 5 minutos
+    cargarDatos();
+    setInterval(cargarDatos, 5 * 60 * 1000);
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+{% block scripts %}
+<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
+<script>
+    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
+    const fmt = (n, d = 2) => new Intl.NumberFormat('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d }).format(n || 0);
+    const fU = n => '$' + fmt(n);
+    const fPct = n => fmt(n, 2) + ' %';
+
+    let tipoVal = 'cajas', tipoVta = '', charts = {};
+
+    // Init
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        const hoy = new Date();
+        const ini = new Date(hoy.getFullYear(), hoy.getMonth(), 1);
+        const f = d => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
+        $('f-fi').value = f(ini);
+        $('f-ff').value = f(hoy);
+        cargarVendedores().then(() => load());
+    });
+
+    async function cargarVendedores() {
+        try {
+            const r = await fetch('/semaforo2/api/vendedores');
+            if (!r.ok) return;
+            const d = await r.json();
+            const s = $('f-ven');
+            d.forEach(v => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v.co_ven; o.textContent = v.ven_des; s.appendChild(o); });
+        } catch { }
+    }
+
+    function setTV(btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.tvb-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('act')); btn.classList.add('act'); tipoVta = btn.dataset.t; }
+    function setTV2(tab) { document.querySelectorAll('.tt').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('act')); tab.classList.add('act'); tipoVal = tab.dataset.v; load(); }
+
+    async function load() {
+        $('s2-loader').style.display = 'flex'; $('s2-lm').textContent = 'Consultando Carmal…';
+        const p = new URLSearchParams({
+            fecha_ini: $('f-fi').value, fecha_fin: $('f-ff').value,
+            vendedor: $('f-ven').value, tipo_venta: tipoVta,
+            tipo_valor: tipoVal, meta: parseFloat($('f-meta').value) || 0
+        });
+        try {
+            const r = await fetch('/semaforo2/api/dashboard?' + p);
+            const d = await r.json();
+            render(d);
+            const meses = ['ene', 'feb', 'mar', 'abr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'ago', 'sep', 'oct', 'nov', 'dic'];
+            const dt = new Date($('f-fi').value + 'T00:00:00');
+            $('s2-periodo').textContent = meses[dt.getMonth()] + ' ' + dt.getFullYear();
+            $('s2-upd').textContent = 'Actualizado: ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-VE');
+        } catch (e) { $('s2-lm').textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message; setTimeout(() => $('s2-loader').style.display = 'none', 3000); return; }
+        $('s2-loader').style.display = 'none';
+    }
+
+    function render(d) {
+        const k = d.kpis, st = d.stats;
+        $('k-meta').textContent = k.meta > 0 ? fmt(k.meta, 0) : 'Sin Meta';
+        $('k-cump').textContent = fPct(k.cumplimiento_pct);
+        $('k-proy').textContent = fPct(k.cumplimiento_proyectado_pct);
+        $('k-fact').textContent = fU(k.facturado_neto);
+        $('k-pend').textContent = fU(k.pedidos_usd);
+        $('k-total').textContent = fU(k.facturado_mas_pedidos);
+        $('s-fact').textContent = fmt(k.facturado_usd, 0);
+        $('s-dev').textContent = fmt(k.devolucion_usd, 0);
+        $('s-pend').textContent = fmt(k.pedidos_usd, 0);
+        $('s-tot').textContent = fmt(k.facturado_mas_pedidos, 0);
+        $('bs1').textContent = st.dias_periodo;
+        $('bs2').textContent = st.dias_con_facturacion;
+        $('bs3').textContent = fmt(st.promedio_dia_calendario, 0);
+        $('bs4').textContent = fmt(st.promedio_dia_activos, 0);
+        $('bs5').textContent = st.num_facturas;
+        $('bs6').textContent = fmt(st.promedio_fact_diaria, 2);
+        renderMarca(d.por_marca || []);
+        renderCanal(d.por_canal || []);
+        renderTipo(d.por_tipo_pedido || []);
+        renderDiario(d.diario || []);
+    }
+
+    const PAL = ['#06b6d4', '#3b82f6', '#6366f1', '#8b5cf6', '#0ea5e9', '#22d3ee', '#818cf8'];
+    const AX = () => ({ grid: { color: 'rgba(37,48,71,.5)' }, ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 10 } }, border: { color: '#253047' } });
+    const OPT = (lgd = true, idx = 'x') => ({
+        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, indexAxis: idx,
+        plugins: {
+            legend: { display: lgd, labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 10 }, boxWidth: 12 } },
+            tooltip: {
+                backgroundColor: '#1c2333', titleColor: '#e2e8f0', bodyColor: '#94a3b8', borderColor: '#253047', borderWidth: 1,
+                callbacks: { label: c => ` ${fmt(c.raw)}` }
+            }
+        }, scales: { x: AX(), y: AX() }
+    });
+
+    function mk(id, cfg) { if (charts[id]) charts[id].destroy(); const c = document.getElementById(id); if (c) charts[id] = new Chart(c, cfg); }
+
+    function renderMarca(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-marca', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => x.marca), datasets: [{ data: d.map(x => x.valor), backgroundColor: d.map((_, i) => PAL[i % PAL.length]), borderRadius: 4, borderSkipped: false }]
+            },
+            options: OPT(false, 'y')
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderCanal(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-canal', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => x.canal), datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Monto', data: d.map(x => x.valor), backgroundColor: ['#3b82f6', '#06b6d4'], borderRadius: 4, yAxisID: 'y', order: 2 },
+                    { label: '%', data: d.map(x => x.pct), type: 'line', borderColor: '#f472b6', pointBackgroundColor: '#f472b6', borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 5, yAxisID: 'y2', order: 1, fill: false }
+                ]
+            }, options: { ...OPT(true), scales: { x: AX(), y: AX(), y2: { ...AX(), position: 'right', grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }, ticks: { callback: v => v + '%', color: '#64748b' } } } }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderTipo(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-tipo', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => x.tipo), datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Pedidos', data: d.map(x => x.pedidos), backgroundColor: ['#06b6d4', '#ef4444'], borderRadius: 4, yAxisID: 'y', order: 2 },
+                    { label: '%', data: d.map(x => x.pct), type: 'line', borderColor: '#f59e0b', pointBackgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 5, yAxisID: 'y2', order: 1, fill: false }
+                ]
+            }, options: { ...OPT(true), scales: { x: AX(), y: AX(), y2: { ...AX(), position: 'right', grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }, ticks: { callback: v => v + '%', color: '#64748b' } } } }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderDiario(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-diario', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => { const dt = new Date(x.dia + 'T00:00:00'); return dt.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' }); }),
+                datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Facturado', data: d.map(x => x.facturado), backgroundColor: 'rgba(6,182,212,.75)', borderRadius: 3, order: 2 },
+                    { label: 'Pedidos Pend.', data: d.map(x => x.pedidos_pendientes), type: 'line', borderColor: '#f59e0b', pointBackgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 4, fill: false, order: 1 }
+                ]
+            }, options: { ...OPT(true), scales: { x: { ...AX(), ticks: { maxRotation: 45, font: { size: 10 }, color: '#64748b' } }, y: AX() } }
+        });
+    }
+
+    setInterval(load, 10 * 60 * 1000);
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+    function switchConfigTab(tabName) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.config-tab-content').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');

+        if (tabName === 'emails') {
+            loadEmailLogs();
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadConfig() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/support/config');
+            configData = await res.json();
+
+            // Populate settings
+            if (configData.settings) {
+                if (configData.settings.notification_emails) document.getElementById('notificationEmails').value = configData.settings.notification_emails;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_server) document.getElementById('smtpServer').value = configData.settings.smtp_server;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_port) document.getElementById('smtpPort').value = configData.settings.smtp_port;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_user) document.getElementById('smtpUser').value = configData.settings.smtp_user;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_password) document.getElementById('smtpPassword').value = "********";
+            }
+
+            renderTables();
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error loading config", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadEmailLogs() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/support/email-logs');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            const body = document.getElementById('emailLogsTableBody');
+
+            if (data.length === 0) {
+                body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align: center; color: #6b7280; padding: 20px;">No hay registros de correos aún.</td></tr>';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            body.innerHTML = data.map(log => {
+                const isError = log.status === 'Failed';
+                return `
+                <tr style="${isError ? 'background-color: #fee2e2;' : ''}">
+                    <td style="white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.85rem;">${log.created_at}</td>
+                    <td style="font-size: 0.85rem; word-break: break-all;">${log.recipients}</td>
+                    <td style="font-size: 0.85rem;">${log.subject || '-'}</td>
+                    <td>
+                        <span style="display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; 
+                            ${isError ? 'background-color: #ef4444; color: white;' : 'background-color: #10b981; color: white;'}">
+                            ${log.status}
+                        </span>
+                    </td>
+                    <td style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #b91c1c; max-width: 300px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word;">${log.error_message || ''}</td>
+                </tr>
+                `;
+            }).join('');
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error loading email logs", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function saveSettings() {
+        const emails = document.getElementById('notificationEmails').value;
+        const smtpServer = document.getElementById('smtpServer').value;
+        const smtpPort = document.getElementById('smtpPort').value;
+        const smtpUser = document.getElementById('smtpUser').value;
+        const smtpPassword = document.getElementById('smtpPassword').value;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('notification_emails', emails);
+        formData.append('smtp_server', smtpServer);
+        formData.append('smtp_port', smtpPort);
+        formData.append('smtp_user', smtpUser);
+        if (smtpPassword) formData.append('smtp_password', smtpPassword);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/support/settings', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const toast = document.getElementById('settingsSavedToast');
+                toast.style.display = 'inline';
+                setTimeout(() => toast.style.display = 'none', 3000);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al guardar ajustes");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error saving settings", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderTables() {
+        // Departments
+        const deptBody = document.getElementById('deptTableBody');
+        deptBody.innerHTML = configData.departments.map(d => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${d.name}</td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('department', ${d.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+
+        // Status
+        const statusBody = document.getElementById('statusTableBody');
+        statusBody.innerHTML = configData.status.map(s => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${s.name}</td>
+                <td><span style="display:inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; background-color: ${s.color_hex || '#ccc'}; border-radius: 4px;"></span></td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('status', ${s.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+
+        // Priority
+        const prioBody = document.getElementById('prioTableBody');
+        prioBody.innerHTML = configData.priorities.map(p => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${p.name}</td>
+                <td>${p.level}</td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('priority', ${p.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+
+        // Type
+        const typeBody = document.getElementById('typeTableBody');
+        typeBody.innerHTML = configData.types.map(t => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${t.name}</td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('type', ${t.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+    }
+
+    async function addItem(table, nameId, colorId = null, levelId = null) {
+        const name = document.getElementById(nameId).value;
+        if (!name) return;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('name', name);
+        formData.append('action', 'create');
+
+        if (colorId) formData.append('color', document.getElementById(colorId).value);
+        if (levelId) formData.append('level', document.getElementById(levelId).value);
+
+        await fetch(`/api/support/config/${table}`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+
+        // Clear inputs
+        document.getElementById(nameId).value = '';
+        loadConfig();
+    }
+
+    async function deleteItem(table, id) {
+        if (!confirm('¿Eliminar?')) return;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('id', id);
+        formData.append('action', 'delete');
+        // Name is required by backend validation even if delete? Let's check backend or send dummy.
+        formData.append('name', 'DELETE');
+
+        await fetch(`/api/support/config/${table}`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+        loadConfig();
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}
