+from sqlalchemy import text
+from app.external_db import engine_a
+
+class StockSolver:
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_diagnostics():
+        issues = []
+        try:
+            with engine_a.connect() as conn:
+                # 1. Check for Negative Stock / Overdraws
+                # Logic: Where exits > entry quantity (approximate check via negative stock_actual, 
+                # but better to check inconsistent balance if stock_actual is trusted or calc it)
+                # For this solver, we focus on what we fixed: Negative Stock Actual
+                
+                q_neg = text("""
+                    SELECT rowguid, co_art, numero_lote, stock_actual, cantidad
+                    FROM saLoteEntrada
+                    WHERE stock_actual < 0
+                """)
+                neg_rows = conn.execute(q_neg).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in neg_rows:
+                    issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "NEGATIVE_STOCK",
+                        "severity": "high",
+                        "title": f"Stock Negativo: {row.numero_lote}",
+                        "description": f"El lote {row.numero_lote} ({row.co_art}) tiene stock negativo de {row.stock_actual:.2f}.",
+                        "meta": {"current_stock": float(row.stock_actual), "initial_qty": float(row.cantidad)}
+                    })
+
+                # 2. Check for Warehouse Mismatch (Line vs Entry)
+                # Logic: saLoteSalida.rowguid_reng -> saTrasladoReng (no alma) -> saTraslado.alm_orig
+                # Actually, simpler check: saLoteSalida.co_alma != saLoteEntrada.co_alma
+                # Limiting to recent issues or active ones?
+                
+                q_mismatch = text("""
+                    SELECT TOP 20 LS.rowguid, LS.numero_lote, LS.co_alma as salida_alma, LE.co_alma as entrada_alma, LS.co_art
+                    FROM saLoteSalida LS
+                    JOIN saLoteEntrada LE ON LS.Rowguid_Lote = LE.rowguid
+                    WHERE LS.co_alma != LE.co_alma
+                """)
+                mis_rows = conn.execute(q_mismatch).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in mis_rows:
+                    issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "WAREHOUSE_MISMATCH",
+                        "severity": "medium",
+                        "title": f"Conflicto Almacén: {row.numero_lote}",
+                        "description": f"Salida desde '{row.salida_alma}' pero el lote pertenece a '{row.entrada_alma}'.",
+                        "meta": {"correct_alma": row.entrada_alma}
+                    })
+
+                # 3. Check for Stuck in Warehouse 99 (P1-99 )
+                # ... (Existing logic) ...
+                
+                # 4. Check for Customer Return Inconsistencies (Supervisor Belén)
+                # Rule A: Validate Header Math (Total = Bruto + Imp)
+                # The user specifically reported cases where Total = Subtotal (ignoring Tax)
+                # Filtered by Current Month to reduce noise
+                q_ret_header = text("""
+                    SELECT doc_num, rowguid, total_neto, total_bruto, monto_imp, co_cli, co_mone
+                    FROM saDevolucionCliente
+                    WHERE anulado = 0
+                    AND MONTH(fec_emis) = MONTH(GETDATE()) 
+                    AND YEAR(fec_emis) = YEAR(GETDATE())
+                    AND ABS(total_neto - (total_bruto + monto_imp)) > 0.1
+                """)
+                rows_bad_header = conn.execute(q_ret_header).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in rows_bad_header:
+                    diff = float(row.total_neto - (row.total_bruto + row.monto_imp))
+                    mone = row.co_mone.strip() if row.co_mone else ""
+                    issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "RETURN_MATH_ERROR",
+                        "severity": "critical",
+                        "title": f"Error Matemático en Devolución: {row.doc_num}",
+                        "description": f"El Total Neto ({row.total_neto:,.2f} {mone}) no coincide con Subtotal + Impuestos. Diferencia: {diff:,.2f} {mone}.",
+                        "meta": {"diff": diff, "mone": mone}
+                    })
+
+                # Rule B: Line Totals vs Header Totals
+                # Compare Header Total Neto vs Sum(Line Net + Line Tax)
+                q_ret_lines = text("""
+                    SELECT H.doc_num, H.co_cli, H.total_neto, H.total_bruto, H.monto_imp,
+                           SUM(L.reng_neto) as sum_neto, SUM(L.monto_imp) as sum_imp,
+                           H.rowguid, MAX(H.co_mone) as co_mone
+                    FROM saDevolucionCliente H
+                    JOIN saDevolucionClienteReng L ON H.doc_num = L.doc_num
+                    WHERE H.anulado = 0
+                    AND MONTH(H.fec_emis) = MONTH(GETDATE()) 
+                    AND YEAR(H.fec_emis) = YEAR(GETDATE())
+                    GROUP BY H.doc_num, H.co_cli, H.total_neto, H.total_bruto, H.monto_imp, H.rowguid
+                    HAVING ABS(H.total_neto - (SUM(L.reng_neto) + SUM(L.monto_imp))) > 0.1
+                """)
+                bad_lines = conn.execute(q_ret_lines).fetchall()
+                
+                for row in bad_lines:
+                     # Avoid dupes
+                     # if row.doc_num in [x['title'] for x in issues]: continue
+                     
+                     real_total = row.sum_neto + row.sum_imp
+                     diff = float(row.total_neto - real_total)
+                     mone = row.co_mone.strip() if row.co_mone else ""
+                     
+                     issues.append({
+                        "id": str(row.rowguid),
+                        "type": "RETURN_LINE_MISMATCH",
+                        "severity": "critical",
+                        "title": f"Diferencia Renglones Devolución: {row.doc_num}",
+                        "description": f"Cabecera ({row.total_neto:,.2f} {mone}) difiere de la Suma de Renglones ({real_total:,.2f} {mone}). Diferencia: {diff:,.2f} {mone}",
+                        "meta": {"diff": diff, "real_total": float(real_total), "mone": mone}
+                    })
+
+
+                # Rule C: Return vs Credit Note (Monto Validation)
+                # Strategy: Find recent returns and try to find matching N/C
+                q_ret_nc = text("""
+                    SELECT top 50 H.doc_num, H.co_cli, H.total_neto, H.fec_emis, H.rowguid, H.co_mone
+                    FROM saDevolucionCliente H
+                    WHERE H.anulado = 0 AND H.status = '0' 
+                    AND MONTH(H.fec_emis) = MONTH(GETDATE()) 
+                    AND YEAR(H.fec_emis) = YEAR(GETDATE())
+                    ORDER BY H.fec_emis DESC
+                """)
+                recent_returns = conn.execute(q_ret_nc).fetchall()
+                
+                for ret in recent_returns:
+                    # Look for N/C for this Client on the same day (or close?)
+                    # Let's search by Date and Client first
+                    q_nc_candidates = text("""
+                        SELECT rowguid, nro_doc, total_neto, doc_orig, nro_orig
+                        FROM saDocumentoVenta 
+                        WHERE co_tipo_doc = 'N/CR' 
+                        AND co_cli = :cli 
+                        AND CAST(fec_emis AS DATE) = CAST(:date AS DATE)
+                    """)
+                    candidates = conn.execute(q_nc_candidates, {
+                        "cli": ret.co_cli, 
+                        "date": ret.fec_emis
+                    }).fetchall()
+                    
+                    match_found = False
+                    best_match = None
+                    
+                    for nc in candidates:
+                        # Check logic:
+                        # 1. Exact Amount Match
+                        if abs(nc.total_neto - ret.total_neto) < 0.1:
+                            match_found = True
+                            break
+                        # 2. Origin Match (if exists)
+                        if nc.nro_orig and nc.nro_orig.strip() == ret.doc_num.strip():
+                            match_found = True
+                            best_match = nc
+                            break
+                            
+                    if not match_found:
+                        if candidates:
+                            # Found N/C on same day but amount differs -> Mismatch
+                            # Pick the first one or the one closest?
+                            # Let's verify if manual fix needed
+                            issues.append({
+                                "id": str(ret.rowguid),
+                                "type": "NC_MISMATCH",
+                                "severity": "medium",
+                                "title": f"Diferencia N/C vs Devolución: {ret.doc_num}",
+                                "description": f"Devolución de {ret.total_neto:,.2f}. N/C encontradas ({len(candidates)}) pero montos no coinciden (Ej: {candidates[0].total_neto:,.2f}).",
+                                "meta": {"nc_doc": candidates[0].nro_doc, "nc_guid": str(candidates[0].rowguid)}
+                            })
+                        else:
+                            # No N/C found at all
+                            issues.append({
+                                "id": str(ret.rowguid),
+                                "type": "NC_MISSING",
+                                "severity": "medium",
+                                "title": f"Falta Nota de Crédito: {ret.doc_num}",
+                                "description": f"No se halló ninguna N/C del cliente {ret.co_cli} para la fecha {ret.fec_emis}.",

+    def fix_issue(issue_id, issue_type):

+<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js"></script>
+<script>
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fetchData);
+
+    function resetTabs(clickedTab) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(t => {
+            if (t !== clickedTab) {
+                t.style.borderBottomColor = 'transparent';
+                t.style.color = '#495057';
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    async function fetchData() {
+        const tsEl = document.getElementById('timestamp');
+        tsEl.innerHTML = 'Actualizando...';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/alerts/api/data');
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (data.status === 'no_data') {
+                tsEl.innerHTML = 'Sin datos recientes.';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            // Update Timestamp
+            tsEl.innerHTML = `Actualizado: <strong>${data.timestamp}</strong>`;
+
+            // Render Audit
+            renderAudit(data.audit);
+
+            // Render Purchasing
+            renderPurchasing(data.purchasing);
+
+            // Render Summary
+            if (data.summary) {
+                document.getElementById('ai-summary-content').innerHTML = marked.parse(data.summary);
+            }
+
+            // KPIs
+            calculateKPIs(data.audit, data.purchasing);
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            tsEl.innerHTML = 'Error de conexión.';
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderAudit(items) {
+        const tbody = document.querySelector('#table-audit tbody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        items.forEach(item => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            const descuadre = Math.abs(item.descuadre);
+            const stockMin = item.stock_min;
+            let percentage = 0;
+            if (stockMin > 0) percentage = (descuadre / stockMin);
+
+            let status = '<span class="badge" style="background-color: #e0e0e0; color: #333;">Normal</span>';
+            let rowStyle = '';
+
+            // Critical Logic
+            if (stockMin == 0 || percentage > 0.05) {
+                status = '<span class="badge" style="background-color: #d9534f; color: white;">CRÍTICO</span>';
+                tr.style.fontWeight = "500";
+            } else if (descuadre > 0) {
+                status = '<span class="badge" style="background-color: #f0ad4e; color: white;">Atención</span>';
+            }
+
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td>${item.co_art}</td>
+                <td>${item.art_des}</td>
+                <td class="text-end">${Number(item.stock_min).toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td class="text-end fw-bold">${Number(item.total_lotes).toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td class="text-end text-danger">-${Number(descuadre).toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td class="text-center">${status}</td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderPurchasing(items) {
+        const tbody = document.querySelector('#table-purchasing tbody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        items.forEach(item => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td>${item.materia_prima}</td>
+                <td class="text-end">${Number(item.consumo_proyectado).toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td class="text-end fw-bold" style="color: #714B67;">${Number(item.meta_con_reserva).toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td class="text-center"><span class="badge" style="background-color: #5bc0de; color: white;">Verificar</span></td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    function calculateKPIs(audit, purchasing) {
+        document.getElementById('kpi-total').innerText = audit.length;
+        document.getElementById('kpi-purchasing').innerText = purchasing.length;
+
+        let critical = 0;
+        audit.forEach(item => {
+            const d = Math.abs(item.descuadre);
+            const s = item.stock_min;
+            if (s == 0 || (s > 0 && (d / s) > 0.05)) {
+                critical++;
+            }
+        });
+        document.getElementById('kpi-critical').innerText = critical;
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+        <div id="ai-issues-container" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem;">
+            <!-- Issues will be injected here -->
+        </div>
+
+        <div id="ai-clean-state"
+            style="display: none; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);">
+            <span>✅</span>
+            <span>Todos los sistemas operativos. No se detectaron anomalías en el stock.</span>

+{% endif %}

+<div class="chat-container">
+    <div class="chat-header">
+        <div class="ai-avatar">👩‍💼</div>
+        <div>

+                <span style="width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--success); border-radius: 50%;"></span>
+                En línea
+            </div>
+        </div>
+        <button onclick="loadAlerts()"
+            style="margin-left: auto; background: white; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); transition: all 0.2s;">
+            <span style="font-size: 1.1rem;">🔔</span> Notificaciones
+        </button>
+    </div>
+
+    <div class="chat-messages" id="chatMessages">
+        <!-- Introduction -->
+        <div class="message ai">
+            <div class="ai-avatar" style="width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 1rem;">👩‍💼</div>
+            <div class="message-content">
+                ¡Hola! Soy Belén, tu supervisora inteligente. 👋<br>
+                Puedo ayudarte a analizar el rendimiento de tu planta, detectar mermas y resumir la producción
+                diaria.<br><br>
+                ¿Qué te gustaría revisar hoy?
+            </div>
+        </div>
+    </div>
+
+    <div class="chat-input-area">
+        <h4 style="margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted);">Configuración de Análisis</h4>
+
+        <!-- Single Date Filter -->
+        <div
+            style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; align-items: center; background: #f8fafc; padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
+            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
+                <label style="font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500;">Desde:</label>
+                <input type="date" id="dateStart"
+                    style="border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.25rem;">
+            </div>
+            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
+                <label style="font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500;">Hasta:</label>
+                <input type="date" id="dateEnd"
+                    style="border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.25rem;">
+            </div>
+            <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-left: auto;">(Aplica a todas las
+                opciones)</span>
+        </div>
+
+        <div class="quick-actions" style="justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; padding-bottom: 0.5rem;">
+            <button class="chip" onclick="executeAction('Rendimiento')"
+                style="border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); font-weight: 500;">
+                📊 Analizar Rendimiento
+            </button>
+            <button class="chip" onclick="executeAction('Resumen')"
+                style="border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); font-weight: 500;">
+                📅 Resumen General
+            </button>
+            <button class="chip" onclick="executeAction('Problemas')"
+                style="border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--danger); font-weight: 500;">
+                🚨 Detectar Problemas
+            </button>
+        </div>
+
+        <!-- Free Form Chat Input -->
+        <div class="input-wrapper" style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">
+            <input type="text" id="userMessage" placeholder="Escribe un mensaje a Supervisor Belén..."
+                onkeypress="if(event.key === 'Enter') sendUserChat()">
+            <button class="send-btn" onclick="sendUserChat()">➤</button>
+        </div>
+    </div>

+<script>
+    const chatMessages = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
+
+    function executeAction(type) {
+        const start = document.getElementById('dateStart').value;
+        const end = document.getElementById('dateEnd').value;
+
+        let label = "";
+        let filterText = "";
+
+        if (start && end) filterText = ` (del ${start} al ${end})`;
+        else if (start) filterText = ` (desde ${start})`;
+
+        if (type === 'Rendimiento') label = "📊 Analizar Rendimiento" + filterText;
+        if (type === 'Resumen') label = "📅 Resumen General" + filterText;
+        if (type === 'Problemas') label = "🚨 Detectar Problemas" + filterText;
+
+        askAI(label, type, start, end);
+    }
+
+    function askAI(displayText, type, start, end) {
+        addMessage(displayText, 'user');
+        showTypingInfo();
+
+        setTimeout(async () => {
+            removeTypingInfo();
+
+            // Fetch with filters
+            const data = await fetchDashboardData(start, end);
+
+            if (type === 'Rendimiento') respondCompliance(data);
+            else if (type === 'Resumen') respondSummary(data);
+            else if (type === 'Problemas') respondProblems(data);
+
+        }, 1000);
+    }
+
+    // UI Helpers
+    function addMessage(html, type) {
+        const div = document.createElement('div');
+        div.className = `message ${type}`;
+
+        let avatar = '';
+        if (type === 'ai') {
+            avatar = `<div class="ai-avatar" style="width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 1rem;">👩‍💼</div>`;
+        }
+
+        div.innerHTML = `
+            ${avatar}
+            <div class="message-content">${html}</div>
+        `;
+
+        chatMessages.appendChild(div);
+        chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
+    }
+
+    function showTypingInfo() {
+        const div = document.createElement('div');
+        div.id = 'typing';
+        div.className = 'typing-indicator';
+        div.innerHTML = '<div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div>';
+        chatMessages.appendChild(div);
+        chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
+    }
+
+    function removeTypingInfo() {
+        const el = document.getElementById('typing');
+        if (el) el.remove();
+    }
+
+    // Data Fetching logic with Dates
+    async function fetchDashboardData(start, end) {
+        try {
+            let url = '/api/dashboard';
+            const params = new URLSearchParams();
+            if (start) params.append('start_date', start);
+            if (end) params.append('end_date', end);
+
+            if (params.toString()) url += '?' + params.toString();
+
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            return await res.json();
+        } catch (e) {
+            return null;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Intent Responses
+    function respondCompliance(data) {
+        if (!data) return addMessage("Lo siento, no pude acceder a los datos.", 'ai');
+
+        let msg = `El cumplimiento de planificación es del <strong>${data.compliance_percentage.toFixed(1)}%</strong>. `;
+
+        if (data.compliance_percentage >= 95) {
+            msg += "<br><br>✅ <strong>Estado Excelente:</strong> La producción está alineada con lo planificado.";
+        } else if (data.compliance_percentage >= 80) {
+            msg += "<br><br>⚠️ <strong>Atención:</strong> Hay un ligero desvío, pero estamos en rangos aceptables.";
+        } else {
+            msg += "<br><br>❌ <strong>Crítico:</strong> Estamos significativamente por debajo del plan.";
+        }
+
+        addMessage(msg, 'ai');
+    }
+
+    function respondSummary(data) {
+        if (!data) return addMessage("Error al cargar datos.", 'ai');
+
+        let table = `
+            <table>
+                <tr><th>Métrica</th><th>Valor</th></tr>
+                <tr><td>Producción Total</td><td>${data.total_production_kg.toFixed(2)} Kg</td></tr>
+                <tr><td>Cajas</td><td>${data.total_production_boxes.toFixed(0)}</td></tr>
+                <tr><td>Unidades</td><td>${data.total_production_units}</td></tr>
+            </table>
+        `;
+
+        addMessage(`Aquí tienes el resumen actualizado de la producción: <br>${table}`, 'ai');
+    }
+
+    function respondProblems(data) {
+        if (!data) return;
+
+        let issues = [];
+        if (data.compliance_percentage < 85) issues.push("Bajo cumplimiento de planificacion");
+        if (data.yield_percentage < 90) issues.push("Rendimiento (Kg/Kg) por debajo del estándar");
+
+        if (issues.length === 0) {
+            addMessage("🎉 No detecto problemas críticos en este momento. La operación fluye con normalidad.", 'ai');
+        } else {
+            addMessage(`He detectado las siguientes anomalías que requieren atención:<br><ul><li>${issues.join('</li><li>')}</li></ul>`, 'ai');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadAlerts() {
+        addMessage("🔍 Buscando alertas de análisis de inteligencia...", 'user');
+        showTypingInfo();
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/assistant/alerts');
+            const alerts = await res.json();
+
+            removeTypingInfo();
+
+            if (!alerts || alerts.length === 0) {
+                addMessage("✅ No hay alertas pendientes. Todo está en orden.", 'ai');
+                return;
+            }
+
+            addMessage(`He encontrado <strong>${alerts.length} alertas</strong> que requieren tu atención:`, 'ai');
+
+            // Build Alerts HTML
+            let html = '<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;">';
+
+            alerts.forEach(alert => {
+                let badgeClass = 'badge-ok';
+                let icon = '✅';
+                if (alert.status === 'CRÍTICO' || alert.severity === 'critical' || alert.severity === 'high') {
+                    badgeClass = 'badge-critical';
+                    icon = '⚠️';
+                } else if (alert.status === 'WARNING' || alert.severity === 'medium') {
+                    badgeClass = 'badge-warning';
+                    icon = '🔸';
+                }
+
+                // Items List
+                let itemsList = alert.items.map(i => `<li>${i}</li>`).join('');
+
+                html += `
+                <div class="alert-card">
+                    <div class="alert-header">
+                        <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b;">#${alert.id}</div>
+                        <div class="alert-badge ${badgeClass}">${icon} ${alert.status}</div>
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <div class="alert-client">${alert.client || 'Cliente Desconocido'}</div>
+                    
+                    <div class="alert-refs">
+                        <span class="ref-badge">📄 ${alert.guide_ref}</span>
+                        ${alert.invoice_ref ? `<span class="ref-badge" style="background:#f1f5f9; color:#64748b;">🧾 ${alert.invoice_ref}</span>` : ''}
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <div class="alert-items">
+                        <strong>Resumen de Ítems:</strong>
+                        <ul style="margin: 0.25rem 0 0 1.2rem; padding: 0;">${itemsList}</ul>
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <button class="toggle-btn" onclick="toggleDesc('desc-${alert.id}', this)">⬇️ Ver Descripción Completa</button>
+                    
+                    <div id="desc-${alert.id}" class="alert-desc-container">
+                        <div class="alert-desc-title">ANÁLISIS DE INTELIGENCIA:</div>
+                        <div class="alert-desc-text">${alert.description || 'Sin descripción detallada.'}</div>
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <div style="text-align: right; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 0.5rem;">
+                        ${alert.date}
+                    </div>
+                </div>`;
+            });
+
+            html += '</div>';
+
+            // Append directly to chat special
+            const div = document.createElement('div');
+            div.className = 'message ai';
+            div.innerHTML = `
+                <div class="ai-avatar" style="width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 1rem;">👩‍💼</div>
+                <div class="message-content" style="background: transparent; padding: 0; box-shadow: none; width: 100%; max-width: 100%;">${html}</div>
+            `;
+            chatMessages.appendChild(div);
+            // Scroll to bottom
+            chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            removeTypingInfo();
+            console.error(e);
+            addMessage("❌ Error al cargar las alertas.", 'ai');
+        }
+    }
+
+    function toggleDesc(id, btn) {
+        const el = document.getElementById(id);
+        if (el.style.display === 'block') {
+            el.style.display = 'none';
+            btn.innerHTML = '⬇️ Ver Descripción Completa';
+        } else {
+            el.style.display = 'block';
+            btn.innerHTML = '⬆️ Ocultar Descripción';
+        }
+    }
+
+    // ── AI Supervisor Diagnostics ──────────────────────────────
+    async function refreshAIDiagnostics() {
+        const container = document.getElementById('ai-supervisor-section');
+        const list = document.getElementById('ai-issues-container');
+        const cleanMsg = document.getElementById('ai-clean-state');
+
+        list.innerHTML = '<div style="opacity: 0.7; color: white;">Analizando base de datos...</div>';
+        cleanMsg.style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/diagnose');
+            const issues = await res.json();
+
+            list.innerHTML = '';
+
+            if (issues.length === 0) {
+                cleanMsg.style.display = 'flex';
+            } else {
+                issues.forEach(issue => {
+                    const div = document.createElement('div');
+                    div.style.cssText = `
+                        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
+                        color: #1e293b;
+                        padding: 1rem;
+                        border-radius: 8px;
+                        display: flex;
+                        justify-content: space-between;
+                        align-items: center;
+                        gap: 1rem;
+                        border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;
+                    `;
+                    div.innerHTML = `
+                        <div>
+                            <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.95rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
+                                ⚠️ ${issue.title}
+                                <span style="background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;">${issue.severity}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">${issue.description}</div>
+                        </div>
+                    `;
+                    list.appendChild(div);
+                });
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color: #fca5a5;">Error de conexión con el servicio AI.</div>';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function fixIssue(id, type, btn) {
+        const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Procesando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.style.opacity = 0.7;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/fix', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify({ id, type })
+            });
+
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                btn.innerHTML = '✅ Corregido';
+                btn.style.background = '#22c55e';
+                setTimeout(() => { refreshAIDiagnostics(); }, 1500);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + result.detail);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+                btn.style.opacity = 1;
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de red");
+            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Auto-escanear al cargar
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        refreshAIDiagnostics();
+    });
+    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+    async function sendUserChat() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('userMessage');
+        const msg = input.value.trim();
+        if (!msg) return;
+
+        addMessage(msg, 'user');
+        input.value = '';
+        showTypingInfo();
+
+        try {
+            const formData = new FormData();
+            formData.append('message', msg);
+
+            const res = await fetch('/api/assistant/chat', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            removeTypingInfo();
+            addMessage(data.response, 'ai');
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            removeTypingInfo();
+            addMessage("❌ Error de conexión.", 'ai');
+        }
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+{% block scripts %}
+<script>
+    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadConfig);
+
+    function switchTab(tabId) {
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl1').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl2').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent1').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('tabContent2').style.display = 'none';
+
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl' + tabId).classList.add('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent' + tabId).style.display = 'block';
+    }
+
+    function toggleRibbon() {
+        const isActive = document.getElementById('inputActive').checked;
+        const ribbon = document.getElementById('activeRibbon');
+        if (isActive) {
+            ribbon.classList.add('active');
+            ribbon.style.background = '#28a745';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Activo';
+        } else {
+            ribbon.classList.add('active');
+            ribbon.style.background = '#6c757d';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Archivado / Inactivo';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadConfig() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/automation-admin/api/config');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            document.getElementById('inputEmails').value = data.emails;
+            document.getElementById('inputCron').value = data.cron_schedule;
+            document.getElementById('inputActive').checked = data.is_active;
+            toggleRibbon();
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error cargando la configuración. Servidor inaccesible.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function saveConfig() {
+        showToast('Guardando...');
+        const payload = {
+            emails: document.getElementById('inputEmails').value.trim(),
+            cron_schedule: document.getElementById('inputCron').value.trim(),
+            is_active: document.getElementById('inputActive').checked
+        };
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/automation-admin/api/config', {
+                method: 'PUT',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (res.ok) {
+                if (data.warning) {
+                    showToast('Guardado. Alerta: ' + data.warning);
+                } else {
+                    showToast('Configuración guardada exitosamente.');
+                }
+            } else {
+                showToast('Error al guardar en base de datos.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error de red al intentar guardar.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function runNow() {
+        switchTab(1); // switch to console tab
+        if (!confirm('¿Desea despachar el agente bot manualmente ahora mismo? Toma algunos minutos.')) return;
+        showToast('Iniciando secuencias del agente bot. No recargue.');
+
+        const logger = document.getElementById('consoleLog');
+        logger.textContent = "> Inicializando conexión SSH y localizando entorno OpenClaw...\n> Despachando Prompt...\n> Esperando respuesta remota y ejecución visual...\n\n";
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/automation-admin/api/run-now', { method: 'POST' });
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                showToast('Secuencia finalizada con éxito.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- TERMINADO CORRECTAMENTE ---\n\n" + data.output;
+            } else {
+                const err = await res.json();
+                showToast('Ocurrió un error en la automatización.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- ERROR ---\n\n" + (err.detail || 'Fallo en la ejecución remota.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Time-out o error de enlace.');
+            logger.textContent += "--- ENLACE CORTADO ---\nNetwork Timeout o error de conexión.";
+        }
+    }
+
+    function showToast(msg, dur = 3000) {
+        const t = document.getElementById('toast');
+        t.innerText = msg;
+        t.style.display = 'block';
+        clearTimeout(window._toastTimer);
+        window._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', dur);
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+    async function loadMRP() {
+        const m = document.getElementById('selMonth').value;
+        const y = document.getElementById('inpYear').value;
+
+        document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'block';
+        document.getElementById('mrpTable').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/purchasing/api/mrp/alerts?month=${m}&year=${y}`);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Error interno al calcular MRP");
+
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (data.data.length === 0) {
+                alert(data.message || "No existen proyecciones de venta almacenadas para explotar en este mes.");
+                document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'none';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            renderTable(data.data);
+
+            document.getElementById('mrpTable').style.display = 'table';
+            document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'grid';
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Fallo la conexión con MRP / Profit Plus.");
+        } finally {
+            document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderTable(rows) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('mrpBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        let cRed = 0, cYellow = 0, cGreen = 0;
+
+        rows.forEach((row) => {
+            let badgeHtml = '';
+            let bgStyle = '';
+
+            if (row.status === 'red') {
+                cRed++;
+                badgeHtml = '<span style="display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#ef4444; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6);"></span>';
+                bgStyle = 'background: #fef2f2;';
+            } else if (row.status === 'yellow') {
+                cYellow++;
+                badgeHtml = '<span style="display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#f59e0b;"></span>';
+            } else {
+                cGreen++;
+                badgeHtml = '<span style="display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#10b981;"></span>';
+            }
+
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.style.cssText = `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); transition: background 0.2s; ${bgStyle}`;
+            tr.onmouseover = () => { if (!bgStyle) tr.style.background = '#f8fafc'; };
+            tr.onmouseout = () => { if (!bgStyle) tr.style.background = 'transparent'; };
+
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center;">${badgeHtml}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight:600; color:#475569;">${row.co_art}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500;">${row.art_des}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a;">${row.demand.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #3b82f6;">${row.stock.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; color: ${row.shortage > 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#cbd5e1'}; font-size:1.05rem;">
+                    ${row.shortage > 0 ? row.shortage.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : '-'}
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem; color:#94a3b8; font-weight:600;">${row.uom}</td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+
+        // Animated counter effect (optional polish)
+        document.getElementById('statRed').innerText = cRed;
+        document.getElementById('statYellow').innerText = cYellow;
+        document.getElementById('statGreen').innerText = cGreen;
+    }
+
+    async function syncProfit() {
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnSync');
+        const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
+
+        if (!confirm("¿Estás seguro de querer forzar una sincronización masiva desde Profit Plus? Esto actualizará Fórmulas, Artículos y Stock.")) return;
+
+        try {
+            btn.innerHTML = '<svg class="animate-spin" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="animation: spin 1s linear infinite;"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56"></path></svg> Sincronizando... (1m)';
+            btn.disabled = true;
+
+            const res = await fetch("/api/mrp/sync", {
+                method: "POST"
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || "Error interno");
+
+            alert(data.message);
+            // Reload the table since stock probably changed
+            loadMRP();
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("No se pudo sincronizar: " + e.message);
+        } finally {
+            btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+</script>

+{% block scripts %}
+<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
+<script>
+    let allData = [];
+    let chartInstance = null;
+
+    // ── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        const hoy = new Date();
+        const primerDia = new Date(hoy.getFullYear(), hoy.getMonth(), 1);
+        document.getElementById('fechaIni').value = primerDia.toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        document.getElementById('fechaFin').value = hoy.toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        loadDashboard();
+    });
+
+    async function loadDashboard() {
+        const fi = document.getElementById('fechaIni').value;
+        const ff = document.getElementById('fechaFin').value;
+        const ventas = document.getElementById('chkVentas').checked;
+        const pedidos = document.getElementById('chkPedidos').checked;
+        const cotizaciones = document.getElementById('chkCotizaciones').checked;
+
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnRefresh');
+        btn.textContent = '⏳ Cargando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+
+        setLoadingState(true);
+
+        try {
+            const params = new URLSearchParams({
+                fecha_ini: fi,
+                fecha_fin: ff,
+                include_ventas: ventas,
+                include_pedidos: pedidos,
+                include_cotizaciones: cotizaciones
+            });
+            const res = await fetch(`/compras-mp/api/dashboard?${params}`);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (data.errors && Object.keys(data.errors).length > 0) {
+                console.warn('Errores del backend:', data.errors);
+            }
+
+            allData = data.balance || [];
+            renderKpis(data.kpis || {});
+            renderTable(allData);
+            renderChart(allData.slice(0, 10));
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            showToast('❌ Error al cargar datos: ' + e.message, 5000);
+        } finally {
+            btn.textContent = '🔄 Actualizar';
+            btn.disabled = false;
+            setLoadingState(false);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderKpis(k) {
+        document.getElementById('kpiTotal').textContent = k.total_articulos ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiCriticos').textContent = k.criticos ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiAlertas').textContent = k.alertas ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiOk').textContent = k.ok ?? '—';
+        document.getElementById('kpiCobertura').textContent = (k.cobertura_global_pct ?? '—') + '%';
+        document.getElementById('kpiDeficit').textContent = formatNum(k.total_deficit ?? 0);
+    }
+
+    function renderTable(data) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('tbodyMP');
+        if (!data.length) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:#94a3b8;">
+                <div style="font-size:2rem;">📦</div>Sin datos para el período seleccionado.<br>
+                <small>Verifique que existen tablas de fórmulas en Profit Plus</small></td></tr>`;
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const filtroText = document.getElementById('filtroTabla').value.toLowerCase();
+        const filtroSem = document.getElementById('filtroSemaforo').value;
+
+        const filtered = data.filter(r => {
+            const matchText = !filtroText || r.des_art_mp.toLowerCase().includes(filtroText) || r.co_art_mp.toLowerCase().includes(filtroText);
+            const matchSem = !filtroSem || r.semaforo === filtroSem;
+            return matchText && matchSem;
+        });
+
+        tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(r => {
+            const emoji = r.semaforo === 'rojo' ? '🔴' : r.semaforo === 'amarillo' ? '🟡' : '🟢';
+            const pctColor = r.semaforo === 'rojo' ? '#ef4444' : r.semaforo === 'amarillo' ? '#f59e0b' : '#10b981';
+            const rowBg = r.semaforo === 'rojo' ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.04)' : r.semaforo === 'amarillo' ? 'rgba(245,158,11,0.04)' : '';
+            return `
+                <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9; background: ${rowBg};" onmouseover="this.style.background='#f8fafc'" onmouseout="this.style.background='${rowBg}'">
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; color:#1e293b;">
+                        <div style="font-weight:600; font-size:0.82rem;">${escHtml(r.des_art_mp)}</div>
+                        <div style="font-size:0.72rem; color:#94a3b8;">${escHtml(r.co_art_mp)}</div>
+                    </td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:center; color:#64748b;">${escHtml(r.unidad)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:right; color:#374151;">${formatNum(r.requerido)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:right; color:#374151;">${formatNum(r.comprado)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:right; color:${r.deficit > 0 ? '#ef4444' : '#10b981'}; font-weight:${r.deficit > 0 ? '700' : '400'};">${formatNum(r.deficit)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:center;">
+                        <div style="background:#f1f5f9; border-radius:20px; height:7px; overflow:hidden; width:80px; margin: 0 auto 3px;">
+                            <div style="height:100%; width:${Math.min(r.cobertura_pct, 100)}%; background:${pctColor}; border-radius:20px;"></div>
+                        </div>
+                        <span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:${pctColor}; font-weight:700;">${r.cobertura_pct}%</span>
+                    </td>
+                    <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:center; font-size:1.1rem;">${emoji}</td>
+                </tr>
+            `;
+        }).join('');
+
+        if (!filtered.length) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:20px; color:#94a3b8;">Sin resultados para el filtro aplicado</td></tr>`;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function filterTable() {
+        renderTable(allData);
+    }
+
+    function renderChart(data) {
+        const ctx = document.getElementById('chartBar').getContext('2d');
+        if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy();
+
+        const labels = data.map(d => d.des_art_mp.length > 30 ? d.des_art_mp.substring(0, 30) + '…' : d.des_art_mp);
+        const requerido = data.map(d => d.requerido);
+        const comprado = data.map(d => d.comprado);
+
+        chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
+            type: 'bar',
+            data: {
+                labels,
+                datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Requerido', data: requerido, backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.75)', borderRadius: 3 },
+                    { label: 'Comprado', data: comprado, backgroundColor: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.75)', borderRadius: 3 }
+                ]
+            },
+            options: {
+                responsive: true,
+                maintainAspectRatio: false,
+                plugins: {
+                    legend: { position: 'top', labels: { font: { size: 11 } } },
+                    tooltip: {
+                        callbacks: {
+                            label: ctx => ` ${ctx.dataset.label}: ${Number(ctx.parsed.y).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 0 })}`
+                        }
+                    }
+                },
+                scales: {
+                    x: { ticks: { font: { size: 10 }, maxRotation: 35 } },
+                    y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { font: { size: 10 } } }
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    async function triggerAlert() {
+        if (!confirm('¿Enviar alerta MP a todos los suscriptores Telegram activos?')) return;
+        showToast('📡 Enviando alertas...', 3000);
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/compras-mp/api/send-alert-now', { method: 'POST' });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (data.success) {
+                showToast(`✅ ${data.result.sent} alerta(s) enviada(s) — ${data.result.errors} error(es)`, 5000);
+            } else {
+                showToast('❌ Error: ' + (data.error || 'Desconocido'), 7000);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('❌ Error de conexión', 5000);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    function setLoadingState(loading) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('tbodyMP');
+        if (loading) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:#94a3b8;"><div style="font-size:1.5rem;">⏳</div> Consultando Profit Plus...</td></tr>`;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function formatNum(n) {
+        return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
+    }
+
+    function escHtml(str) {
+        return String(str || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
+    }
+
+    function showToast(msg, dur = 3000) {
+        const t = document.getElementById('toast');
+        t.textContent = msg;
+        t.style.display = 'block';
+        setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', dur);
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+<script>
+    let historyChartInstance = null;
+    let pieChartInstance = null;
+
+    async function loadDashboard() {
+        const start = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
+        const end = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
+        let url = '/api/dashboard';
+
+        const params = new URLSearchParams();
+        if (start) params.append('start_date', start);
+        if (end) params.append('end_date', end);
+
+        if (params.toString()) url += '?' + params.toString();
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error fetching stats');
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            // KPIs
+            document.getElementById('compliancePct').textContent = data.compliance_percentage.toFixed(1);
+            document.getElementById('yieldPct').textContent = data.yield_percentage.toFixed(1);
+            document.getElementById('wastePct').textContent = data.waste_percentage.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('wasteKg').textContent = data.total_waste_kg.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('avgKgBatch').textContent = data.avg_kg_per_batch.toFixed(1);
+            document.getElementById('quickConsPct').textContent = data.quick_consumption_percentage.toFixed(1);
+
+            // Production Stats
+            document.getElementById('prodBatches').textContent = data.total_production_batches;
+            document.getElementById('prodKg').textContent = data.total_production_kg.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('prodUnits').textContent = data.total_production_units;
+
+            // Planning Stats
+            document.getElementById('planBatches').textContent = data.total_planned_batches;
+            document.getElementById('planKg').textContent = data.total_planned_kg.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('planUnits').textContent = data.total_planned_units;
+
+            // --- Render Charts ---
+
+            // 1. Pie Chart
+            const pieCtx = document.getElementById('pieChart').getContext('2d');
+            if (pieChartInstance) pieChartInstance.destroy();
+
+            const pieLabels = data.pie_data.map(d => d.label);
+            const pieValues = data.pie_data.map(d => d.value);
+
+            pieChartInstance = new Chart(pieCtx, {
+                type: 'doughnut',
+                data: {
+                    labels: pieLabels,
+                    datasets: [{
+                        data: pieValues,
+                        backgroundColor: [
+                            '#4a90e2', '#50e3c2', '#b8e986', '#f5a623', '#d0021b', '#9b9b9b'
+                        ]
+                    }]
+                },
+                options: {
+                    responsive: true,
+                    plugins: {
+                        legend: { position: 'bottom' }
+                    }
+                }
+            });
+
+            // 2. History Chart (Bar vs Line)
+            const historyCtx = document.getElementById('historyChart').getContext('2d');
+            if (historyChartInstance) historyChartInstance.destroy();
+
+            const histDates = data.history_data.map(d => d.date);
+            const histProduced = data.history_data.map(d => d.produced);
+            const histPlanned = data.history_data.map(d => d.planned);
+
+            historyChartInstance = new Chart(historyCtx, {
+                type: 'bar',
+                data: {
+                    labels: histDates,
+                    datasets: [
+                        {
+                            label: 'Producido (Kg)',
+                            data: histProduced,
+                            backgroundColor: '#4a90e2',
+                            order: 2
+                        },
+                        {
+                            label: 'Planificado (Kg)',
+                            data: histPlanned,
+                            type: 'line', // Line overlay to show target
+                            borderColor: '#d0021b',
+                            borderWidth: 2,
+                            fill: false,
+                            tension: 0.1,
+                            order: 1
+                        }
+                    ]
+                },
+                options: {
+                    responsive: true,
+                    interaction: {
+                        mode: 'index',
+                        intersect: false,
+                    }
+                }
+            });
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function clearFilter() {
+        document.getElementById('startDate').value = '';
+        document.getElementById('endDate').value = '';
+        loadDashboard();
+    }
+
+    // Date Validation Logic
+    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+    // First day of current month
+    const dateObj = new Date();
+    const firstDay = new Date(dateObj.getFullYear(), dateObj.getMonth(), 1).toISOString().split('T')[0];
+
+    const dateStart = document.getElementById('startDate');
+    const dateEnd = document.getElementById('endDate');
+
+    // Set default if empty (Month to Date)
+    if (!dateStart.value) dateStart.value = firstDay;
+    if (!dateEnd.value) dateEnd.value = today;
+
+    function validateDateRange() {
+        if (dateStart.value && dateEnd.value && dateStart.value > dateEnd.value) {
+            alert("Fecha inválida: La fecha final no puede ser menor a la inicial.");
+            dateEnd.value = dateStart.value;
+        }
+    }
+
+    dateStart.addEventListener('change', validateDateRange);
+    dateEnd.addEventListener('change', validateDateRange);
+
+    // AI Supervisor Logic
+    async function refreshAIDiagnostics() {
+        const container = document.getElementById('ai-supervisor-section');
+        const list = document.getElementById('ai-issues-container');
+        const cleanMsg = document.getElementById('ai-clean-state');
+
+        // Show section
+        container.style.display = 'block';
+        list.innerHTML = '<div style="opacity: 0.7;">Analizando base de datos...</div>';
+        cleanMsg.style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/diagnose');
+            const issues = await res.json();
+
+            list.innerHTML = '';
+
+            if (issues.length === 0) {
+                cleanMsg.style.display = 'flex';
+            } else {
+                issues.forEach(issue => {
+                    const div = document.createElement('div');
+                    div.style.cssText = `
+                        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
+                        color: #1e293b;
+                        padding: 1rem;
+                        border-radius: 8px;
+                        display: flex;
+                        justify-content: space-between;
+                        align-items: center;
+                        gap: 1rem;
+                        border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;
+                    `;
+
+                    div.innerHTML = `
+                        <div>
+                            <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.95rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
+                                ⚠️ ${issue.title}
+                                <span style="background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;">${issue.severity}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">${issue.description}</div>
+                        </div>
+                        <button onclick="fixIssue('${issue.id}', '${issue.type}', this)" 
+                            style="background: #dc2626; color: white; border: none; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.2s;">
+                            ✨ Corregir con AI
+                        </button>
+                    `;
+                    list.appendChild(div);
+                });
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color: #fca5a5;">Error de conexión con el servicio AI.</div>';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function fixIssue(id, type, btn) {
+        const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Procesando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.style.opacity = 0.7;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/fix', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify({ id, type })
+            });
+
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                btn.innerHTML = '✅ Corregido';
+                btn.style.background = '#22c55e';
+                setTimeout(() => {
+                    // Refresh checks
+                    refreshAIDiagnostics();
+                }, 1500);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + result.detail);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+                btn.style.opacity = 1;
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de red");
+            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Auto-load AI Supervisor
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        refreshAIDiagnostics();
+    });
+
+    loadDashboard();
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+<script>
+    let currentView = 'inbox'; // inbox, starred, history
+
+    async function loadChannels() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/discuss/api/channels');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            const list = document.getElementById('channelsList');
+            list.innerHTML = '';
+            data.forEach(c => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.className = 'discuss-nav-item';
+                div.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #714B67; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 8px;">#</span> ${c.name}`;
+                div.onclick = () => { alert('Channel view not fully implemented yet, showing Inbox for demo'); loadMessages('inbox'); };
+                list.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
+    }
+    loadChannels();
+
+    async function loadMessages(view) {
+        currentView = view;
+
+        // Update Title
+        const labels = { 'inbox': '📥 Bandeja de entrada', 'starred': '⭐ Destacado', 'history': '🕒 Historial' };
+        document.getElementById('currentViewTitle').textContent = labels[view];
+
+        // Update Sidebar Active
+        document.querySelectorAll('.discuss-nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
+        const navId = 'nav-' + view;
+        const navEl = document.getElementById(navId);
+        if (navEl) navEl.classList.add('active');
+
+        // Fetch
+        const container = document.getElementById('messageContainer');
+        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:20px; text-align:center;">Cargando...</div>';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/discuss/api/messages/${view}`);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            container.innerHTML = '';
+            if (data.length === 0) {
+                container.innerHTML = `
+                    <div style="display: flex; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; color: #666;">
+                        <div style="font-size: 4rem; opacity: 0.2; margin-bottom: 20px;">${view === 'starred' ? '⭐' : '📥'}</div>
+                        <h3 style="margin: 0; color: #444;">${view === 'inbox' ? 'Bandeja vacía' : 'Sin mensajes'}</h3>
+                        <p style="color: #888; margin-top: 10px;">¡Estás al día!</p>
+                    </div>`;
+                return;
+            }
+
+            data.forEach(msg => {
+                const item = document.createElement('div');
+                item.className = 'message-item';
+
+                // Avatar
+                const avatar = `<img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${msg.author}&background=random" style="width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;">`;
+
+                // Star Class
+                const starClass = msg.is_starred ? 'starred' : '';
+
+                // Actions based on view
+                let actionsHtml = '';
+                if (view === 'inbox') {
+                    actionsHtml += `<span class="action-icon" onclick="markRead(${msg.id})" title="Marcar como leído">✓</span>`;
+                }
+                actionsHtml += `<span class="action-icon ${starClass}" onclick="toggleStar(${msg.id})" title="Destacar">★</span>`;
+
+                item.innerHTML = `
+                    ${avatar}
+                    <div style="flex: 1;">
+                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;">
+                            <strong style="font-size: 0.95rem; color: #333;">${msg.author}</strong>
+                            <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888;">${msg.full_date} en <strong>${msg.channel}</strong></span>
+                        </div>
+                        <div style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #444; margin-top: 4px;">
+                            ${msg.body}
+                        </div>
+                    </div>
+                    <div class="message-actions">
+                        ${actionsHtml}
+                    </div>
+                `;
+                container.appendChild(item);
+            });
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            container.innerHTML = 'Error loading messages';
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Initial Load
+    loadMessages('inbox');
+
+    // Actions
+    async function markRead(id) {
+        await fetch(`/discuss/api/message/${id}/mark_read`, { method: 'POST' });
+        loadMessages(currentView); // Refresh
+    }
+
+    async function toggleStar(id) {
+        await fetch(`/discuss/api/message/${id}/star`, { method: 'POST' });
+        loadMessages(currentView); // Refresh
+    }
+
+    async function postMessage(e) {
+        e.preventDefault();
+        const body = document.getElementById('postBody').value;
+        const channelId = document.getElementById('postChannelId').value;
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('body', body);
+        fd.append('channel_id', channelId);
+
+        await fetch('/discuss/api/message', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+        document.getElementById('postBody').value = '';
+        loadMessages(currentView);
+    }
+</script>

+                </tbody>

+<script>
+    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
+
+    // Init Date
+    $('headerDate').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+
+    // Tabs Logic
+    function switchTab(tabName) {
+        // Toggle Headers
+        document.querySelectorAll('.o_notebook_tab').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
+        if (tabName === 'lines') document.querySelectorAll('.o_notebook_tab')[0].classList.add('active');
+        if (tabName === 'info') document.querySelectorAll('.o_notebook_tab')[1].classList.add('active');
+
+        // Toggle Content
+        $('tab-lines').style.display = tabName === 'lines' ? 'block' : 'none';
+        $('tab-info').style.display = tabName === 'info' ? 'block' : 'none';
+    }
+
+    // State
+    let currentLines = [];
+
+    // --- Reuse Search Logic ---
+    let articlesData = [];
+    async function loadArticles() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (res.ok) articlesData = await res.json();
+        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
+    }
+    loadArticles();
+
+    const searchInput = $('articleSearch');
+    const resultsDiv = $('articleResults');
+    const bInput = $('batchInput');
+
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        if (term.length < 1) { resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; return; }
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a => a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term));
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach(item => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.style.padding = '8px'; div.style.cursor = 'pointer'; div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onclick = () => {
+                    searchInput.value = item.description;
+                    $('articleCodeHidden').value = item.code;
+                    $('articleDescHidden').value = item.description;
+                    resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+                    bInput.focus();
+                };
+                div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f8f9fa';
+                div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else { resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; }
+    });
+    // Enter key to add line logic
+    $('qtyInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') addLine();
+    });
+    document.addEventListener('click', e => { if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; });
+
+    // --- Line Logic ---
+    function addLine() {
+        const code = $('articleCodeHidden').value;
+        const desc = $('articleDescHidden').value || searchInput.value; // Fallback if user typed manually (dangerous but flexible)
+        const batch = $('batchInput').value;
+        const qty = parseFloat($('qtyInput').value);
+
+        if (!desc || !qty || qty <= 0) {
+            // Subtle shake or red border? For now alert
+            // alert("Info Incompleta");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        currentLines.push({ article_code: code || 'MANUAL', article_description: desc, batch: batch || 'S/L', quantity: qty });
+        renderLines();
+
+        // Reset inputs
+        searchInput.value = '';
+        $('articleCodeHidden').value = '';
+        $('articleDescHidden').value = '';
+        $('batchInput').value = '';
+        $('qtyInput').value = '';
+        searchInput.focus();
+    }
+
+    function removeLine(index) {
+        currentLines.splice(index, 1);
+        renderLines();
+    }
+
+    function renderLines() {
+        const tbody = $('linesTableBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        currentLines.forEach((line, idx) => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td>${line.article_description} <span style="color:#888; font-size:0.8rem;">[${line.article_code}]</span></td>
+                <td>${line.batch}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: right;">${line.quantity.toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: center;">
+                    <span onclick="removeLine(${idx})" style="cursor: pointer; color: #dc3545; font-size: 1.1rem;" title="Eliminar">&times;</span>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    // --- Save Logic ---
+    async function saveFullCapture() {
+        if (currentLines.length === 0) {
+            alert("Agregue al menos una línea.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = {
+            date: $('headerDate').value,
+            notes: $('headerNotes').value + " | Tipo: " + $('opType').value,
+            lines: currentLines
+        };
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/inventory/api/full-capture', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                $('correlativeDisplay').textContent = data.correlative;
+                $('successModal').style.display = 'flex';
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al guardar.");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión.");
+        }
+    }
+</script>
+
+{% endblock %}

+    <script>
+        // Discuss Logic
+        async function toggleDiscussDropdown() {
+            const dropdown = document.getElementById('discussDropdown');
+            const isVisible = dropdown.style.display === 'block';
+            dropdown.style.display = isVisible ? 'none' : 'block';
+
+            if (!isVisible) {
+                await fetchRecentMessages();
+            }
+        }
+
+        async function fetchRecentMessages() {
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch('/discuss/api/messages/recent');
+                const data = await res.json();
+                const list = document.getElementById('discussList');
+                list.innerHTML = '';
+
+                if (data.length === 0) {
+                    list.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 15px; text-align: center; color: #888;">¡Estás al día!</div>';
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                data.forEach(msg => {
+                    const item = document.createElement('div');
+                    item.style.padding = '10px 15px';
+                    item.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #f0f0f0';
+                    item.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                    item.onmouseover = () => item.style.background = '#f2f6f8';
+                    item.onmouseout = () => item.style.background = 'white';
+
+                    // Icon logic based on type could be enhanced. Using generic Odoo style
+                    let iconHtml = '<div style="background: #e9ecef; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #666; font-size: 0.8rem;">?</div>';
+
+                    if (msg.type === 'notification') {
+                        iconHtml = '<div style="background: #fff4e5; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #f0ad4e; font-size: 1rem;">⚠️</div>';
+                    } else if (msg.author === 'Sistema') {
+                        iconHtml = '<div style="background: #d1ecf1; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #0c5460; font-size: 1rem;">🤖</div>';
+                    } else {
+                        iconHtml = `<img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${msg.author}&background=random" style="width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;">`;
+                    }
+
+                    item.innerHTML = `
+                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start;">
+                            ${iconHtml}
+                            <div style="flex: 1;">
+                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;">
+                                    <strong style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #333;">${msg.channel}</strong>
+                                    <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888;">${msg.date}</span>
+                                </div>
+                                <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #444; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 500;">
+                                    ${msg.author}: <span style="font-weight: 400; color: #666;">${msg.body}</span>
+                                </div>
+                            </div>
+                        </div>
+                    `;
+                    list.appendChild(item);
+                });
+
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error(e);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Close dropdown when clicking outside
+        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+            const dropdown = document.getElementById('discussDropdown');
+            const trigger = document.querySelector('[onclick="toggleDiscussDropdown()"]');
+            if (dropdown && dropdown.style.display === 'block') {
+                if (!dropdown.contains(e.target) && !trigger.contains(e.target)) {
+                    dropdown.style.display = 'none';
+                }
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Simple active link highlighter
+        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(link => {
+            if (link.getAttribute('href') === window.location.pathname) {
+                link.classList.add('active');
+            }
+        });
+
+
+        // Sidebar Toggle
+        function toggleSidebar() {
+            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
+            const overlay = document.querySelector('.sidebar-overlay');
+
+            if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
+                // Mobile Logic
+                sidebar.classList.toggle('expanded-mobile');
+                overlay.classList.toggle('active');
+            } else {
+                // Desktop Logic
+                sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
+                // Save preference
+                localStorage.setItem('sidebarState', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'collapsed' : 'expanded');
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Restore sidebar state
+        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+            const state = localStorage.getItem('sidebarState');
+            // Default: 'collapsed' if null (Prodio style) or explicitly 'collapsed'
+            if (window.innerWidth > 768 && (state === 'collapsed' || state === null)) {
+                document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
+            }
+
+            // Expand active section by default
+            const activeLink = document.querySelector('.nav-link.active');
+            if (activeLink) {
+                const parentContent = activeLink.closest('.nav-section-content');
+                if (parentContent) {
+                    parentContent.style.display = 'block';
+                    const title = parentContent.parentElement.querySelector('.nav-section-title');
+                    if (title) title.classList.add('expanded');
+                }
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Sidebar Navigation Logic
+        function toggleNavSection(header) {
+            const content = header.nextElementSibling;
+            const isExpanded = content.style.display === 'block';
+
+            // Toggle
+            content.style.display = isExpanded ? 'none' : 'block';
+            header.classList.toggle('expanded', !isExpanded);
+        }
+    </script>
+    <div class="sidebar-overlay" onclick="toggleSidebar()"></div>
+    {% block scripts %}{% endblock %}
