+    async function searchInvoice() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('invoiceInput');
+        let val = input.value.trim();
+
+        if (val.includes(' - ')) {
+            val = val.split(' - ')[0].trim();
+        }
+
+        const docNum = val;
+        if (!docNum) return;
+
+        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('importedInvoices');
+        const currentInvoices = hiddenInput.value ? hiddenInput.value.split(',') : [];
+
+        // Use prefix to uniqueness
+        const prefix = currentDocType === 'invoice' ? 'FACT' : 'NOTA';
+        const storedValue = `${prefix}:${docNum}`;
+
+        if (currentInvoices.includes(storedValue)) {
+            alert(`${currentDocType === 'invoice' ? 'Esta factura' : 'Esta nota'} ya está en la lista actual.`);
+            return;
+        }
+
+        input.disabled = true;
+
+        try {
+            const endpoint = currentDocType === 'invoice'
+                ? `/logistics/api/external/invoice/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items`
+                : `/logistics/api/external/delivery_note/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items`;
+
+            const res = await fetch(endpoint);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (data.error) {
+                alert(data.error);
+                input.disabled = false;
+                return;
+            }
+            if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
+                alert(`${currentDocType === 'invoice' ? 'Factura no encontrada' : 'Nota de entrega no encontrada'} o sin ítems pendientes.`);
+                input.disabled = false;
+                return;
+            }
+
+            if (items.length === 1 && !items[0].item && !items[0].qty) {
+                items = [];
+            }
+
+            const totalAmount = data[0].invoice_total || 0;
+            const clientName = data[0].client_name || '';
+
+            data.forEach(invItem => {
+                items.push({
+                    client: clientName,
+                    fact: invItem.fact_num,
+                    item: invItem.art_des,
+                    qty: invItem.total_articulo,
+                    unit: invItem.co_uni || 'Unid',
+                    total_cajas: invItem.total_cajas,
+                    unidad_cajas: invItem.unidad_cajas,
+                    num_lote: invItem.num_lote,
+                    invoice_total: totalAmount
+                });
+            });
+
+            currentInvoices.push(storedValue);
+            hiddenInput.value = currentInvoices.join(',');
+
+            // Pass just the list, updateBadges parses it
+            updateBadges(currentInvoices);
+
+            // Assume renderItems or similar exists. 
+            // In typical flow we modify 'items' then user might see updates if Vue/React, 
+            // but this is vanilla JS.
+            // I'll ensure I call renderItems() or addItemRow() (if logic adds there).
+            // Actually, based on previous code reading, `items` is just an array, logic needs to re-render table.
+            renderItems();
+
+            input.value = '';
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error consultando documento");
+        } finally {
+            input.disabled = false;
+            input.focus();
+        }
+    }
+
+    function updateBadges(invoices) {
+        const badgeContainer = document.getElementById('invoiceBadges');
+        badgeContainer.innerHTML = '';
+        invoices.forEach(val => {
+            let type = 'Fact.';
+            let cleanNum = val;
+
+            if (val.includes(':')) {
+                const parts = val.split(':');
+                if (parts[0] === 'NOTA') type = 'Nota';
+                cleanNum = parts[1];
+            } else {
+                // Determine inferred type if no prefix? (Legacy support)
+                // Assume Fact if raw number.
+            }
+
+            const span = document.createElement('span');
+            span.style.background = '#e0f2fe';
+            span.style.color = '#0369a1';
+            span.style.padding = '2px 8px';
+            span.style.borderRadius = '4px';
+            span.style.fontSize = '0.8rem';
+            span.style.display = 'flex';
+            span.style.alignItems = 'center';
+            span.style.gap = '4px';
+
+            // Pass 'val' (prefixed) to removeInvoice
+            span.innerHTML = `<strong>${type}</strong> ${cleanNum} <span onclick="removeInvoice('${val}')" style="cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; color: #0284c7; margin-left: 4px;">&times;</span>`;
+
+            badgeContainer.appendChild(span);
+        });
+    }
+
+    function removeInvoice(val) {
+        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('importedInvoices');
+        let list = hiddenInput.value ? hiddenInput.value.split(',') : [];
+        list = list.filter(i => i !== val);
+        hiddenInput.value = list.join(',');
+
+        let cleanNum = val;
+        if (val.includes(':')) cleanNum = val.split(':')[1];
+
+        // Remove items
+        items = items.filter(i => i.fact !== cleanNum);
+        renderItems();
+        updateBadges(list);
+    }

+    function renderItems() {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('itemsTableBody');
+        const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        if (items.length === 0) {
+            emptyState.style.display = 'block';
+            return;
+        } else {
+            emptyState.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+
+        items.forEach((item, index) => {
+            // Determine breakdown text
+            let breakdownHtml = '';
+            if (item.total_cajas && item.total_cajas > 0) {
+                const unit = item.unidad_cajas || 'CAJ';
+                breakdownHtml = `<div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #16a34a; margin-top:0.25rem;">📦 ${item.total_cajas} ${unit}</div>`;
+            }
+
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">${index + 1}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--primary);">
+                    ${item.client || '-'}
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; background: #e2e8f0; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;">
+                        ${item.fact || 'Manual'}
+                    </span>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <input type="text" value="${item.item}" onchange="updateItem(${index}, 'item', this.value)"
+                        list="productList"
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);">
+                    ${breakdownHtml}
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <input type="number" step="0.01" value="${item.qty}" onchange="updateItem(${index}, 'qty', parseFloat(this.value))"
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);">
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <select onchange="updateItem(${index}, 'unit', this.value)"
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);">
+                        <option value="Unid" ${item.unit === 'Unid' ? 'selected' : ''}>Unid</option>
+                        <option value="Kg" ${item.unit === 'Kg' ? 'selected' : ''}>Kg</option>
+                        <option value="Cjas" ${item.unit === 'Cjas' ? 'selected' : ''}>Cajas</option>
+                        <option value="Lts" ${item.unit === 'Lts' ? 'selected' : ''}>Litros</option>
+                        <option value="${item.unit}" ${['Unid', 'Kg', 'Cjas', 'Lts'].includes(item.unit) ? '' : 'selected'}>${item.unit}</option>
+                    </select>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem; text-align: center;">
+                    <button type="button" onclick="removeItem(${index})" 
+                        style="background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--danger); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.2rem; opacity: 0.6;">
+                        &times;
+                    </button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }

+    async function annulDispatch(id, ref) {
+        if (!confirm(`⚠️ ALERTA ⚠️\n\n¿Estás seguro de que deseas ANULAR la guía ${ref}?\n\n- Esta acción no se puede deshacer.\n- Todas las facturas o notas contenidas volverán a estar disponibles de inmediato.\n\nEscribe "ANULAR" para confirmar:`)) return;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/logistics/api/dispatch/${id}/annul`, {
+                method: 'POST'
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                alert(data.message);
+                location.reload(); // Reload to refresh list and annulled states
+            } else {
+                alert(data.detail || "Error anulando la guía.");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión al anular.");
+        }
+    }

+    function updateItem(index, field, value) {
+        items[index][field] = value;
+    }

+    // Submit Handler
+    document.getElementById('dispatchForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+
+        // Validation
+        const validItems = items.filter(i => i.item.trim() !== '' && i.qty > 0);
+
+        if (validItems.length === 0) {
+            alert("⚠️ Por favor agrega al menos un ítem válido (Nombre y Cantidad > 0).");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+        // We only send valid items
+        formData.append('items', JSON.stringify(validItems));
+
+        try {
+            // Button is now outside the form, connected via form attribute
+            const btn = document.querySelector('button[form="dispatchForm"]');
+            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+            btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Guardando...';
+            btn.disabled = true;
+
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/dispatch', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                showSuccessModal(data.document_ref);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+            } else {
+                // Try to get error detail
+                try {
+                    const errData = await res.json();
+                    console.error("Error Saving:", errData);
+
+                    let msg = "Error desconocido.";
+
+                    if (errData.detail) {
+                        if (typeof errData.detail === 'string') {
+                            msg = errData.detail;
+                        } else if (Array.isArray(errData.detail)) {
+                            // Pydantic styled errors
+                            msg = errData.detail.map(e => `${e.loc ? e.loc.join('.') : ''}: ${e.msg}`).join('\n');
+                        } else {
+                            // Object or other
+                            msg = JSON.stringify(errData.detail, null, 2);
+                        }
+                    } else {
+                        msg = JSON.stringify(errData, null, 2);
+                    }
+
+                    alert("❌ " + msg);
+                } catch (e) {
+                    console.error(e);
+                    alert("❌ Error al procesar la respuesta del servidor.");
+                }
+
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+            }
+        } catch (err) {
+            console.error(err);
+            alert("Error de conexión con el servidor.");
+        }
+    });

+    function filterLogs() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('logSearch');
+        const filter = input.value.toLowerCase();
+        const list = document.getElementById('logList');
+        const items = list.getElementsByClassName('log-item');
+
+        for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
+            const item = items[i];
+            const ref = (item.getAttribute('data-ref') || '').toLowerCase();
+            const date = (item.getAttribute('data-date') || '').toLowerCase();
+            const text = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
+
+            if (ref.includes(filter) || date.includes(filter) || text.includes(filter)) {
+                item.style.display = "";
+            } else {
+                item.style.display = "none";
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    async function searchGuides() {
+        const guideRef = document.getElementById('consGuideRef').value.trim();
+        const dateFrom = document.getElementById('consDateFrom').value;
+        const dateTo = document.getElementById('consDateTo').value;
+
+        // Visual loading state if needed, or silent for debounce
+        // Let's toggle the button logic if it was clicked
+        // But for debounce we might skip it to avoid flickering
+
+        document.getElementById('consResultsContainer').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('consGuideListContainer').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('btnPrintConsolidated').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const url = new URL('/logistics/api/guides/search', window.location.origin);
+            if (guideRef) url.searchParams.append('q', guideRef);
+            if (dateFrom) url.searchParams.append('date_from', dateFrom);
+            if (dateTo) url.searchParams.append('date_to', dateTo);
+
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const guides = await res.json();
+                renderGuideList(guides);
+            } else {
+                console.error("Search error");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);

+    async function selectConsolidatedGuide(guideRef) {
+        try {
+            const url = new URL('/logistics/api/consolidated_report', window.location.origin);
+            url.searchParams.append('guide_ref', guideRef);
+
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Error loading report");
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            // Hide List, Show Report
+            document.getElementById('consGuideListContainer').style.display = 'none';
+            renderConsolidatedReport(data);
+
+            // Set Print Context
+            document.getElementById('consolidatedModal').setAttribute('data-selected-guide', guideRef);
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error cargando reporte");
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderConsolidatedReport(data) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('consTableBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        if (!data.details || data.details.length === 0) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; padding: 1rem;">No se encontraron datos.</td></tr>';
+            document.getElementById('consTotalBoxes').textContent = '0';
+            document.getElementById('consTotalWeight').textContent = '0.00 kg';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        data.details.forEach(item => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);">${item.sku}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center;">${item.total_units}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center;">${item.total_boxes}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center;">${item.total_weight.toFixed(2)} kg</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 0.8rem; color: #666;">
+                    ${item.invoices.join(', ')}
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+
+
+        document.getElementById('consTotalBoxes').textContent = data.total_boxes_all;
+        document.getElementById('consTotalWeight').textContent = data.total_weight_all.toFixed(2) + ' kg';
+
+        // Update Invoice Count
+        document.getElementById('consTotalInvoices').textContent = data.total_invoices_count || 0;
+
+        if (data.total_amount_all) {
+            document.getElementById('consTotalAmount').textContent = parseFloat(data.total_amount_all).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
+        } else {
+            document.getElementById('consTotalAmount').textContent = '0.00';
+        }
+
+        // Show print button and container if we have data
+        if (data.details && data.details.length > 0) {
+            document.getElementById('btnPrintConsolidated').style.display = 'inline-block';
+            document.getElementById('consResultsContainer').style.display = 'block';
+        }
+    }
+
+    function printConsolidatedReport() {
+        // Get selected guide from attribute
+        const guideRef = document.getElementById('consolidatedModal').getAttribute('data-selected-guide');
+
+        if (!guideRef) return;
+
+        // Extract number for pretty printing if needed, or pass full ref
+        const guideNum = guideRef.split('|')[0].trim();
+
+        const url = new URL('/logistics/consolidated_report/print', window.location.origin);
+        url.searchParams.append('guide_ref', guideNum);
+
+        const width = screen.availWidth;
+        const height = screen.availHeight;
+
+        window.open(
+            url.toString(),
+            'PrintConsolidated',
+            `width=${width},height=${height},top=0,left=0,resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes`
+        );
+    }
+</script>

+                                <th style="width: 5%;"></th>
+                            </tr>
+                        </thead>

+                            <tr id="inputRow" style="background: #fafafa; border-bottom: 2px solid #eee;">
+                                <td>
+                                    <div class="search-container">
+                                        <input type="text" id="newArticleName" placeholder="Buscar producto..."

+<script>
+    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
+
+    // Init Date
+    $('dateInput').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+
+    // --- Tab Logic ---
+    function switchTab(tabName) {
+        if (tabName === 'lines') {
+            $('tab-lines').style.display = 'block';
+            $('tab-other').style.display = 'none';
+        } else {
+            $('tab-lines').style.display = 'none';
+            $('tab-other').style.display = 'block';
+        }
+    }
+
+    // --- Data Store ---
+    let inventoryLines = [];
+    let articlesData = [];
+    let selectedIndex = -1;
+
+    // --- Load Articles ---
+    async function loadArticles() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles?category=inventory');
+            if (res.ok) articlesData = await res.json();
+        } catch (e) { console.error("Error loading articles", e); }
+    }
+    loadArticles();
+
+    // --- Search & Keyboard Navigation Logic ---
+    const searchInput = $('newArticleName');
+    const resultsDiv = $('searchResults');
+
+    // Helper to render dropdown
+    function renderResults(filtered) {
+        resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach((item, index) => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.className = 'result-item';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onclick = () => selectArticle(item);
+                // Highlight logic
+                if (index === selectedIndex) div.classList.add('selected');
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    }
+
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        searchInput.classList.remove('is-invalid'); // Clear error
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        selectedIndex = -1; // Reset selection
+        if (term.length < 2) { resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; return; }
+
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a =>
+            a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term)
+        );
+        // Limit results for performance
+        renderResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));
+    });
+
+    // Keyboard Navigation for Search
+    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        const items = resultsDiv.getElementsByClassName('result-item');
+
+        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (items.length > 0) {
+                selectedIndex = (selectedIndex + 1) % items.length;
+                updateSelection(items);
+            }
+        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (items.length > 0) {
+                selectedIndex = (selectedIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
+                updateSelection(items);
+            }
+        } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (selectedIndex >= 0 && items[selectedIndex]) {
+                items[selectedIndex].click(); // Simulate click
+            } else if (items.length > 0) {
+                items[0].click(); // Select first if none selected
+            }
+        }
+    });
+
+    function updateSelection(items) {
+        Array.from(items).forEach((item, index) => {
+            if (index === selectedIndex) {
+                item.classList.add('selected');
+                item.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
+            } else {
+                item.classList.remove('selected');
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function selectArticle(item) {
+        searchInput.value = item.description;
+        $('newArticleCode').value = item.code;
+        resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        searchInput.classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        $('newBatch').focus();
+    }
+
+    // --- Sequential Enter Logic ---
+    $('newBatch').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            $('newQty').focus();
+        }
+    });
+
+    $('newQty').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        $('newQty').classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            addLine();
+        }
+    });
+
+    // --- Add Line Logic ---
+    function addLine() {
+        const code = $('newArticleCode').value;
+        const name = searchInput.value;
+        const batch = $('newBatch').value;
+        const qty = parseFloat($('newQty').value);
+
+        let isValid = true;
+
+        if (!code || !name) {
+            searchInput.classList.add('is-invalid');
+            isValid = false;
+        }
+        if (isNaN(qty) || qty <= 0) {
+            $('newQty').classList.add('is-invalid');
+            isValid = false;
+        }
+
+        if (!isValid) return; // Stop if invalid
+
+        // Add to array
+        inventoryLines.push({
+            article_code: code,
+            article_description: name,
+            batch: batch || 'N/A',
+            quantity: qty
+        });
+
+        renderLines();
+        clearInputRow();
+        searchInput.focus(); // Jump back to start
+    }
+
+    function renderLines() {
+        // Remove existing non-input rows
+        const tbody = $('linesTableBody');
+        const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('.data-row');
+        rows.forEach(r => r.remove());
+
+        // Append to end of table (Input Row is now at top)
+        inventoryLines.forEach((line, index) => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.className = 'data-row';
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td>${line.article_description} <span style='color:#999; font-size:0.8em;'>[${line.article_code}]</span></td>
+                <td>${line.batch}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: right;">${line.quantity.toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: center;">
+                    <button type="button" onclick="removeLine(${index})" style="color: red; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer;">×</button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    window.removeLine = function (index) {
+        inventoryLines.splice(index, 1);
+        renderLines();
+    }
+
+    function clearInputRow() {
+        searchInput.value = '';
+        $('newArticleCode').value = '';
+        $('newBatch').value = '';
+        $('newQty').value = '';
+        searchInput.classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        $('newQty').classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        selectedIndex = -1;
+    }
+
+    // --- Submit Logic ---
+    $('inventoryForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+
+        if (inventoryLines.length === 0) {
+            alert("Agregue al menos una línea al inventario.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = {
+            date: $('dateInput').value,
+            notes: document.querySelector('input[name="notes"]').value,
+            lines: inventoryLines
+        };
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/inventory/api/full-capture', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                alert("Inventario guardado exitosamente (DOC #" + (await res.json()).correlative + ")");
+                window.location.reload();
+            } else {
+                const err = await res.json();
+                alert("Error al guardar: " + (err.detail || "Desconocido"));
+            }
+        } catch (error) {
+            console.error(error);
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    });
+
+    // Close search on click outside
+    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+</script>

+<script>
+    let currentDocType = 'invoice';
+    let searchDebounce;
+    let selectedIndex = -1;
+
+    // Set default date to today
+    document.getElementById('receptionDate').valueAsDate = new Date();
+
+    function toggleDocType() {
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnDocToggle');
+        const lbl = document.getElementById('lblTitle');
+        const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
+
+        if (currentDocType === 'invoice') {
+            currentDocType = 'delivery_note';
+            btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Factura';
+            lbl.innerText = 'Buscar Nota de Entrega';
+            input.placeholder = 'Buscar Nota...';
+        } else {
+            currentDocType = 'invoice';
+            btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Nota de Entrega';
+            lbl.innerText = 'Buscar Factura';
+            input.placeholder = 'Buscar Factura...';
+        }
+
+        // Reset
+        input.value = '';
+        input.focus();
+        document.getElementById('detailsSection').style.display = 'none';
+        hideDropdown();
+    }
+
+    function hideDropdown() {
+        const dropdown = document.getElementById('resultsDropdown');
+        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
+        selectedIndex = -1;
+    }
+
+    function handleKeyDown(e) {
+        const dropdown = document.getElementById('resultsDropdown');
+        const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item');
+
+        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (dropdown.style.display === 'none' && document.getElementById('searchInput').value.length >= 2) {
+                handleInput(document.getElementById('searchInput').value);
+            }
+            selectedIndex = Math.min(selectedIndex + 1, items.length - 1);
+            updateSelection(items);
+        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            selectedIndex = Math.max(selectedIndex - 1, 0);
+            updateSelection(items);
+        } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            if (dropdown.style.display !== 'none' && selectedIndex > -1 && items[selectedIndex]) {
+                e.preventDefault();
+                items[selectedIndex].click();
+            } else {
+                // If dropdown is closed or nothing selected, trigger searchDocument
+                searchDocument();
+            }
+        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
+            hideDropdown();
+        }
+    }
+
+    function updateSelection(items) {
+        items.forEach((item, index) => {
+            if (index === selectedIndex) {
+                item.classList.add('selected');
+                item.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
+            } else {
+                item.classList.remove('selected');
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function handleInput(val) {
+        const dropdown = document.getElementById('resultsDropdown');
+
+        if (val.length < 2) {
+            hideDropdown();
+            return;
+        }
+
+        clearTimeout(searchDebounce);
+        searchDebounce = setTimeout(async () => {
+            try {
+                // Unified search endpoint
+                const res = await fetch(`/logistics/api/external/documents/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(val)}`);
+                if (res.ok) {
+                    const data = await res.json();
+                    dropdown.innerHTML = '';
+
+                    if (data.length === 0) {
+                        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
+                        return;
+                    }
+
+                    data.forEach((item, index) => {
+                        // Populate custom dropdown for rich details
+                        const div = document.createElement('div');
+                        div.className = 'dropdown-item';
+                        div.style.padding = '0.75rem 1rem';
+                        div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                        div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #f1f5f9';
+                        div.style.display = 'flex';
+                        div.style.justifyContent = 'space-between';
+                        div.style.alignItems = 'center';
+                        div.style.transition = 'background 0.2s';
+
+                        const typeLabel = item.doc_type === 'invoice' ? 'FACT' : 'NOTA';
+                        const typeColor = item.doc_type === 'invoice' ? '#3b82f6' : '#8b5cf6';
+
+                        div.innerHTML = `
+                            <div>
+                                <span style="font-weight: 600; color: ${typeColor}; margin-right: 0.5rem;">${typeLabel} ${item.doc_num}</span>
+                                <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-main);">${item.client}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 0.5;">ENTER</span>
+                        `;
+
+                        div.onclick = () => {
+                            document.getElementById('searchInput').value = item.display;
+                            hideDropdown();
+                            selectAndSearch(item.doc_num, item.doc_type);
+                        };
+
+                        div.onmouseover = () => {
+                            selectedIndex = index;
+                            updateSelection(dropdown.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item'));
+                        };
+
+                        dropdown.appendChild(div);
+                    });
+
+                    dropdown.style.display = 'block';
+                }
+            } catch (err) {
+                console.error("Autocomplete error", err);
+            }
+        }, 150); // Reduced debounce for snappier feel
+    }
+
+    // Trigger search after selecting from dropdown
+    async function selectAndSearch(docNum, docType) {
+        // We reuse the search logic but passing params directly
+        await performSearch(docNum, docType);
+    }
+
+    // Unified search logic
+    async function searchDocument() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
+        let displayVal = input.value.trim();
+        if (!displayVal) return;
+
+        // Attempt to parse number if it's in "TYPE NUM - CLIENT" format
+        let docNum = displayVal;
+        let docType = currentDocType;
+
+        if (displayVal.includes(' - ')) {
+            const parts = displayVal.split(' - ');
+            const left = parts[0].trim();
+            docNum = left.replace(/^(FACT:|NOTA:)\s*/, '');
+            docType = left.startsWith('NOTA:') ? 'delivery_note' : 'invoice';
+        }
+
+        await performSearch(docNum, docType);
+    }
+
+    async function performSearch(docNum, docType) {
+        const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
+        input.disabled = true;
+
+        try {
+            // Set visuals
+            currentDocType = docType;
+            const btn = document.getElementById('btnDocToggle');
+            const lbl = document.getElementById('lblTitle');
+
+            if (docType === 'delivery_note') {
+                btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Factura';
+                lbl.innerText = 'Nota de Entrega Detectada';
+            } else {
+                btn.innerHTML = '🔄 Cambiar a Nota de Entrega';
+                lbl.innerText = 'Factura Detectada';
+            }
+
+            const endpoint = docType === 'invoice'
+                ? `/logistics/api/external/invoice/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items/no-check`
+                : `/logistics/api/external/delivery_note/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items`;
+
+            const res = await fetch(endpoint);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
+                alert("Documento no encontrado o no tiene renglones pendientes.");
+                input.disabled = false;
+                return;
+            }
+
+            // Populate Details
+            const first = data[0];
+            document.getElementById('detClient').innerText = first.client_name || first.client || 'Desconocido';
+            document.getElementById('detDoc').innerText = `${docType === 'invoice' ? 'FACT' : 'NOTA'} ${docNum}`;
+
+            const amt = first.invoice_total || 0;
+            document.getElementById('detAmount').innerText = amt.toLocaleString('es-VE', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
+
+            // Prepare Form
+            document.getElementById('formDocType').value = docType;
+            document.getElementById('formDocNum').value = docNum;
+
+            // Show Section
+            document.getElementById('detailsSection').style.display = 'block';
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error consultando documento");
+        } finally {
+            input.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function submitUpdate(e) {
+        e.preventDefault();
+
+        if (!confirm("¿Está seguro de actualizar la fecha de recepción para este documento?")) return;
+
+        const form = document.getElementById('updateForm');
+        const formData = new FormData(form);
+        const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.innerText = "Guardando...";
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/api/external/update-reception-date', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (result.status === 'success') {
+                alert("✅ Actualización Exitosa");
+                // Reset UI
+                document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
+                document.getElementById('detailsSection').style.display = 'none';
+                document.getElementById('searchInput').focus();
+            } else {
+                alert("❌ Error: " + (result.message || "Desconocido"));
+            }
+
+        } catch (err) {
+            console.error(err);
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        } finally {
+            btn.disabled = false;
+            btn.innerText = "💾 Guardar Fecha";
+        }
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+<script>
+    // State
+    let items = [];
+
+    // Init
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        addItemRow(); // Start with one row
+    });
+
+    function renderItems() {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('itemsTableBody');
+        const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        if (items.length === 0) {
+            emptyState.style.display = 'block';
+            return;
+        } else {
+            emptyState.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+
+        items.forEach((item, index) => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <input type="text" value="${item.item}" oninput="updateItem(${index}, 'item', this.value)" 
+                        placeholder="Descripción del producto" 
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem;">
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <input type="number" value="${item.qty}" oninput="updateItem(${index}, 'qty', this.value)" 
+                        placeholder="0" 
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem;">
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <select onchange="updateItem(${index}, 'unit', this.value)" 
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem;">
+                        <option value="Unid" ${item.unit === 'Unid' ? 'selected' : ''}>Unid</option>
+                        <option value="Kg" ${item.unit === 'Kg' ? 'selected' : ''}>Kg</option>
+                        <option value="Cjas" ${item.unit === 'Cjas' ? 'selected' : ''}>Cajas</option>
+                        <option value="Lts" ${item.unit === 'Lts' ? 'selected' : ''}>Litros</option>
+                    </select>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem; text-align: center;">
+                    <button type="button" onclick="removeItem(${index})" 
+                        style="background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--danger); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.2rem; opacity: 0.6;">
+                        &times;
+                    </button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    function addItemRow() {
+        items.push({ item: '', qty: '', unit: 'Unid' });
+        renderItems();
+    }
+
+    function removeItem(index) {
+        items.splice(index, 1);
+        renderItems();
+    }
+
+    function updateItem(index, field, value) {
+        items[index][field] = value;
+    }
+
+    // Submit Handler
+    document.getElementById('receptionForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+
+        // Validation
+        const validItems = items.filter(i => i.item.trim() !== '' && i.qty > 0);
+
+        if (validItems.length === 0) {
+            alert("⚠️ Por favor agrega al menos un ítem válido (Nombre y Cantidad > 0).");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+        // We only send valid items
+        formData.append('items', JSON.stringify(validItems));
+
+        try {
+            const btn = e.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+            btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Guardando...';
+            btn.disabled = true;
+
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/reception/merchandise', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                // Success feedback
+                showSuccessModal();
+            } else {
+                alert("❌ Error al guardar la recepción.");
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+            }
+        } catch (err) {
+            console.error(err);
+            alert("Error de conexión con el servidor.");
+        }
+    });
+</script>

+    async function fetchPendingOrders() {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('modalListBody');
+        const loading = document.getElementById('modalLoading');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+        loading.style.display = 'block';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/logistics/api/production/pending`);
+            const data = await res.json();
+            pendingOrders = data;
+            renderModalList(data);
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            loading.style.display = 'none';
+            tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; color:red; padding: 1rem;'>Error cargando órdenes...</td></tr>";
+        }

+    function renderModalList(items) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('modalListBody');
+        const loading = document.getElementById('modalLoading');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+        loading.style.display = 'none';
+
+        if (items.length === 0) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; padding: 2rem; color: #6b7280;'>No hay órdenes pendientes.</td></tr>";
+            return;

+            const row = document.createElement("tr");
+            row.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #f3f4f6";
+            row.style.cursor = "pointer";
+            row.onmouseover = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "#eff6ff"; };
+            row.onmouseout = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "transparent"; };
+            row.onclick = () => selectOrder(order);
+
+            const orderNum = order.order_number ? String(order.order_number).padStart(8, '0') : order.id;
+
+            row.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 16px 24px; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: #2563eb;">#${orderNum}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 16px 24px; color: #111827;">${order.article_type}</td>

+                </td>

+    function selectOrder(order) {
+        // Unlock form
+        const card = document.getElementById('receptionCard');
+        card.style.opacity = '1';
+        card.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
+
+        document.getElementById('prodId').value = order.id;

+        // Fetch Box Equivalence

+    }
+
+    let currentBoxEquiv = 0;
+
+    async function fetchArticleDetails(description) {
+        if (!description) return;
+        try {
+            // Re-use external articles API to find the article and get box_equiv
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const articles = await res.json();
+                const found = articles.find(a => a.description === description);
+                if (found) {
+                    currentBoxEquiv = found.box_equiv || 0;
+                    calculateBoxes();
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error fetching article details", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function calculateBoxes() {
+        const units = parseFloat(document.getElementById('receivedQty').value) || 0;
+        const boxesInput = document.getElementById('totalBoxes');
+
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && units > 0) {
+            boxesInput.value = (units / currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(2);
+        } else {
+            boxesInput.value = '';
+        }
+    }
+
+    document.getElementById('receivedQty').addEventListener('input', calculateBoxes);
+
+    function validateAndSubmit() {
+        const expected = parseFloat(document.getElementById('expectedUnits').value);
+        const received = parseFloat(document.getElementById('receivedQty').value);
+        const orderNum = document.getElementById('orderNumber').value;
+
+        if (isNaN(received)) {
+            alert("Ingrese la cantidad recibida");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const diff = expected - received;
+
+        if (diff !== 0) {
+            // Show Alert Modal
+            const body = document.getElementById('emailBody');
+            body.value = `Se detectó una diferencia en la Orden ${orderNum}.\n\nEsperado: ${expected}\nRecibido: ${received}\nDiferencia: ${diff}\n\nPor favor verificar.`;
+
+            document.getElementById('alertModal').style.display = 'flex';
+        } else {
+            // Submit directly
+            submitForm();
+        }
+    }
+
+    function closeModal() {
+        document.getElementById('alertModal').style.display = 'none';
+    }
+
+    async function submitForm(email = null) {
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('production_id', document.getElementById('prodId').value);
+        formData.append('received_qty', document.getElementById('receivedQty').value);
+        if (email) formData.append('alert_email', email);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/reception/confirm', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                showSuccessModal();
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + data.detail);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    }
+
+    function confirmWithAlert() {
+        const emailTo = document.getElementById('emailTo').value;
+        submitForm(emailTo);
+    }

+    <!-- JS for AI Toggle -->
+    <script>
+        async function toggleAI(id, checkbox) {
+            const enabled = checkbox.checked;
+            const formData = new FormData();
+            formData.append('func_id', id);
+            formData.append('enabled', enabled);
+
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/toggle', {
+                    method: 'POST',
+                    body: formData
+                });
+                const data = await res.json();
+                if (data.status !== 'success') {
+                    alert('Error al cambiar estado');
+                    checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+                }
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error(e);
+                alert('Error de conexión');
+                checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+            }
+        }
+    </script>
+</div>

+<script>
+    // Init Dates
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
+        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        const ps = document.getElementById('planStart');
+        const pe = document.getElementById('planEnd');
+        if (ps) ps.value = today;
+        if (pe) pe.value = today;
+
+        function valMaint() {
+            if (ps.value > pe.value) {
+                alert("Fecha inválida");
+                pe.value = ps.value;
+            }
+        }
+        if (ps) ps.addEventListener('change', valMaint);
+        if (pe) pe.addEventListener('change', valMaint);
+
+        // Init Production Dates too
+        const prs = document.getElementById('prodStart');
+        const pre = document.getElementById('prodEnd');
+        if (prs) prs.value = today;
+        if (pre) pre.value = today;
+    });
+
+
+
+    function resetFilters(table) {
+        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            document.getElementById('planStart').value = today;
+            document.getElementById('planEnd').value = today;
+        } else if (table === 'production') {
+            document.getElementById('prodStart').value = today;
+            document.getElementById('prodEnd').value = today;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function printReport(table) {
+        let url = `/maintenance/report/print?type=${table}`;
+        let s = '', e = '';
+
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            s = document.getElementById('planStart').value;
+            e = document.getElementById('planEnd').value;
+        } else if (table === 'production') {
+            s = document.getElementById('prodStart').value;
+            e = document.getElementById('prodEnd').value;
+        }
+
+        if (s) url += `&start_date=${s}`;
+        if (e) url += `&end_date=${e}`;
+
+        window.open(url, '_blank');
+    }
+
+    function showTab(tabId, btn) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
+        document.getElementById(tabId).style.display = 'block';
+
+        // Update active state
+        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
+        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
+    }
+
+    function confirmDelete(type) {
+        const start = document.getElementById('planStart').value;
+        const end = document.getElementById('planEnd').value;
+
+        // Update hidden form inputs
+        document.getElementById('formPlanStart').value = start;
+        document.getElementById('formPlanEnd').value = end;
+
+        let msg = "¿ESTÁ SEGURO? Se borrarán las planificaciones";
+        if (start || end) {
+            msg += ` entre ${start || 'Inicio'} y ${end || 'Fin'}`;
+        } else {
+            msg += " DE TODAS LAS FECHAS";
+        }
+        return confirm(msg);
+    }
+
+
+
+    let currentTable = ''; // Store current table for deleteSelected
+
+    async function previewData(table) {
+        currentTable = table;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', table);
+
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('planStart').value);
+            formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('planEnd').value);
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            const container = document.getElementById('previewContainer');
+            const tableEl = document.getElementById('previewTable');
+            const thead = tableEl.querySelector('thead');
+            const tbody = tableEl.querySelector('tbody');
+
+            container.style.display = 'block';
+            tbody.innerHTML = '';
+            thead.innerHTML = '';
+
+            if (data.length === 0) {
+                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td style="padding:1rem;">No se encontraron datos.</td></tr>';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            // Build Headers
+            let keys = Object.keys(data[0]);
+
+            // Reorder: id, date/created_at, inserted_at, others
+            const priority = ['id', 'date', 'created_at', 'inserted_at', 'article_type', 'article', 'batch_qty', 'kg_produced'];
+            keys.sort((a, b) => {
+                const idxA = priority.indexOf(a);
+                const idxB = priority.indexOf(b);
+                if (idxA !== -1 && idxB !== -1) return idxA - idxB;
+                if (idxA !== -1) return -1;
+                if (idxB !== -1) return 1;
+                return a.localeCompare(b);
+            });
+
+            const headerMap = {
+                'id': 'ID',
+                'date': 'Fecha Planificada',
+                'created_at': 'Fecha Asignada',
+                'inserted_at': 'Fecha Registro (System)',
+                'article_type': 'Artículo',
+                'article': 'Artículo',
+                'batch_qty': 'Batches',
+                'kg_produced': 'Kg Prod.',
+                'boxes': 'Cajas',
+                'pt_units': 'Unidades PT'
+            };
+
+            let headerRow = '<tr style="background:#f1f1f1; text-align:left;">';
+            headerRow += '<th style="padding:0.5rem; width: 30px;"><input type="checkbox" id="checkAll" onchange="toggleAll(this)"></th>';
+            keys.forEach(k => headerRow += `<th style="padding:0.5rem; white-space:nowrap;">${headerMap[k] || k}</th>`);
+            headerRow += '<th style="padding:0.5rem;">Acción</th>'; // Action Header
+            headerRow += '</tr>';
+            thead.innerHTML = headerRow;
+
+            // Build Rows
+            data.forEach(row => {
+                let tr = '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">';
+                tr += `<td style="padding:0.5rem;"><input type="checkbox" class="row-check" value="${row.id}" onchange="updateDeleteButton()"></td>`;
+                keys.forEach(k => {
+                    let content = row[k];
+                    if (content === null || content === undefined) content = "";
+                    let displayContent = content.toString();
+
+                    // Truncate logic handled by CSS, but we ensure tooltip has full content
+                    tr += `<td style="padding:0.5rem; white-space:nowrap; max-width: 150px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" title="${displayContent}">${displayContent}</td>`;
+                });
+
+                // Action Button
+                tr += `
+                <td style="padding:0.5rem;">
+                    <button onclick="deleteOne('${table}', '${row.id}')" 
+                        style="background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
+                        Eliminar
+                    </button>
+                </td>`;
+
+                tr += '</tr>';
+                tbody.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', tr);
+            });
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert('Error al cargar vista previa');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function deleteOne(table, id) {
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar registro ID: ${id}?`)) return;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', table);
+        formData.append('action', 'one');
+        formData.append('id', id);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData // Using FormData for standard form submission endpoint
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                // Refresh preview
+                previewData(table);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al eliminar");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    }
+
+
+    function toggleAll(source) {
+        const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.row-check');
+        checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = source.checked);
+        updateDeleteButton();
+    }
+
+    function updateDeleteButton() {
+        const checked = document.querySelectorAll('.row-check:checked');
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnDeleteSelected');
+        const countSpan = document.getElementById('selectedCount');
+
+        countSpan.innerText = checked.length;
+
+        if (checked.length > 0) {
+            btn.disabled = false;
+            btn.style.opacity = '1';
+            btn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+        } else {
+            btn.disabled = true;
+            btn.style.opacity = '0.5';
+            btn.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function deleteSelected() {
+        const checked = document.querySelectorAll('.row-check:checked');
+        if (checked.length === 0) return;
+
+        const ids = Array.from(checked).map(cb => cb.value).join(',');
+
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar los ${checked.length} registros seleccionados? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`)) return;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', currentTable); // Use stored table
+        formData.append('action', 'list');
+        formData.append('ids', ids);
+
+        // Add dates to preserve context if backend needs it (though list delete usually ignores dates)
+        // Better safe to be simple. Backend relies on IDs.
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok || res.status === 303 || res.redirected) {
+                // Since fetch follows redirects automatically for 303 but returns the HTML of the new page, 
+                // we might want to manually reload or just call previewData again to refresh the table.
+                // But the backend returns a RedirectResponse to /maintenance?message=...
+                // Fetch will get that HTML. We can't easily change the browser URL and show the message without a full reload 
+                // or extracting the message. 
+                // Let's just reload the page to show the flash message or refresh the grid.
+                // Actually, resizing the grid is better UX, but we want the flash message "Se eliminaron X registros".
+                // If we use fetch, we lose the flash message if we don't handle it.
+                // Let's force a reload to the URL that the backend redirected to (if we can get it) 
+                // or just reload current page with a custom message if possible.
+                // Fetch 'res.url' should be the redirected URL.
+                window.location.href = res.url;
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al eliminar");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+<script>
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        ['planStart', 'planEnd', 'prodStart', 'prodEnd', 'logStart', 'logEnd', 'supStart', 'supEnd'].forEach(id => {
+            const el = document.getElementById(id);
+            if (el) el.value = today;
+        });
+    });
+
+    function openTab(evt, tabId) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
+        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(el => {
+            el.classList.remove('active');
+            el.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
+            el.style.borderBottomColor = 'transparent';
+            el.style.fontWeight = '500';
+        });
+
+        document.getElementById(tabId).style.display = 'block';
+        evt.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
+        evt.currentTarget.style.color = 'var(--text-current)';
+        evt.currentTarget.style.borderBottomColor = 'var(--primary)';
+        evt.currentTarget.style.fontWeight = '600';
+    }
+
+    function confirmDelete(type) {
+        if (type === 'planning') {
+            document.getElementById('formPlanStart').value = document.getElementById('planStart').value;
+            document.getElementById('formPlanEnd').value = document.getElementById('planEnd').value;
+        }
+        return confirm("¿Estás seguro de eliminar estos registros? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.");
+    }
+
+    function printReport(table) {
+        let s, e;
+        if (table === 'planning') { s = document.getElementById('planStart').value; e = document.getElementById('planEnd').value; }
+        if (table === 'production') { s = document.getElementById('prodStart').value; e = document.getElementById('prodEnd').value; }
+
+        window.open(`/maintenance/report/print?type=${table}&start_date=${s}&end_date=${e}`, '_blank');
+    }
+
+    function syncLogForms() {
+        document.getElementById('formLogTable').value = document.getElementById('logTable').value;
+        document.getElementById('formLogStart').value = document.getElementById('logStart').value;
+        document.getElementById('formLogEnd').value = document.getElementById('logEnd').value;
+    }
+
+    function syncSupForms() {
+        document.getElementById('formSupStart').value = document.getElementById('supStart').value;
+        document.getElementById('formSupEnd').value = document.getElementById('supEnd').value;
+    }
+
+    async function previewLogistics() {
+        const table = document.getElementById('logTable').value;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', table);
+        formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('logStart').value);
+        formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('logEnd').value);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            renderTable(data, 'previewLogistics', table);
+        } catch (e) { alert("Error"); }
+    }
+
+    async function previewSupport() {
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', 'support_tickets');
+        formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('supStart').value);
+        formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('supEnd').value);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            renderTable(data, 'previewSupport', 'support_tickets');
+        } catch (e) { alert("Error"); }
+    }
+
+    // Creating a reusable render function since logic was repeated
+    function renderTable(data, containerId, tableType) {
+        let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.85rem;"><thead><tr style="background:#f1f5f9;">';
+
+        if (data.length === 0) {
+            html += '<td style="padding:1rem;">No se encontraron datos.</td></tr></table>';
+        } else {
+            // Checkbox Header
+            html += '<th style="padding:0.5rem; width: 40px;"><input type="checkbox" onclick="toggleAll(this)"></th>';
+
+            const keys = Object.keys(data[0]).filter(k => !['items_json', 'notes', '_sa_instance_state'].includes(k));
+            keys.forEach(k => html += `<th style="padding:0.5rem; text-align:left;">${k}</th>`);
+            html += '<th style="padding:0.5rem;">Acción</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
+
+            data.forEach(row => {
+                html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">';
+                // Checkbox Cell
+                html += `<td style="padding:0.5rem; text-align:center;"><input type="checkbox" class="row-selector" value="${row.id}"></td>`;
+
+                keys.forEach(k => html += `<td style="padding:0.5rem;">${row[k] === null ? '-' : row[k]}</td>`);
+                html += `<td style="padding:0.5rem;">
+                            <button onclick="deleteOne('${tableType}', '${row.id}')" style="color:var(--danger); border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer;">&times; Eliminar</button>
+                         </td></tr>`;
+            });
+            html += '</tbody></table>';
+        }
+        document.getElementById(containerId).innerHTML = html;
+    }
+
+    function toggleAll(source) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.row-selector').forEach(cb => cb.checked = source.checked);
+    }
+
+    async function deleteSelected(scope) {
+        // scope used to know which table is active if needed, but here we assume 'logistics' tab mainly uses this
+        // or check which tab is visible
+        let table = '';
+        if (scope === 'logistics') {
+            table = document.getElementById('logTable').value;
+        } else if (scope === 'support') {
+            table = 'support_tickets';
+        } else {
+            // Fallback or others
+            return;
+        }
+
+        let previewContainer = scope === 'support' ? '#previewSupport' : '#previewLogistics';
+        const checkboxes = document.querySelector(previewContainer).querySelectorAll('.row-selector:checked');
+        if (checkboxes.length === 0) {
+            alert("Selecciona al menos un registro para eliminar.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar ${checkboxes.length} registros seleccionados?`)) return;
+
+        const ids = Array.from(checkboxes).map(cb => cb.value).join(',');
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('table', table);
+        fd.append('action', 'list');
+        fd.append('ids', ids);
+
+        try {
+            await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+            // Refresh
+            if (scope === 'logistics') previewLogistics();
+            else if (scope === 'support') previewSupport();
+            else alert("Actualiza la vista para ver cambios.");
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error al eliminar");
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function previewData(table) {
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', table);
+
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('planStart').value);
+            formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('planEnd').value);
+        } else if (table === 'production') {
+            formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('prodStart').value);
+            formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('prodEnd').value);
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            renderTable(data, table === 'planning' ? 'previewPlanning' : 'previewProduction', table);
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error al cargar datos");
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function deleteOne(table, id) {
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar registro ID ${id}?`)) return;
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        // If tableType passed from renderTable was 'previewLogistics', we need actual table name
+        // Quick fix: renderTable receives the actual table name (e.g., 'inventory') or logic mapping
+        // In previous renderTable call: renderTable(data, 'previewLogistics', table); -> third arg IS table name
+
+        fd.append('table', table);
+        fd.append('action', 'one');
+        fd.append('id', id);
+
+        await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+
+        // Refresh based on table type (naive refresh of active tab)
+        if (['planning', 'production'].includes(table)) previewData(table);
+        else if (table === 'support_tickets') previewSupport();
+        else previewLogistics();
+    }
+
+    async function toggleAI(id, checkbox) {
+        const enabled = checkbox.checked;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('func_id', id);
+        formData.append('enabled', enabled);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/toggle', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (data.status !== 'success') {
+                alert('Error al cambiar estado');
+                checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert('Error de conexión');
+            checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+        }
+    }
+    async function sendAIChat() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
+        const history = document.getElementById('chatHistory');
+        const txt = input.value.trim();
+        if (!txt) return;
+
+        // User Message
+        history.innerHTML += `
+            <div style="align-self: flex-end; background: #8b5cf6; color: white; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 8px; max-width: 80%;">
+                ${txt}
+            </div>
+        `;
+        input.value = '';
+        history.scrollTop = history.scrollHeight;
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('message', txt);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/chat', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            // AI Response
+            history.innerHTML += `
+                <div style="align-self: flex-start; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 0; max-width: 80%;">
+                    ${data.response}
+                </div>
+            `;
+
+            // Auto-refresh if success
+            if (data.response.includes("exitosamente") || data.response.includes("agregado")) {
+                setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1500);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            history.innerHTML += `
+                <div style="align-self: flex-start; background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 0; max-width: 80%;">
+                    Error de conexión.
+                </div>
+            `;
+        }
+        history.scrollTop = history.scrollHeight;
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+{% block scripts %}
+<script>
+    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadConfig);
+
+    function switchTab(tabId) {
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl1').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl2').classList.remove('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent1').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('tabContent2').style.display = 'none';
+
+        document.getElementById('tabCtrl' + tabId).classList.add('active');
+        document.getElementById('tabContent' + tabId).style.display = 'block';
+    }
+
+    function toggleRibbon() {
+        const isActive = document.getElementById('inputActive').checked;
+        const ribbon = document.getElementById('activeRibbon');
+        if (isActive) {
+            ribbon.classList.add('active');
+            ribbon.style.background = '#28a745';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Activo';
+        } else {
+            ribbon.style.background = '#6c757d';
+            ribbon.innerText = 'Archivado / Inactivo';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadConfig() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/mismatch-admin/api/config');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            document.getElementById('inputEmails').value = data.emails;
+            document.getElementById('inputCron').value = data.cron_schedule;
+            document.getElementById('inputActive').checked = data.is_active;
+            toggleRibbon();
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error cargando la configuración. Servidor inaccesible.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function saveConfig() {
+        showToast('Guardando...');
+        const payload = {
+            emails: document.getElementById('inputEmails').value.trim(),
+            cron_schedule: document.getElementById('inputCron').value.trim(),
+            is_active: document.getElementById('inputActive').checked
+        };
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/mismatch-admin/api/config', {
+                method: 'PUT',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (res.ok) {
+                if (data.warning) {
+                    showToast('Guardado. Alerta: ' + data.warning);
+                } else {
+                    showToast('Configuración guardada exitosamente.');
+                }
+            } else {
+                showToast('Error al guardar en base de datos.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Error de red al intentar guardar.');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function runNow() {
+        switchTab(1); // switch to console tab
+        if (!confirm('¿Desea despachar el agente bot manualmente para buscar discrepancias ahora mismo? Toma algunos minutos.')) return;
+        showToast('Iniciando secuencias del agente bot. No recargue.');
+
+        const logger = document.getElementById('consoleLog');
+        logger.textContent = "> Inicializando conexión SSH e inyectando prompt de Mismatch...\n> Esperando respuesta remota y ejecución...\n\n";
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/mismatch-admin/api/run-now', { method: 'POST' });
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                showToast('Supervisión finalizada con éxito.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- TERMINADO CORRECTAMENTE ---\n\n" + data.output;
+            } else {
+                const err = await res.json();
+                showToast('Ocurrió un error en la automatización.');
+                logger.textContent += "--- ERROR ---\n\n" + (err.detail || 'Fallo en la ejecución remota.');
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            showToast('Time-out o error de enlace.');
+            logger.textContent += "--- ENLACE CORTADO ---\nNetwork Timeout o error de conexión.";
+        }
+    }
+
+    function showToast(msg, dur = 3000) {
+        const t = document.getElementById('toast');
+        t.innerText = msg;
+        t.style.display = 'block';
+        clearTimeout(window._toastTimer);
+        window._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', dur);
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}
