+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; color: #888;">Kg</td>
+                            </tr>
+                            <tr style="background: #fcfcfc;">
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; font-weight: 600;">Total
+                                    Kilogramos
+                                </td>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
+                                    <input type="text" inputmode="decimal" name="kg" id="totalKgInput" required readonly
+                                        style="border:none; width: 150px; background: transparent; font-weight: 700; color: var(--odoo-primary); text-align: left;">
+                                </td>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; color: #888;">Kg</td>
+                            </tr>
+                            <tr>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">Unidades Esperadas</td>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
+                                    <input type="number" name="units" id="unitsInput" required
+                                        style="border:none; width: 150px; text-align: left;">
+                                </td>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; color: #888;">Ud</td>
+                            </tr>
+                            <tr>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">Numero de Cajas</td>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">
+                                    <input type="text" inputmode="decimal" name="boxes" id="boxesInput" required
+                                        style="border:none; width: 80px; text-align: left;">
+                                    <span id="boxesHelper" style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #999;"></span>
+                                </td>
+                                <td style="padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; color: #888;">Cajas</td>
+                            </tr>
+                        </tbody>
+                    </table>
+                </div>
+                <div style="margin-top: 2rem;">
+                    <label
+                        style="font-weight: 600; color: #666; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Observaciones</label>
+                    <textarea name="notes" placeholder="Notas internas..."
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 0.5rem; min-height: 80px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.95rem;"></textarea>
+                </div>
+            </div>
+        </div>
+    </div>
+
+    <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;">
+        <button type="button" onclick="window.open('/maintenance/report/print?type=planning', '_blank')" class="btn"
+            style="color: var(--odoo-link); background: none; border: none; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer;">
+            🖨 Versión Imprimible PDF
+        </button>
+    </div>
+</form>
+
+<script>
+    // --- Global UI References (Declared at top to avoid TDZ) ---
+    const searchInput = document.getElementById('articleSearch');
+    const resultsDiv = document.getElementById('articleResults');
+    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('articleHidden');
+
+    // Form Inputs
+    const documentNumberInput = document.getElementById('documentNumber');
+    const batchInput = document.querySelector('input[name="batches"]');
+    const kgPerBatchInput = document.getElementById('kgPerBatch');
+    const totalKgInput = document.getElementById('totalKgInput');
+    const wastePercentageInput = document.getElementById('wastePercentageInput');
+
+    const presentationInput = document.getElementById('presentationInput');
+    const unitsInput = document.getElementById('unitsInput');
+    const boxesInput = document.getElementById('boxesInput');
+
+    // Search Correlative
+    const searchInputCorr = document.getElementById('searchCorrelative');
+    const searchSuggestions = document.getElementById('searchSuggestions');
+
+    // State
+    let articlesData = [];
+    let currentBoxEquiv = 0;
+
+    // --- Search & Edit Logic ---
+    async function searchPlan() {
+        const query = searchInputCorr.value;
+        if (!query) return;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/planning/search?query=${query}`);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("No encontrado");
+            const plan = await res.json();
+            loadPlanIntoForm(plan);
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Documento no encontrado");
+        }
+    }
+
+    function loadPlanIntoForm(plan) {
+        // Set ID
+        document.getElementById('planId').value = plan.id;
+        documentNumberInput.value = plan.order_number.toString().padStart(8, '0');
+
+        // Populate Fields
+        searchInput.value = plan.article;
+        hiddenInput.value = plan.article;
+        batchInput.value = plan.batches;
+        document.querySelector('input[name="date"]').value = plan.date;
+        presentationInput.value = plan.presentation;
+        wastePercentageInput.value = plan.waste_percentage;
+        kgPerBatchInput.value = (plan.kg / plan.batches).toFixed(2);
+        totalKgInput.value = plan.kg;
+        unitsInput.value = plan.units;
+        boxesInput.value = plan.boxes;
+        document.querySelector('textarea[name="notes"]').value = plan.notes || "";
+
+        // UI State
+        setReadOnly(true);
+        document.getElementById('btnConfirm').style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Status Logic: Loaded = Green (Confirmed)
+        updateStatusUI('confirmed');
+    }
+
+    function updateStatusUI(state) {
+        const draft = document.getElementById('statusDraft');
+        const confirmed = document.getElementById('statusConfirmed');
+
+        // Reset classes
+        draft.classList.remove('active', 'status-red', 'status-yellow');
+        confirmed.classList.remove('active', 'status-green');
+
+        if (state === 'new') {
+            draft.classList.add('active', 'status-red');
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').style.display = 'inline-block';
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').textContent = "Confirmar";
+        } else if (state === 'edit') {
+            draft.classList.add('active', 'status-yellow');
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').style.display = 'inline-block';
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').textContent = "Guardar Cambios";
+        } else if (state === 'confirmed') {
+            confirmed.classList.add('active', 'status-green');
+        }
+    }
+
+    function setReadOnly(state) {
+        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('#planningForm input:not(#searchCorrelative), #planningForm textarea');
+        inputs.forEach(input => {
+            if (input.id !== 'documentNumber') {
+                input.disabled = state;
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function enableEdit() {
+        const planId = document.getElementById('planId').value;
+        setReadOnly(false);
+        updateStatusUI(planId ? 'edit' : 'new');
+    }
+
+    // Navigation
+    async function navigateRecord(direction) {
+        const planId = document.getElementById('planId').value;
+        let url;
+
+        if (!planId) {
+            if (direction === 'prev') {
+                url = '/api/planning/latest';
+            } else {
+                return;
+            }
+        } else {
+            url = `/api/planning/${planId}/navigate?direction=${direction}`;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("No hay más registros");
+            const plan = await res.json();
+            loadPlanIntoForm(plan);
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.log("Navigation limit reached");
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Autocomplete Logic
+    searchInputCorr.addEventListener('input', async (e) => {
+        const val = e.target.value;
+        if (val.length < 1) {
+            searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/planning/autosuggest?query=${val}`);
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                if (data.length > 0) {
+                    searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '';
+                    data.forEach(item => {
+                        const div = document.createElement('div');
+                        div.style.padding = '8px';
+                        div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                        div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                        div.textContent = `Documento #${item.order_number}`;
+                        div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f9f9f9';
+                        div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+                        div.onclick = () => {
+                            searchInputCorr.value = item.order_number;
+                            searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+                            searchPlan();
+                        };
+                        searchSuggestions.appendChild(div);
+                    });
+                    searchSuggestions.style.display = 'block';
+                } else {
+                    searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
+    });
+
+    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+        if (!searchInputCorr.contains(e.target) && !searchSuggestions.contains(e.target)) {
+            searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    searchInputCorr.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') searchPlan();
+    });
+
+    // Fetch Next Correlative ID
+    async function loadNextId() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/next-id/planning');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            const nextId = data.next_id || 1;
+            documentNumberInput.value = nextId.toString().padStart(8, '0');
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Failed to load next ID", e);
+            documentNumberInput.value = "00000000";
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Load Articles
+    async function loadArticles() {
+        try {
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Cargando artículos...";
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error fetching articles');
+            articlesData = await res.json();
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Producto a construir...";
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Error conexión";
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Progressive Search Logic
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        if (term.length < 1) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a =>
+            a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term)
+        );
+
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach(item => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.style.padding = '0.5rem';
+                div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f1f1f1';
+                div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+
+                div.onclick = () => {
+                    selectArticle(item);
+                };
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    function selectArticle(item) {
+        searchInput.value = item.description;
+        hiddenInput.value = item.description;
+        resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Store equivalence
+        currentBoxEquiv = item.box_equiv || 0;
+
+        // Smart Extraction
+        const regex = /(\d+(?:\.|,)?\d*\s*(?:g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b)/i;
+        const match = item.description.match(regex);
+
+        if (match) {
+            presentationInput.value = match[1].replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
+        } else {
+            presentationInput.value = "";
+        }
+
+        // Equivalence Feedback
+        const boxesHelper = document.getElementById('boxesHelper');
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0) {
+            boxesHelper.textContent = `(Factor: ${currentBoxEquiv} Und/Caja)`;
+            boxesHelper.style.color = '#16a34a'; // Green
+        } else {
+            boxesHelper.textContent = `(Factor: No definido)`;
+            boxesHelper.style.color = '#dc2626'; // Red
+        }
+
+        // Recalculate
+        calculateTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    // Calculators
+    function parseLocaleFloat(val) {
+        if (!val) return 0;
+        return parseFloat(val.toString().replace(',', '.')) || 0;
+    }
+
+    function calculateTotalKg() {
+        const batches = parseFloat(batchInput.value) || 0;
+        const kgBatch = parseLocaleFloat(kgPerBatchInput.value);
+        const wastePct = parseLocaleFloat(wastePercentageInput.value) || 0;
+
+        if (batches > 0 && kgBatch > 0) {
+            let grossTotal = batches * kgBatch;
+            let netTotal = grossTotal * (1 - (wastePct / 100));
+
+            totalKgInput.value = netTotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
+        }
+        calculateUnitsFromTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    batchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    kgPerBatchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    wastePercentageInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+
+    function getPresentationWeightKg() {
+        const val = presentationInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
+        const match = val.match(/([\d,\.]+)\s*(g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b/);
+
+        if (!match) return 0;
+
+        let num = parseFloat(match[1].replace(',', '.'));
+        let unit = match[2];
+
+        if (isNaN(num)) return 0;
+
+        switch (unit) {
+            case 'g':
+            case 'gr':
+            case 'ml':
+            case 'cc': return num / 1000;
+            case 'kg':
+            case 'l': return num;
+            case 'ton': return num * 1000;
+            case 'lb': return num * 0.453592;
+            case 'oz': return num * 0.0283495;
+            default: return 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function calculateUnitsFromTotalKg() {
+        const totalKg = parseLocaleFloat(totalKgInput.value);
+        const presKg = getPresentationWeightKg();
+
+        if (totalKg > 0 && presKg > 0) {
+            const units = Math.floor(totalKg / presKg);
+            unitsInput.value = units;
+            calculateBoxesFromUnits();
+        }
+    }
+
+    presentationInput.addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromTotalKg);
+
+    function calculateBoxesFromUnits() {
+        const units = parseFloat(unitsInput.value) || 0;
+
+        // Try to recover equiv if missing
+        if (currentBoxEquiv === 0) {
+            const currentDesc = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
+            const found = articlesData.find(a => a.description.toLowerCase() === currentDesc);
+            if (found) {
+                currentBoxEquiv = found.box_equiv || 0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0) {
+            boxesInput.value = (units / currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(2);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function calculateUnitsFromBoxes() {
+        const boxes = parseLocaleFloat(boxesInput.value);
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && boxes > 0) {
+            unitsInput.value = (boxes * currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(0);
+        }
+    }
+
+    boxesInput.addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromBoxes);
+    unitsInput.addEventListener('input', calculateBoxesFromUnits);
+
+    // Close dropdown
+    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    function calculateUnitsFromBoxes() {
+        const boxes = parseLocaleFloat(boxesInput.value);
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && boxes > 0) {
+            unitsInput.value = (boxes * currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(0);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Close dropdown
+    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    // Set default date to today
+    document.querySelector('input[name="date"]').valueAsDate = new Date();
+
+    loadArticles();
+    loadNextId();
+
+    document.getElementById('planningForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+        const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+        const data = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());
+
+        // Sanitization
+        if (!data.article || data.article.trim() === "") {
+            alert("Por favor, seleccione un producto válido.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            data.kg = parseLocaleFloat(data.kg);
+            data.boxes = parseLocaleFloat(data.boxes);
+            data.batches = parseInt(data.batches) || 0;
+            data.kg = parseLocaleFloat(data.kg);
+            data.boxes = parseLocaleFloat(data.boxes);
+            data.batches = parseInt(data.batches) || 0;
+            data.units = parseInt(data.units) || 0;
+            data.waste_percentage = parseLocaleFloat(data.waste_percentage);
+        } catch (err) {
+            alert("Error en formato de números");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const planId = document.getElementById('planId').value;
+        const method = planId ? 'PUT' : 'POST';
+        const url = planId ? `/api/planning/${planId}` : '/api/planning';
+
+        const response = await fetch(url, {
+            method: method,
+            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+            body: JSON.stringify(data)
+        });
+
+        if (response.ok) {
+            showSuccessModal();
+        } else {
+            alert('Error al guardar');
+        }
+    });
+</script>
+
+<!-- Success Modal -->
+<div id="successModal"
+    style="display: none; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 9999; justify-content: center; align-items: center; backdrop-filter: blur(2px);">
+    <div class="card"
+        style="width: 400px; padding: 2rem; text-align: center; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); animation: slideIn 0.3s ease-out; background: white; border-radius: 8px;">
+        <div style="font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">✅</div>
+        <h2 style="margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: #16a34a;">Registro Guardado</h2>
+        <p style="color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">La información se ha guardado correctamente.</p>
+        <button onclick="closeSuccessAndReload()" class="btn"
+            style="width: 100%; justify-content: center; background: var(--odoo-primary); color: white; padding: 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;">Aceptar</button>
+    </div>
+</div>
+<script>
+    function showSuccessModal() {
+        document.getElementById('successModal').style.display = 'flex';
+    }
+    function closeSuccessAndReload() {
+        window.location.reload();
+    }
+</script>

+{% endblock %}

+<script>
+    // ... (Existing loadArticles logic) ...
+    let articlesData = [];
+
+    async function loadArticles() {
+        const searchInput = document.getElementById('articleSearch');
+        try {
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Cargando datos...";
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error');
+            articlesData = await res.json();
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Escriba para buscar artículo...";
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error('API External Error:', e);
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Error cargando artículos";
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Progressive Search Logic
+    const searchInput = document.getElementById('articleSearch');
+    const resultsDiv = document.getElementById('articleResults');
+    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('articleTypeHidden');
+
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        if (term.length < 1) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a =>
+            a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term)
+        );
+
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach(item => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.style.padding = '0.5rem';
+                div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f1f1f1';
+                div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+
+                div.onclick = () => {
+                    selectArticle(item);
+                };
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    let currentBoxEquiv = 0;
+
+    function selectArticle(item) {
+        searchInput.value = item.description;
+        hiddenInput.value = item.description;
+        resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Auto-fill logic
+        document.getElementById('baseUnit').value = item.unit;
+        if (item.unit) {
+            document.getElementById('consType').value = item.unit;
+        }
+
+        currentBoxEquiv = item.box_equiv || 0;
+
+        // Smart Extraction for Presentation (e.g., "BOLSA 600g")
+        const regex = /(\d+(?:\.|,)?\d*\s*(?:g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b)/i;
+        const match = item.description.match(regex);
+
+        const presentationInput = document.getElementById('presentationInput');
+        if (match) {
+            presentationInput.value = match[1].replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
+        } else {
+            presentationInput.value = "";
+        }
+
+        // Recalculate everything based on new article/presentation
+        calculateUnitsFromTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    // Presentation Parser
+    function getPresentationWeightKg() {
+        const val = document.getElementById('presentationInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
+        // Regex for number + unit
+        const match = val.match(/([\d,\.]+)\s*(g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b/);
+
+        if (!match) return 0;
+
+        let num = parseFloat(match[1].replace(',', '.'));
+        let unit = match[2];
+
+        if (isNaN(num)) return 0;
+
+        switch (unit) {
+            case 'g':
+            case 'gr':
+            case 'ml':
+            case 'cc': return num / 1000;
+            case 'kg':
+            case 'l': return num;
+            case 'ton': return num * 1000;
+            case 'lb': return num * 0.453592;
+            case 'oz': return num * 0.0283495;
+            default: return 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Kg Calculator
+    const batchInput = document.querySelector('input[name="batch_qty"]');
+    const kgPerBatchInput = document.getElementById('kgPerBatch');
+    const totalKgInput = document.getElementById('totalKgInput');
+
+    function parseLocaleFloat(val) {
+        if (!val) return 0;
+        return parseFloat(val.toString().replace(',', '.')) || 0;
+    }
+
+    function calculateTotalKg() {
+        const batches = parseFloat(batchInput.value) || 0;
+        const kgBatch = parseLocaleFloat(kgPerBatchInput.value);
+        if (batches > 0 && kgBatch > 0) {
+            // Apply Waste Deduction logic from Planning
+            const wastePct = parseFloat(document.getElementById('wastePercentageHidden').value) || 0;
+            let grossTotal = batches * kgBatch;
+            let netTotal = grossTotal * (1 - (wastePct / 100));
+
+            totalKgInput.value = netTotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
+        }
+        calculateUnitsFromTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    batchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    kgPerBatchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    document.getElementById('presentationInput').addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromTotalKg);
+
+    // Calculation Logic: Bidirectional Boxes <-> Units
+    const boxesInput = document.getElementById('boxesInput');
+    const unitsInput = document.getElementById('unitsInput');
+
+    // Triggered when Total Kg changes
+    function calculateUnitsFromTotalKg() {
+        const totalKg = parseLocaleFloat(totalKgInput.value);
+        const presKg = getPresentationWeightKg();
+
+        if (totalKg > 0 && presKg > 0) {
+            const units = Math.floor(totalKg / presKg);
+            unitsInput.value = units;
+            calculateBoxesFromUnits();
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Triggered when Units manually changed
+    // Triggered when Units manually changed
+    function calculateBoxesFromUnits() {
+        const units = parseFloat(unitsInput.value) || 0;
+
+        // Try to find equiv if missing (e.g. manual entry or loaded form)
+        if (currentBoxEquiv === 0) {
+            const currentDesc = document.getElementById('articleSearch').value.trim();
+            if (currentDesc && articlesData.length > 0) {
+                // Case insensitive match
+                const found = articlesData.find(a => a.description.toLowerCase() === currentDesc.toLowerCase());
+                if (found) currentBoxEquiv = found.box_equiv || 0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0) {
+            boxesInput.value = (units / currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(2);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Triggered when Boxes manually changed
+    function calculateUnitsFromBoxes() {
+        const boxes = parseLocaleFloat(boxesInput.value);
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && boxes > 0) {
+            unitsInput.value = (boxes * currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(0);
+        }
+    }
+
+    boxesInput.addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromBoxes);
+    unitsInput.addEventListener('input', calculateBoxesFromUnits);
+
+    // Close dropdown when clicking outside
+    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    // Consumo Rapido Calculator
+    const consCountInput = document.getElementById('consCount');
+    const consUnitWeightInput = document.getElementById('consUnitWeight');
+    const consTotalWeightInput = document.getElementById('consTotalWeight');
+
+    function calculateConsWeight() {
+        const count = parseLocaleFloat(consCountInput.value);
+        const unitWeight = parseLocaleFloat(consUnitWeightInput.value);
+        if (count > 0 && unitWeight > 0) {
+            consTotalWeightInput.value = (count * unitWeight).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
+        }
+    }
+
+    consCountInput.addEventListener('input', calculateConsWeight);
+    consUnitWeightInput.addEventListener('input', calculateConsWeight);
+

+    const consTypeSelect = document.getElementById('consType');
+    consTypeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
+        if (consTypeSelect.value === 'Galon') {
+            consUnitWeightInput.value = "3,3";
+            calculateConsWeight();

+                fileNameSpan.style.fontWeight = '500';
+            } else {
+                fileNameSpan.textContent = "Toca para subir foto...";
+                fileNameSpan.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
+                fileNameSpan.style.fontWeight = 'normal';
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    document.getElementById('productionForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+        const form = e.target;
+        const formData = new FormData(form);
+
+        // Ensure Article Type is set (fallback to search text)
+        if (!formData.get('article_type') || formData.get('article_type').trim() === '') {
+            const searchText = document.getElementById('articleSearch').value;
+            if (searchText) {
+                formData.set('article_type', searchText);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Client-side validation/formatting if needed
+        // Note: FormData values are strings/blobs. The backend FastApi Form features will cast them.
+        // However, we might want to ensure dots instead of commas for floats before sending?
+        // Or simply trust the backend to handle standard float string if locale matches?
+        // Let's replace comma with dot in formData for float fields to be safe
+
+        const floatFields = ['kg_produced', 'boxes', 'cons_count', 'cons_unit_weight', 'cons_qty', 'mp_waste_kg'];
+
+        for (const field of floatFields) {
+            const val = formData.get(field);
+            // Replace comma, and ensure not empty string
+            if (val && typeof val === 'string') {
+                const cleaned = val.replace(',', '.');
+                if (cleaned.trim() === '') {
+                    formData.set(field, "0");
+                } else {
+                    formData.set(field, cleaned);
+                }
+            } else if (!val) {
+                // If null or empty, send 0
+                formData.set(field, "0");
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Sanitize Integers as well
+        const intFields = ['batch_qty', 'pt_units', 'pt_lab', 'pt_burned', 'mp_containers', 'mp_caps_clean', 'mp_caps_dirty'];
+        for (const field of intFields) {
+            const val = formData.get(field);
+            if (!val || val.toString().trim() === '') {
+                formData.set(field, "0");
+            }
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const id = document.getElementById('reportId').value;
+            const method = id ? 'PUT' : 'POST';
+            const url = id ? `/api/production/${id}` : '/api/production';
+
+            let body;
+            let headers = {};
+
+            if (method === 'POST') {
+                body = formData;
+            } else {
+                const obj = {};
+                formData.forEach((value, key) => {
+                    // Exclude File objects (images) from JSON update
+                    if (value instanceof File) return;
+                    obj[key] = value;
+                });
+                body = JSON.stringify(obj);
+                headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
+            }
+
+            const response = await fetch(url, {
+                method: method,
+                headers: headers,
+                body: body
+            });
+
+            if (response.ok) {
+                // Remove alert and immediate reload
+                form.reset();
+                document.getElementById('totalKgInput').value = '';
+                document.getElementById('consTotalWeight').value = '';
+
+                showSuccessModal();
+            } else {
+                let errorMsg = 'Error desconocido';
+                try {
+                    // Read text first to avoid 'body stream already read'
+                    const text = await response.text();
+                    try {
+                        const err = JSON.parse(text);
+                        errorMsg = JSON.stringify(err.detail || err);
+                    } catch (e) {
+                        // Not JSON, use text
+                        errorMsg = text || response.statusText;
+                    }
+                } catch (readErr) {
+                    errorMsg = "Error leyendo respuesta del servidor";
+                }
+                alert('Error al guardar reporte (' + response.status + '): ' + errorMsg);
+            }
+        } catch (error) {
+            console.error(error);
+            alert('Error de conexión o red: ' + error.message);
+        }
+    });
+

+<script>

+    // 1. Search & Autosuggest
+    const reportSearchInput = document.getElementById('reportSearchInput');
+    const suggestions = document.getElementById('searchSuggestions');
+
+    reportSearchInput.addEventListener('input', async (e) => {
+        const val = e.target.value;
+        if (val.length < 1) { suggestions.style.display = 'none'; return; }
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/production/autosuggest?query=${val}`);
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                suggestions.innerHTML = '';
+                if (data.length > 0) {
+                    data.forEach(item => {
+                        const div = document.createElement('div');
+                        div.textContent = `Reporte #${item.order_number}`;
+                        div.style.padding = '8px'; div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                        div.onclick = () => {
+                            reportSearchInput.value = item.order_number;
+                            suggestions.style.display = 'none';
+                            searchReport();
+                        }
+                        suggestions.appendChild(div);
+                    });
+                    suggestions.style.display = 'block';
+                } else suggestions.style.display = 'none';
+            }
+        } catch (e) { }
+    });
+
+    async function searchReport() {
+        const query = reportSearchInput.value;
+        if (!query) return;
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/production/search?query=${query}`);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("No encontrado");
+            const data = await res.json();
+            loadReportIntoForm(data);
+        } catch (e) { alert(e.message); }
+    }

+    // 2. Navigation
+    async function navigateRecord(direction) {
+        const id = document.getElementById('reportId').value;
+        let url;
+        if (!id && direction === 'prev') url = '/api/production/latest';
+        else if (id) url = `/api/production/${id}/navigate?direction=${direction}`;
+        else return;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("No hay más");
+            const data = await res.json();
+            loadReportIntoForm(data);
+        } catch (e) { }
+    }

+        setReadOnly(false);
+        const id = document.getElementById('reportId').value;
+        updateStatusUI(id ? 'edit' : 'new');
+    }
+
+    async function navigateRecord(direction) {
+        const currentId = document.getElementById('reportId').value;
+        let url;
+
+        if (!currentId) {
+            // If new/empty, 'prev' should load the latest record
+            if (direction === 'prev') url = '/api/production/latest';
+            else return;
+        } else {
+            url = `/api/production/${currentId}/navigate?direction=${direction}`;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("No record");
+            const data = await res.json();
+            loadReportIntoForm(data);
+        } catch (e) {
+            // alert("Debug: " + e.message); // Only for dev
+            if (e.message.includes('No record') || e.message.includes('404')) {
+                alert("No hay más registros.");
+            } else {
+                alert("Error de navegación: " + e.message);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    // 5. Submit (PUT/POST logic)
+    // 5. Submit Logic is handled in the main script block above.
+
+
+    // Init with ID
+    async function loadNextId() {
+        // Implement /api/next-id/production logic? 
+        // Re-use planning one or create new?
+        // Not critical for 'New' look, but good to have.
+        try {
+            // Assuming similar endpoint exists or create it?
+            // Let's skip auto-ID fetch for now or use 00000000
+            const numDisplay = document.getElementById('orderNumberDisplay');
+            if (numDisplay) numDisplay.innerText = "00000000";
+        } catch (e) { }
+    }
+    loadNextId();
+

+<script>
+    // Modal Logic
+    const modal = document.getElementById("planningModal");
+    const modalBody = document.getElementById("planningModalBody");
+    const loadingDiv = document.getElementById("planningLoading");
+
+    function openPlanningModal() {
+        modal.style.display = "block";
+        // Disable scrolling on body
+        document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
+        fetchPendingPlans();
+    }
+
+    function closePlanningModal() {
+        modal.style.display = "none";
+        document.body.style.overflow = "auto";
+    }
+
+    window.onclick = function (event) {
+        if (event.target == modal) {
+            closePlanningModal();
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function fetchPendingPlans() {
+        modalBody.innerHTML = "";
+        loadingDiv.style.display = "block";
+
+        try {
+            const response = await fetch('/api/planning/pending');
+            const plans = await response.json();
+            loadingDiv.style.display = "none";
+
+            if (plans.length === 0) {
+                modalBody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; padding: 3rem; color: #6b7280;'>No hay órdenes de planificación pendientes.</td></tr>";
+                return;
+            }
+
+            plans.forEach(plan => {
+                const row = document.createElement("tr");
+                row.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #f3f4f6";
+                row.style.cursor = "pointer";
+                row.style.transition = "background-color 0.15s";
+                row.onmouseover = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "#eff6ff"; };
+                row.onmouseout = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "transparent"; };
+                row.onclick = function () { selectPlanningOrder(plan); };
+
+                const idClean = plan.label.split(" - ")[0].replace('#', '');
+
+                // Calculate Pending Batches for Display
+                let displayQty = `${plan.units} unid`; // Fallback
+                if (plan.total_units && plan.batches && plan.batches > 0) {
+                    const unitsPerBatch = plan.total_units / plan.batches;
+                    const pBatches = (plan.units / unitsPerBatch).toFixed(2);
+                    displayQty = `${parseFloat(pBatches)} batches`; // parseFloat to remove unnecessary decimals
+                }
+
+                row.innerHTML = `
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 700; color: #2563eb;">#${idClean}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; color: #111827; font-weight: 500;">${plan.article}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; text-align: right; color: #374151; font-weight: 600;">
+                            <span style="background-color: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem;">${displayQty}</span>
+                        </td>
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; text-align: center;">
+                            <button style="
+                                background-color: #4f46e5; 
+                                color: white; 
+                                border: none; 
+                                padding: 6px 12px; 
+                                border-radius: 4px; 
+                                font-size: 0.75rem; 
+                                font-weight: 600; 
+                                text-transform: uppercase; 
+                                letter-spacing: 0.05em; 
+                                cursor: pointer; 
+                                box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
+                                transition: background-color 0.2s;
+                            " 
+                            onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='#4338ca'"
+                            onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='#4f46e5'">
+                                <span style="margin-right:4px;">CLICK</span>
+                            </button>
+                        </td>
+                    `;
+                modalBody.appendChild(row);
+            });
+
+        } catch (error) {
+            console.error("Error fetching plans:", error);
+            loadingDiv.style.display = "none";
+            modalBody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; padding: 2rem; color: #ef4444;'>Error al cargar los datos</td></tr>";
+        }
+    }
+
+    function selectPlanningOrder(plan) {
+        // Populate Form
+        document.getElementById('planningSearch').value = plan.label;
+        document.getElementById('planningOrderIdHidden').value = plan.id;
+        document.getElementById('wastePercentageHidden').value = plan.waste_percentage || 0;
+
+        // Auto-fill Article
+        document.getElementById('articleSearch').value = plan.article;
+        document.getElementById('articleTypeHidden').value = plan.article;
+
+        // Auto-fill Quantity (Batches)
+        // Logic: Calculate ratio (Total Units / Total Batches) = Units per Batch
+        // Then: Pending Units / Units per Batch = Pending Batches
+        let pendingBatches = 0;
+        if (plan.total_units && plan.batches && plan.batches > 0) {
+            const unitsPerBatch = plan.total_units / plan.batches;
+            pendingBatches = (plan.units / unitsPerBatch).toFixed(2); // plan.units here is 'pending_units' from API
+            // Handle edge case if result is NaN/Infinite
+            if (!isFinite(pendingBatches)) pendingBatches = 0;
+        } else {
+            // Fallback if data missing
+            pendingBatches = 0;
+        }
+
+        const qtyInput = document.querySelector('input[name="batch_qty"]');
+        qtyInput.value = parseFloat(pendingBatches); // Remove trailing zeros if integer
+        qtyInput.placeholder = "0.00";
+
+        // Auto-fill Presentation if available
+        if (plan.presentation) {
+            document.getElementsByName('presentation')[0].value = plan.presentation;
+        }
+
+        closePlanningModal();
+    }
+</script>

+    <div class="card"

+                        <a href="/logistics/dispatch/{{ item.id }}/print" target="_blank" class="btn-filter"
+                            style="text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; width: auto; padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem;">
+                            🖨️ Imprimir
+                        </a>
+                        {% endif %}
+                    </td>

+                    <!-- Inventory now returns Headers, not flattened Capture Objects 
+                         We need to adjust fields: date, correlative, status, notes -->
+                    <td>{{ item.date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if item.date else '-' }}</td>

+                    <td>
+                        <a href="/reports/inventory/print/{{ item.id }}" target="_blank" class="btn-filter"
+                            style="text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; width: auto; padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem;">
+                            🖨️ Imprimir
+                        </a>
+                    </td>
+                    {% endif %}
+                </tr>

+            </tbody>
+        </table>
+    </div>
+</div>

+<script>
+    // JS to parse JSON cells
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.json-cell').forEach(td => {
+            try {
+                const raw = td.getAttribute('data-json');
+                if (!raw) return;
+                const data = JSON.parse(raw);
+                if (Array.isArray(data)) {
+                    // Summarize: "3 Items: Item A (10)..."
+                    const count = data.length;
+                    const preview = data.slice(0, 2).map(i => `${i.item} (${i.qty})`).join(', ');
+                    const text = `${count} Items: ${preview}${count > 2 ? '...' : ''}`;
+                    td.textContent = text;
+                    td.title = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2); // Tooltip full details
+                }
+            } catch (e) {
+                td.textContent = '(Error parsing details)';
+            }
+        });
+    });
+</script>

+
+    <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
+        <table class="table" style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; display: none;" id="forecastTable">
+            <thead>
+                <tr style="background: var(--surface);">
+                    <th style="padding: 1rem; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); width: 15%; cursor: pointer;"
+                        onclick="setSort('co_art')" title="Clic para ordenar">
+                        Código <span id="sort_co_art" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--primary);"></span>
+                    </th>
+                    <th style="padding: 1rem; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); width: 25%; cursor: pointer;"
+                        onclick="setSort('article_name')" title="Clic para ordenar">
+                        Artículo <span id="sort_article_name" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--primary);">▲</span>
+                    </th>
+                    <th style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); color: #64748b; cursor: pointer; width: 15%;"
+                        onclick="setSort('total_past_3m')" title="Clic para ordenar">
+                        Venta Histórica<br><small id="lblHistoryDates" style="font-weight:normal;"></small> <span
+                            id="sort_total_past_3m" style="font-size: 0.8rem;"></span>
+                    </th>
+                    <th style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); color: #3b82f6; cursor: pointer; width: 20%;"
+                        onclick="setSort('suggested_qty')" title="Clic para ordenar">
+                        Sug. Mensual<br><small>(Promedio Móvil)</small> <span id="sort_suggested_qty"
+                            style="font-size: 0.8rem;"></span>
+                        <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: normal; margin-top: 0.2rem;">UND / CAJ</div>

+<script>
+    const canEditStr = "{{ 'true' if user and user.role in [1, 4, 8] else 'false' }}";
+    const canEdit = (canEditStr === "true");
+    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
+        document.getElementById('selMonth').value = "{{ default_month }}";
+    });
+
+    let currentForecastData = [];
+    let displayData = [];
+    let sortCol = 'article_name';
+    let sortAsc = true;
+
+    async function loadForecast() {
+        const m = document.getElementById('selMonth').value;
+        const y = document.getElementById('inpYear').value;
+
+        document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'block';
+        document.getElementById('forecastTable').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('btnSave').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/sales/api/forecast/generate?month=${m}&year=${y}`);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Error interno");
+
+            const data = await res.json();
+            currentForecastData = data.data;
+
+            document.getElementById('lblHistoryDates').innerText = `${data.start_history} - ${data.end_history}`;
+
+            applyFilter();
+
+            document.getElementById('forecastTable').style.display = 'table';
+            document.getElementById('summaryStats').style.display = 'grid';
+            document.getElementById('btnSave').style.display = 'block';
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("No se pudo cargar la sugerencia.");
+        } finally {
+            document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    }
+
+    function setSort(col) {
+        if (sortCol === col) {
+            sortAsc = !sortAsc;
+        } else {
+            sortCol = col;
+            sortAsc = true;
+        }
+        applyFilter();
+    }
+
+    function applyFilter() {
+        // Since we removed inputs, displayData is exactly the same array, just sorted
+        displayData = [...currentForecastData];
+
+        displayData.sort((a, b) => {
+            let va = a[sortCol];
+            let vb = b[sortCol];
+            if (typeof va === 'string') return sortAsc ? va.localeCompare(vb) : vb.localeCompare(va);
+            return sortAsc ? va - vb : vb - va;
+        });
+
+        ['co_art', 'article_name', 'total_past_3m', 'suggested_qty', 'estimated_qty'].forEach(c => {
+            const el = document.getElementById('sort_' + c);
+            if (el) el.innerText = (c === sortCol) ? (sortAsc ? '▲' : '▼') : '';
+        });
+
+        renderTable();
+    }
+
+    function renderTable() {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('forecastBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        let sumAvg = 0;
+        let sumFinal = 0;
+
+        currentForecastData.forEach(row => {
+            sumAvg += row.suggested_qty;
+            sumFinal += row.estimated_qty;
+        });
+
+        displayData.forEach((row) => {
+            const idx = currentForecastData.indexOf(row);
+            const isAdj = Math.abs(row.suggested_qty - row.estimated_qty) > 0.01;
+            const bg = isAdj ? 'background: #f0fdf4;' : '';
+
+            const equivText = (row.equiv > 1) ? ` <span style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.8rem;">/ ${row.suggested_boxes.toLocaleString()} CJ</span>` : '';
+            const finalEquivText = (row.equiv > 1) ? `<div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #10b981; margin-top: 0.3rem;">${row.estimated_boxes.toLocaleString()} CJ</div>` : '';
+
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.style.cssText = `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); ${bg}`;
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.85rem;">${row.co_art}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500;">${row.article_name}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: center; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500;">${row.total_past_3m.toLocaleString()}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; color: #3b82f6;">
+                    ${row.suggested_qty.toLocaleString()} UND<br>${equivText}
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; text-align: center;">
+                    <input type="number" step="0.01" value="${row.estimated_qty}" 
+                    style="width: 100px; padding: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid ${isAdj ? '#10b981' : 'var(--border)'}; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; color: ${isAdj ? '#047857' : 'inherit'};"
+                    onchange="updateEstimatedQty(${idx}, this.value)"
+                    ${canEdit ? "" : "disabled"} >
+                    ${finalEquivText}
+                </td >
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+
+        document.getElementById('statSkus').innerText = currentForecastData.length;
+        document.getElementById('statAvg').innerText = Math.round(sumAvg).toLocaleString();
+        document.getElementById('statFinal').innerText = Math.round(sumFinal).toLocaleString();
+    }
+
+    function updateEstimatedQty(idx, val) {
+        let num = parseFloat(val);
+        if (isNaN(num) || num < 0) num = 0;
+
+        let row = currentForecastData[idx];
+        row.estimated_qty = num;
+        if (row.equiv > 1) {
+            row.estimated_boxes = Math.round((num / row.equiv) * 100) / 100;
+        }
+
+        applyFilter();
+    }
+
+    async function saveForecast() {
+        const payload = {
+            month: parseInt(document.getElementById('selMonth').value),
+            year: parseInt(document.getElementById('inpYear').value),
+            rows: currentForecastData
+        };
+
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnSave');
+        const origText = btn.innerText;
+        btn.innerText = "Guardando...";
+        btn.disabled = true;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/sales/api/forecast/save', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                alert("✅ " + data.message);
+            } else {
+                alert("❌ Error: " + data.detail);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión al guardar.");
+        } finally {
+            btn.innerText = origText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+<script>
+    let chartVentas = null;
+    const fmt = (n) => new Intl.NumberFormat('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(n);
+
+    async function cargarDatos() {
+        document.getElementById('loader').style.display = 'flex';
+        document.getElementById('main-content').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('error-state').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const [estadoRes, histRes] = await Promise.all([
+                fetch('/semaforo/api/estado'),
+                fetch('/semaforo/api/historico?dias=30')
+            ]);
+
+            if (!estadoRes.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${estadoRes.status}`);
+            const data = await estadoRes.json();
+            const hist = histRes.ok ? await histRes.json() : data.historico_7dias || [];
+
+            renderSemaforo(data);
+            renderHistorico(hist, data.promedio_30);
+            renderTopClientes(data.top_clientes || []);
+
+            document.getElementById('ts-label').textContent =
+                `Actualizado: ${data.hora_consulta} · Fuente: ${data.fuente === 'carmal' ? 'Carmal' : 'Local'}`;
+
+            document.getElementById('loader').style.display = 'none';
+            document.getElementById('main-content').style.display = 'block';
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            document.getElementById('loader').style.display = 'none';
+            document.getElementById('error-state').style.display = 'block';
+            document.getElementById('error-msg').textContent = e.message;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderSemaforo(d) {
+        // Luces
+        ['rojo', 'amarillo', 'verde'].forEach(c => {
+            document.getElementById(`light-${c}`).className = 'light';
+        });
+        const est = d.estado; // verde | amarillo | rojo | sin_datos
+        if (['verde', 'amarillo', 'rojo'].includes(est)) {
+            document.getElementById(`light-${est}`).classList.add(`active-${est}`);
+        }
+
+        // Badge
+        const badge = document.getElementById('estado-badge');
+        badge.className = `estado-badge badge-${est}`;
+        const labels = { verde: '✅ En Meta', amarillo: '⚠️ Alerta', rojo: '🚨 Bajo Meta', sin_datos: '⚪ Sin Datos' };
+        badge.textContent = labels[est] || est;
+
+        // Barra progreso
+        const pct = Math.min(d.pct, 150);
+        const bar = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
+        bar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
+        const colors = { verde: 'var(--verde)', amarillo: 'var(--amarillo)', rojo: 'var(--rojo)', sin_datos: 'var(--gris)' };
+        bar.style.background = colors[est];
+        document.getElementById('pct-label').textContent = `${d.pct}%`;
+        document.getElementById('pct-label').style.color = colors[est];
+
+        // Métricas
+        document.getElementById('val-hoy').textContent = fmt(d.hoy);
+        document.getElementById('val-prom').textContent = fmt(d.promedio_30);
+        const diff = d.diferencia;
+        const diffEl = document.getElementById('val-diff');
+        diffEl.textContent = (diff >= 0 ? '+' : '') + fmt(diff);
+        diffEl.style.color = diff >= 0 ? 'var(--verde)' : 'var(--rojo)';
+    }
+
+    function renderHistorico(hist, promedio) {
+        const labels = hist.map(h => {
+            const d = new Date(h.dia + 'T00:00:00');
+            return d.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' });
+        });
+        const totales = hist.map(h => h.total);
+        const promArr = hist.map(() => promedio);
+
+        const ctx = document.getElementById('chart-ventas').getContext('2d');
+        if (chartVentas) chartVentas.destroy();
+
+        chartVentas = new Chart(ctx, {
+            type: 'bar',
+            data: {
+                labels,
+                datasets: [
+                    {
+                        label: 'Ventas diarias',
+                        data: totales,
+                        backgroundColor: totales.map(v =>
+                            v >= promedio * 0.9 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,.7)' :
+                                v >= promedio * 0.7 ? 'rgba(234,179,8,.7)' :
+                                    'rgba(239,68,68,.7)'
+                        ),
+                        borderRadius: 4,
+                        order: 2
+                    },
+                    {
+                        label: 'Promedio 30d',
+                        data: promArr,
+                        type: 'line',
+                        borderColor: 'rgba(148,163,184,.6)',
+                        borderDash: [5, 5],
+                        borderWidth: 2,
+                        pointRadius: 0,
+                        fill: false,
+                        order: 1
+                    }
+                ]
+            },
+            options: {
+                responsive: true,
+                plugins: {
+                    legend: { labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 11 } } },
+                    tooltip: {
+                        callbacks: {
+                            label: ctx => ` ${fmt(ctx.raw)}`
+                        }
+                    }
+                },
+                scales: {
+                    x: { ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 10 } }, grid: { color: '#1e293b' } },
+                    y: { ticks: { color: '#64748b', callback: v => fmt(v) }, grid: { color: '#1e293b' } }
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderTopClientes(clientes) {
+        const el = document.getElementById('top-clientes');
+        if (!clientes.length) {
+            el.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted" style="font-size:.85rem">Sin ventas registradas hoy</p>';
+            return;
+        }
+        const max = Math.max(...clientes.map(c => c.total));
+        el.innerHTML = clientes.map((c, i) => `
+      <div class="cliente-row">
+        <div>
+          <span class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.85rem">${i + 1}. ${c.cliente}</span>
+          <div style="height:4px; margin-top:4px; width:${Math.round(c.total / max * 100)}%;
+               background:rgba(99,102,241,.6); border-radius:2px"></div>
+        </div>
+        <span class="fw-bold" style="color:var(--verde); font-size:.9rem">${fmt(c.total)}</span>
+      </div>
+    `).join('');
+    }
+
+    // Auto-refresh cada 5 minutos
+    cargarDatos();
+    setInterval(cargarDatos, 5 * 60 * 1000);
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+<script>
+    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
+    const fmt = (n, d = 2) => new Intl.NumberFormat('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d }).format(n || 0);
+    const fU = n => '$' + fmt(n);
+    const fPct = n => fmt(n, 2) + ' %';
+
+    let tipoVal = 'cajas', tipoVta = '', charts = {};
+
+    // Init
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        const hoy = new Date();
+        const ini = new Date(hoy.getFullYear(), hoy.getMonth(), 1);
+        const f = d => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
+        $('f-fi').value = f(ini);
+        $('f-ff').value = f(hoy);
+        cargarVendedores().then(() => load());
+    });
+
+    async function cargarVendedores() {
+        try {
+            const r = await fetch('/semaforo2/api/vendedores');
+            if (!r.ok) return;
+            const d = await r.json();
+            const s = $('f-ven');
+            d.forEach(v => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v.co_ven; o.textContent = v.ven_des; s.appendChild(o); });
+        } catch { }
+    }
+
+    function setTV(btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.tvb-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('act')); btn.classList.add('act'); tipoVta = btn.dataset.t; }
+    function setTV2(tab) { document.querySelectorAll('.tt').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('act')); tab.classList.add('act'); tipoVal = tab.dataset.v; load(); }
+
+    async function load() {
+        $('s2-loader').style.display = 'flex'; $('s2-lm').textContent = 'Consultando Carmal…';
+        const p = new URLSearchParams({
+            fecha_ini: $('f-fi').value, fecha_fin: $('f-ff').value,
+            vendedor: $('f-ven').value, tipo_venta: tipoVta,
+            tipo_valor: tipoVal, meta: parseFloat($('f-meta').value) || 0
+        });
+        try {
+            const r = await fetch('/semaforo2/api/dashboard?' + p);
+            const d = await r.json();
+            render(d);
+            const meses = ['ene', 'feb', 'mar', 'abr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'ago', 'sep', 'oct', 'nov', 'dic'];
+            const dt = new Date($('f-fi').value + 'T00:00:00');
+            $('s2-periodo').textContent = meses[dt.getMonth()] + ' ' + dt.getFullYear();
+            $('s2-upd').textContent = 'Actualizado: ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-VE');
+        } catch (e) { $('s2-lm').textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message; setTimeout(() => $('s2-loader').style.display = 'none', 3000); return; }
+        $('s2-loader').style.display = 'none';
+    }
+
+    function render(d) {
+        const k = d.kpis, st = d.stats;
+        $('k-meta').textContent = k.meta > 0 ? fmt(k.meta, 0) : 'Sin Meta';
+        $('k-cump').textContent = fPct(k.cumplimiento_pct);
+        $('k-proy').textContent = fPct(k.cumplimiento_proyectado_pct);
+        $('k-fact').textContent = fU(k.facturado_neto);
+        $('k-pend').textContent = fU(k.pedidos_usd);
+        $('k-total').textContent = fU(k.facturado_mas_pedidos);
+        $('s-fact').textContent = fmt(k.facturado_usd, 0);
+        $('s-dev').textContent = fmt(k.devolucion_usd, 0);
+        $('s-pend').textContent = fmt(k.pedidos_usd, 0);
+        $('s-tot').textContent = fmt(k.facturado_mas_pedidos, 0);
+        $('bs1').textContent = st.dias_periodo;
+        $('bs2').textContent = st.dias_con_facturacion;
+        $('bs3').textContent = fmt(st.promedio_dia_calendario, 0);
+        $('bs4').textContent = fmt(st.promedio_dia_activos, 0);
+        $('bs5').textContent = st.num_facturas;
+        $('bs6').textContent = fmt(st.promedio_fact_diaria, 2);
+        renderMarca(d.por_marca || []);
+        renderCanal(d.por_canal || []);
+        renderTipo(d.por_tipo_pedido || []);
+        renderDiario(d.diario || []);
+    }
+
+    const PAL = ['#06b6d4', '#3b82f6', '#6366f1', '#8b5cf6', '#0ea5e9', '#22d3ee', '#818cf8'];
+    const AX = () => ({ grid: { color: 'rgba(37,48,71,.5)' }, ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 10 } }, border: { color: '#253047' } });
+    const OPT = (lgd = true, idx = 'x') => ({
+        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, indexAxis: idx,
+        plugins: {
+            legend: { display: lgd, labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 10 }, boxWidth: 12 } },
+            tooltip: {
+                backgroundColor: '#1c2333', titleColor: '#e2e8f0', bodyColor: '#94a3b8', borderColor: '#253047', borderWidth: 1,
+                callbacks: { label: c => ` ${fmt(c.raw)}` }
+            }
+        }, scales: { x: AX(), y: AX() }
+    });
+
+    function mk(id, cfg) { if (charts[id]) charts[id].destroy(); const c = document.getElementById(id); if (c) charts[id] = new Chart(c, cfg); }
+
+    function renderMarca(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-marca', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => x.marca), datasets: [{ data: d.map(x => x.valor), backgroundColor: d.map((_, i) => PAL[i % PAL.length]), borderRadius: 4, borderSkipped: false }]
+            },
+            options: OPT(false, 'y')
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderCanal(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-canal', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => x.canal), datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Monto', data: d.map(x => x.valor), backgroundColor: ['#3b82f6', '#06b6d4'], borderRadius: 4, yAxisID: 'y', order: 2 },
+                    { label: '%', data: d.map(x => x.pct), type: 'line', borderColor: '#f472b6', pointBackgroundColor: '#f472b6', borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 5, yAxisID: 'y2', order: 1, fill: false }
+                ]
+            }, options: { ...OPT(true), scales: { x: AX(), y: AX(), y2: { ...AX(), position: 'right', grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }, ticks: { callback: v => v + '%', color: '#64748b' } } } }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderTipo(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-tipo', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => x.tipo), datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Pedidos', data: d.map(x => x.pedidos), backgroundColor: ['#06b6d4', '#ef4444'], borderRadius: 4, yAxisID: 'y', order: 2 },
+                    { label: '%', data: d.map(x => x.pct), type: 'line', borderColor: '#f59e0b', pointBackgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 5, yAxisID: 'y2', order: 1, fill: false }
+                ]
+            }, options: { ...OPT(true), scales: { x: AX(), y: AX(), y2: { ...AX(), position: 'right', grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }, ticks: { callback: v => v + '%', color: '#64748b' } } } }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function renderDiario(d) {
+        if (!d.length) return; mk('c-diario', {
+            type: 'bar', data: {
+                labels: d.map(x => { const dt = new Date(x.dia + 'T00:00:00'); return dt.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' }); }),
+                datasets: [
+                    { label: 'Facturado', data: d.map(x => x.facturado), backgroundColor: 'rgba(6,182,212,.75)', borderRadius: 3, order: 2 },
+                    { label: 'Pedidos Pend.', data: d.map(x => x.pedidos_pendientes), type: 'line', borderColor: '#f59e0b', pointBackgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 4, fill: false, order: 1 }
+                ]
+            }, options: { ...OPT(true), scales: { x: { ...AX(), ticks: { maxRotation: 45, font: { size: 10 }, color: '#64748b' } }, y: AX() } }
+        });
+    }
+
+    setInterval(load, 10 * 60 * 1000);
+</script>

+<script>
+    let configData = {};
+
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadConfig);
+
+    function switchConfigTab(tabName) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.config-tab-content').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
+        document.getElementById('tab-' + tabName).style.display = 'block';
+
+        document.querySelectorAll('.odoo-tab').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
+        event.target.classList.add('active');
+
+        if (tabName === 'emails') {
+            loadEmailLogs();
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadConfig() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/support/config');
+            configData = await res.json();
+
+            // Populate settings
+            if (configData.settings) {
+                if (configData.settings.notification_emails) document.getElementById('notificationEmails').value = configData.settings.notification_emails;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_server) document.getElementById('smtpServer').value = configData.settings.smtp_server;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_port) document.getElementById('smtpPort').value = configData.settings.smtp_port;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_user) document.getElementById('smtpUser').value = configData.settings.smtp_user;
+                if (configData.settings.smtp_password) document.getElementById('smtpPassword').value = "********";
+            }
+
+            renderTables();
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error loading config", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadEmailLogs() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/support/email-logs');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            const body = document.getElementById('emailLogsTableBody');
+
+            if (data.length === 0) {
+                body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align: center; color: #6b7280; padding: 20px;">No hay registros de correos aún.</td></tr>';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            body.innerHTML = data.map(log => {
+                const isError = log.status === 'Failed';
+                return `
+                <tr style="${isError ? 'background-color: #fee2e2;' : ''}">
+                    <td style="white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.85rem;">${log.created_at}</td>
+                    <td style="font-size: 0.85rem; word-break: break-all;">${log.recipients}</td>
+                    <td style="font-size: 0.85rem;">${log.subject || '-'}</td>
+                    <td>
+                        <span style="display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; 
+                            ${isError ? 'background-color: #ef4444; color: white;' : 'background-color: #10b981; color: white;'}">
+                            ${log.status}
+                        </span>
+                    </td>
+                    <td style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #b91c1c; max-width: 300px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word;">${log.error_message || ''}</td>
+                </tr>
+                `;
+            }).join('');
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error loading email logs", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function saveSettings() {
+        const emails = document.getElementById('notificationEmails').value;
+        const smtpServer = document.getElementById('smtpServer').value;
+        const smtpPort = document.getElementById('smtpPort').value;
+        const smtpUser = document.getElementById('smtpUser').value;
+        const smtpPassword = document.getElementById('smtpPassword').value;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('notification_emails', emails);
+        formData.append('smtp_server', smtpServer);
+        formData.append('smtp_port', smtpPort);
+        formData.append('smtp_user', smtpUser);
+        if (smtpPassword) formData.append('smtp_password', smtpPassword);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/support/settings', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const toast = document.getElementById('settingsSavedToast');
+                toast.style.display = 'inline';
+                setTimeout(() => toast.style.display = 'none', 3000);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al guardar ajustes");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error saving settings", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderTables() {
+        // Departments
+        const deptBody = document.getElementById('deptTableBody');
+        deptBody.innerHTML = configData.departments.map(d => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${d.name}</td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('department', ${d.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+
+        // Status
+        const statusBody = document.getElementById('statusTableBody');
+        statusBody.innerHTML = configData.status.map(s => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${s.name}</td>
+                <td><span style="display:inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; background-color: ${s.color_hex || '#ccc'}; border-radius: 4px;"></span></td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('status', ${s.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+
+        // Priority
+        const prioBody = document.getElementById('prioTableBody');
+        prioBody.innerHTML = configData.priorities.map(p => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${p.name}</td>
+                <td>${p.level}</td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('priority', ${p.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+
+        // Type
+        const typeBody = document.getElementById('typeTableBody');
+        typeBody.innerHTML = configData.types.map(t => `
+            <tr>
+                <td>${t.name}</td>
+                <td><button class="btn-odoo-secondary btn-sm" onclick="deleteItem('type', ${t.id})">🗑️</button></td>
+            </tr>
+        `).join('');
+    }
+
+    async function addItem(table, nameId, colorId = null, levelId = null) {
+        const name = document.getElementById(nameId).value;
+        if (!name) return;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('name', name);
+        formData.append('action', 'create');
+
+        if (colorId) formData.append('color', document.getElementById(colorId).value);
+        if (levelId) formData.append('level', document.getElementById(levelId).value);
+
+        await fetch(`/api/support/config/${table}`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+
+        // Clear inputs
+        document.getElementById(nameId).value = '';
+        loadConfig();
+    }
+
+    async function deleteItem(table, id) {
+        if (!confirm('¿Eliminar?')) return;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('id', id);
+        formData.append('action', 'delete');
+        // Name is required by backend validation even if delete? Let's check backend or send dummy.
+        formData.append('name', 'DELETE');
+
+        await fetch(`/api/support/config/${table}`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+        loadConfig();
+    }
+</script>
+{% endblock %}

+

+            console.error("Error loading config", e);

+
+        // Handle form input focus effects matching Odoo
+        document.querySelectorAll('input:not([type="file"]), select, textarea').forEach(el => {

+        document.getElementById('ticketForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+            e.preventDefault();
+
+            const btn = e.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+            btn.innerHTML = 'Enviando...';
+            btn.disabled = true;
+
+            const title = document.getElementById('description').value;
+            const details = document.getElementById('detailed_description').value;
+            const finalDesc = details ? `${title}\n\n${details}` : title;
+
+            const formData = new FormData();
+            formData.append('department_id', document.getElementById('department_id').value);
+            formData.append('type_id', document.getElementById('type_id').value);
+            formData.append('priority_id', document.getElementById('priority_id').value);
+            formData.append('contact_email', document.getElementById('contact_email').value);
+            formData.append('description', finalDesc);
+
+            const fileInput = document.getElementById('file');
+            if (fileInput.files[0]) {
+                formData.append('file', fileInput.files[0]);
+            }
+
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch('/api/support/ticket', {
+                    method: 'POST',
+                    body: formData // No Content-Type header with FormData, let browser set boundary
+                });
+
+                if (res.ok) {
+                    const ticket = await res.json();
+                    alert(`Ticket creado con éxito: ${ticket.code}`);
+                    window.location.href = '/support/tickets'; // Go to list
+                } else {
+                    alert('Error al crear el ticket. Por favor intente nuevamente.');
+                    btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                    btn.disabled = false;
+                }
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error(e);
+                alert('Error de red. Verifique su conexión.');
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+            }
+        });
+    });
+</script>
